jobs.title: IT Business Analyst - Credit (IT)
jobs.description:
• Mission

• The mission consists in performing the role of IT business analyst for key credit applications and projects

Main responsibilities:

• Reporting to the Team Lead of IT Risk, Credit & ESG, the consultant will work on key credit applications projects.

BA Responsibilities:

• Analyse business scenarios/cases and contribute to business requirements definition.

• Define Functional Design Specification.

• Manage vendor application (SpeciTec) relationship (software package Specicred ).

• Install and test new version of Specicred.

• Execute database scripts and queries (SQL) to validate data integrity and ensure alignment with regulatory requirements.

• Liaise with the business to provide guidance from an IT point of view.

• Provide guidance for business analysts, developers, and testers assigned to the projects and ensure good project management practices are employed throughout the project lifecycle.

• Identify key risks and issues and define mitigation scenarios.

• Your Profile

• 5 to 10 years of experience

• Education : Master Degree in IT

• Experience required

• Strong experience required: IT Business Analyst with strong technical and functional skills on Credit projects

• Good understanding of the bank’s business processes

• Good operational experience in the implementation of various IT Credit projects

• Languages:

• French mandatory and English (C1)

• Others

• Swiss residency: Mandatory

descriptionByLocale.it:
• Missione

• La missione consiste nello svolgere il ruolo di analista di business IT per applicazioni di credito chiave e progetti

Principali responsabilità:

• Segnalando al Team Lead of IT Risk, Credit & ESG, il consulente lavorerà su progetti chiave di applicazioni di credito.

BA Responsabilità:

• Analizzare scenari aziendali / casi e contribuire alla definizione dei requisiti aziendali.

• Definire la specifica di progettazione funzionale.

• Gestisci il rapporto dell'applicazione del fornitore (SpeciTec) (pacchetto del software Specicred ).

• Installare e testare la nuova versione di Specicred.

• Eseguire script e query del database (SQL) per convalidare l'integrità dei dati e garantire l'allineamento con i requisiti normativi.

• Liaise con il business per fornire indicazioni da un punto di vista IT.

• Fornire indicazioni per gli analisti, gli sviluppatori e i tester assegnati ai progetti e garantire buone pratiche di gestione dei progetti sono impiegati in tutto il ciclo di vita del progetto.

• Identificare rischi e problemi chiave e definire scenari di mitigazione.

• Il tuo profilo

• da 5 a 10 anni di esperienza

• Istruzione: Master in IT

• Esperienza richiesta

• Forte esperienza richiesta: IT Business Analyst con forti competenze tecniche e funzionali sui progetti di credito

• Buona comprensione dei processi aziendali della banca

• Buona esperienza operativa nell'attuazione di vari progetti di credito IT

• Lingue:

• Francese obbligatorio e inglese (C1)

• Altri

• Residenza svizzera: obbligatoria

descriptionByLocale.de:
• Mission

• Die Mission besteht darin, die Rolle des IT Business Analysten für wichtige Kreditanträge und Projekte zu übernehmen.

Hauptzuständigkeiten:

• Der Berater, der dem Teamleiter von IT Risk, Credit & ESG berichtet, wird an wichtigen Kreditantragsprojekten arbeiten.

BA Zuständigkeiten:

• Analysieren Sie Geschäftsszenarien / -fälle und tragen Sie zur Definition von Geschäftsanforderungen bei.

• Definieren der funktionalen Designspezifikation.

• Verwalten von Vendor Application (SpeciTec) Beziehung (Softwarepaket Specicred ).

• Installieren und testen Sie eine neue Version von Specicred.

• Führen Sie Datenbankskripte und Abfragen (SQL) aus, um die Datenintegrität zu validieren und die Übereinstimmung mit den regulatorischen Anforderungen sicherzustellen.

• Verbinden Sie sich mit dem Unternehmen, um eine Anleitung aus IT-Sicht zu geben.

• Bereitstellung von Anleitungen für Geschäftsanalysten, Entwickler und Tester, die den Projekten zugewiesen sind, und Gewährleistung guter Projektmanagementpraktiken während des gesamten Projektlebenszyklus.

• Identifizieren Sie die wichtigsten Risiken und Probleme und definieren Sie Minderungsszenarien.

• Ihr Profil

• 5 bis 10 Jahre Erfahrung

• Ausbildung: Master Degree in IT

• Erforderliche Erfahrung

• Starke Erfahrung erforderlich: IT Business Analyst mit starken technischen und funktionalen Fähigkeiten bei Kreditprojekten

• Gutes Verständnis der Geschäftsprozesse der Bank

• Gute operative Erfahrung bei der Umsetzung verschiedener IT Credit Projekte

• Sprachen:

• Französisch obligatorisch und Englisch (C1)

• Andere

• Schweizer Wohnsitz: obligatorisch
descriptionByLocale.fr:
• Mission

• La mission consiste à jouer le rôle d'analyste informatique pour les principales applications et projets de crédit

Principales responsabilités :

• Relevant de l'équipe responsable du risque informatique, du crédit et de l'ESG, le consultant travaillera sur des projets clés de demandes de crédit.

Responsabilités du BA :

• Analyser les scénarios/cas d'affaires et contribuer à la définition des exigences opérationnelles.

• Définir la spécification de conception fonctionnelle.

• Gérer la relation entre l'application fournisseur (SpeciTec) (paquet logiciel Specicred ).

• Installer et tester une nouvelle version de Specicred.

• Exécuter des scripts de base de données et des requêtes (SQL) pour valider l'intégrité des données et assurer l'alignement avec les exigences réglementaires.

• Assurer la liaison avec l'entreprise pour fournir des conseils d'un point de vue informatique.

• Fournir des conseils aux analystes opérationnels, aux concepteurs et aux testeurs affectés aux projets et s'assurer que les bonnes pratiques de gestion des projets sont utilisées tout au long du cycle de vie du projet.

• Identifier les principaux risques et enjeux et définir les scénarios d'atténuation.

• Votre profil

• 5 à 10 ans d'expérience

• Éducation : Maîtrise en informatique

• Expérience requise

• Forte expérience requise: Analyste d'affaires TI avec de solides compétences techniques et fonctionnelles sur les projets de crédit

• Bonne compréhension des processus opérationnels de la banque

• Bonne expérience opérationnelle dans la mise en œuvre de divers projets de crédit informatique

• Langues:

• Français obligatoire et anglais (C1)

• Autres

• Résidence suisse : obligatoire

jobs.title: Structured Product Engineer
jobs.description:
Mission & Main responsibilities

• Product Management:
• Oversee the booking process for new structured products and ensure effective life cycle monitoring of existing products.

• Manage post-trade services for the EMEA team, including the creation of products in internal systems and mapping products into team tools.

• Act as a liaison between Bankers, Advisors, Middle Office, and Back Office teams to ensure seamless communication and coordination.

• Digital Development and Process Optimization:
• Identify opportunities for improvement in both automated and manual tasks, providing actionable feedback and suggestions.

• Design, develop, and maintain Excel-based tools to support the Structured Products team in their daily operations.

• Contribute to the enhancement of digital processes to improve efficiency and accuracy in team workflows.

• Contribute to automation of the booking process.

• Ensure the best execution in a secure framework in open architecture
• Pricing of structured products in a secure operational framework

• Focus on flow products (in comparison to solution products)

• Ensure best execution in accordance with regulatory requirements

• Management of the Issuer relationship, with a focus on the search for internal group synergies

• Back up of the Solutions activity in case of needs

• Development of tactical trade ideas
• Design, analysis, and selection of SP tactical ideas (trading axis, market opportunities etc.)

• Promotion of new payoffs within subscription products

• Client focus:
• Provide expertise and support to internal partners and clients

• Take initiatives to achieve quantitative objectives for the structured products business

• Build relationship with private bankers

• Favour internal synergies

Your Profile

• Education: Master degree in Financial Markets

• Experience Technical skills - 5y of experience on Structured Products field

• Languages - English, French, German, others

• Personal skills - Team player, agile, Pro active, ability to take initiatives, business developpement & service oriented

• IT skills: Programming proficiency with at least one major language, such as Python. Excellent knowledge of the Pandas and NumPy packages. Proven experience in project development or automation using this expertise / data management and data analysis.

• Others: Swiss Residence

Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives

descriptionByLocale.it:
Missione e responsabilità principali

- Gestione dei prodotti: - Controllare il processo di prenotazione di nuovi prodotti strutturati e garantire un efficace monitoraggio del ciclo di vita dei prodotti esistenti. - Gestire i servizi post-trade per il team EMEA, compresa la creazione di prodotti nei sistemi interni e la mappatura dei prodotti in strumenti di squadra. - Agire come collegamento tra banchieri, consulenti, servizi di Medio Ufficio e Back Office per garantire una comunicazione e un coordinamento senza soluzione di continuità. - Sviluppo digitale e ottimizzazione dei processi: - Identificare opportunità di miglioramento in attività sia automatizzate che manuali, fornendo feedback e suggerimenti efficaci.

- Progettare, sviluppare e mantenere strumenti basati su Excel per supportare il team di prodotti strutturati nelle loro operazioni quotidiane. - Contribuire al miglioramento dei processi digitali per migliorare l'efficienza e l'accuratezza dei flussi di lavoro del team. - Contribuire all'automazione del processo di prenotazione.

- Garantire la migliore esecuzione in un quadro sicuro in architettura aperta - Prezzi dei prodotti strutturati in un quadro operativo sicuro - Focus sui prodotti di flusso (rispetto ai prodotti di soluzione) - Garantire la migliore esecuzione in conformità con i requisiti normativi - Gestione del rapporto Emittente, con un focus sulla ricerca di sinergie interne di gruppo - Backup dell'attività Solutions in caso di necessità - Sviluppo di idee commerciali tattiche - Progettazione, analisi e selezione di idee tattiche SP (asse di trading, opportunità di mercato ecc.) - Promozione di nuovi premi all'interno di un abbonamento

prodotti - Client focus: - Fornire competenza e supporto ai partner e clienti interni - Prendere iniziative per raggiungere obiettivi quantitativi per il business dei prodotti strutturati - Costruire rapporti con banchieri privati - Favorire le sinergie interne

Il tuo profilo

- Formazione: Laurea magistrale in Mercati finanziari - Esperienze Competenze tecniche - 5a esperienza sul campo Prodotti strutturati - Lingue - Inglese, Francese, Tedesco, Altri - Competenze personali - Giocatore di team, Angle, Pro attivo, capacità di prendere iniziative, sviluppo di imprese & servizi orientati - Competenze IT: Conoscenza di programmazione con almeno una lingua importante, come Python. Conoscenza eccellente dei pacchetti Pandas e NumPy. Esperienza di proven nello sviluppo di progetti o automazione utilizzando questa competenza / gestione dei dati e analisi dei dati.

- Altro: Residenza Svizzera - Competenze fondamentali: Aderenza ai valori aziendali: Dedicazione, Convizione, Agiltà e Responsabilità - Rispetto delle normative e delle direttive interne

- Entwerfen, entwickeln und pflegen Excel-basierte Tools, um das Team Structured Products in ihrem täglichen Betrieb zu unterstützen. - Beitrag zur Verbesserung der digitalen Prozesse, um Effizienz und Genauigkeit in Team-Workflows zu verbessern. - Beitrag zur Automatisierung des Buchungsprozesses.

Produkte - Kundenfokus: - Bereitstellung von Know-how und Unterstützung für interne Partner und Kunden - ergreifen Initiativen, um quantitative Ziele für das strukturierte Produktgeschäft zu erreichen - Build-Beziehung mit privaten Bankern - Favour interne Synergien

Ihr Profil

- Ausbildung: Master in Financial Markets - Erfahrung Technische Fähigkeiten - 5y Erfahrung auf dem Gebiet der strukturierten Produkte - Sprachen - Englisch, Französisch, Deutsch, andere - Persönliche Fähigkeiten - Teamplayer, agil, Pro aktiv, Fähigkeit, Initiativen zu ergreifen, Business DevelopmentPement & Service orientiert - IT-Fähigkeiten: Programmierkenntnisse mit mindestens einer wichtigen Sprache, wie Python. Ausgezeichnete Kenntnisse der Pandas und NumPy-Pakete. Bewährte Erfahrung in der Projektentwicklung oder Automatisierung mit diesem Know-how / Datenmanagement und Datenanalyse.

- Sonstige: Schweizer Residenz - Kernkompetenzen : Unternehmensnähe, Werte: Widmung, Überzeugung, Agilität und Verantwortung - Einhaltung von Vorschriften und internen Richtlinien

- Concevoir, développer et maintenir des outils basés sur Excel pour soutenir l'équipe Produits Structured dans leurs opérations quotidiennes. - Contribuer à l'amélioration des processus numériques pour améliorer l'efficacité et la précision des workflows d'équipe. - Contribuer à l'automatisation du processus de réservation.

- Assurer la meilleure exécution dans un cadre sécurisé en architecture ouverte - Tarification des produits structurés dans un cadre opérationnel sécurisé - Focus sur les produits de flux (par rapport aux produits de solution) - Assurer la meilleure exécution conformément aux exigences réglementaires - Gestion de la relation d'émetteur, en mettant l'accent sur la recherche de synergies internes de groupes - Sauvegarde de l'activité Solutions en cas de besoins - Développement d'idées commerciales tactiques - Conception, analyse et sélection d'idées tactiques SP (axe de négociation, opportunités de marché, etc.) - Promotion de nouveaux avantages dans le cadre de l'abonnement

produits - Objectif client : - Fournir expertise et soutien aux partenaires et clients internes - Prendre des initiatives pour atteindre des objectifs quantitatifs pour l'entreprise de produits structurés - Établir des relations avec les banquiers privés - synergies internes Favour

titleByLocale.fr: Gestion des Changements / Incidents / Problèmes / Vulnérabilités

jobs.description:
• Mission

We are looking for our new team member, passionate about ITIL processes and Vulnerability Management, willing to be part of a team which is at the crossroads or all IT departments and addressing a large variety of subjects that help the IT department achieving A class results

• Main responsibilities

- Escalate, coordinate, animate committees, report and communicate on IT Major Incidents
 - Review, assess, validate, animate CAB, report and communicate on IT Changes
 - Log, coordinate, keep track, animate sessions, and report on IT Problems
 - Log, coordinate, keep track, report on Vulnerabilities and animate Vulnerability Management meetings

• Your Profile

- Master degree in IT and/or Security
 - 5 years experience in Incident / Change / Problem / Vulnerability management
 - Fluency in French and English
 - Experience with Nessus or Qualys scanning tools (build & operate scans)
 - ITIL certifications
 - Team player, ability to work in autonomy but as a member of a team with shared responsibilities and goals
 - Ability to work under stress, list priorities, build action plan and follow the plan
 - Excellent communication skills, orally and in written. Ability to animate calls with different audiences (technical and management)
 - Flexibility according to work priorities

descriptionByLocale.it:

• Principali responsabilità

- Escalate, coordinate, animate i comitati, segnalate e comunicate sui principali Incidenti IT
 - Revisione, valutare, convalidare, animare CAB, segnalare e comunicare sulle modifiche IT
 - Log, coordinate, tenere traccia, animare le sessioni e segnalare i problemi IT
 - Log, coordinate, tenere traccia, rapporto sulle vulnerabilità e animare riunioni di gestione della vulnerabilità

• Il tuo profilo

- Laurea Magistrale in IT e/o Sicurezza
 - 5 anni di esperienza in Incident / Change / Problema / Gestione della vulnerabilità
 - Fluency in francese e inglese
 - Esperienza con strumenti di scansione Nessus o Qualys (costruire e gestire scansioni)
 - Certificazioni ITIL

 - Eccellente capacità di comunicazione, per via orale e scritta. Capacità di animare le chiamate con un pubblico diverso (tecnica e gestione)

 - Expérience avec les outils de numérisation Nesus ou Qualys (construisez et actionnez des scans)
 - Certifications ITIL
 - Joueur d'équipe, capacité de travailler en autonomie mais en tant que membre d'une équipe avec des responsabilités et des objectifs partagés
 - Capacité de travailler sous stress, de dresser la liste des priorités, d'élaborer un plan d'action et de suivre le plan
 - Excellentes compétences en communication, oralement et par écrit. Capacité d'animer les appels avec différents publics (technique et gestion)
 - Flexibilité selon les priorités de travail

jobs.description:
Mission
 Lead and strengthen UBP’s cybersecurity first line of defence by overseeing Security Risk & Governance and Vulnerability Management. Establish, maintain, and evolve a robust, transparent control framework aligned to global banking regulations (FINMA, EU, UK, Hong Kong, Singapore). Partner with Technology, Business, Risk, and Compliance stakeholders to proactively manage cyber risks, ensure regulatory adherence, and safeguard UBP’s clients and assets.

Main responsibilities
 Governance & Risk Management

• Own and evolve the cybersecurity risk management framework, policies, standards, and security controls catalogue for first line of defence.

• Drive risk identification, assessment, and ensure that adequate and achievable treatment plans are defined and implemented in effective timescales.

• Maintain risk registers and key risk indicators (KRIs). Ensure discrete risks are clearly identified, challenged and catalogued without duplication or unnecessary overlap.

• Ensure alignment with group risk appetite, regulatory expectations, and industry best practices (ISF, NIST CSF, ISO/IEC 27001/27005).
 Vulnerability Management

• Lead enterprise vulnerability management strategy and operations (infrastructure, applications, cloud, third parties).

• Oversee vulnerability scanning, assessment, risk-based prioritisation, and timely remediation in line with SLAs.

• Partner with Infrastructure, DevSecOps, and application owners to embed secure-by-design principles and shift-left controls.

• Report on exposure, trends, and risk posture to senior management and risk committees.
 Regulatory Compliance & Audit Support

• Interpret and operationalize cyber requirements across FINMA, EU (including DORA/NIS2 where applicable), UK (PRA/FCA), Hong Kong (HKMA), and Singapore (MAS).

• Prepare evidence and responses for internal/external audits, regulatory exams, and board-level reporting.

• Maintain control mapping to regulatory frameworks; ensure continuous readiness and closure of findings.

• Manage and mentor a small team; build capabilities and career growth for junior staff.

• Communicate complex cyber risk topics clearly to senior management and non-technical stakeholders.

• Champion a risk-aware culture across technology and business functions.
 Leadership & Stakeholder Management

• Champion a risk-aware culture across technology and business functions.

Your Profile

• Experienced cybersecurity risk leader with deep first line of defense experience in financial services.

• Strong knowledge of regulatory environments across Switzerland (FINMA), EU, UK, Hong Kong, and Singapore, with proven ability to operationalize requirements.

• Strategic thinker with hands-on rigor—able to sustain current frameworks while maturing them for scalability and transparency.

• Influential communicator and collaborative partner comfortable engaging senior executives and guiding junior staff.

Education

• Bachelor’s or master’s degree in information security, Computer Science, Engineering, Risk Management, or a related field.

• Relevant certifications preferred: CISSP, CISM, CRISC, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer/Auditor, CEH, or equivalent.

Experience Technical skills

• 8–12+ years in cybersecurity with significant exposure to first line risk and control management in a regulated bank.

• Proven track record in:

• Designing and operating cyber risk and control frameworks (policies, standards, KRIs/KPIs, control testing).

• Leading enterprise vulnerability management (tools, processes, SLAs, metrics, remediation governance).

• Regulatory engagement, audit response, and evidence management.

• Cross-border regulatory alignment (FINMA, EU/DORA, UK PRA/FCA, HKMA, MAS).

• Practical familiarity with:

• Frameworks/standards: NIST CSF, NIST 800-53, ISO/IEC 27001/27002/27005, OWASP, CIS Controls, MITRE ATT&CK.

• VM tooling & ecosystems: Qualys/Tenable/Rapid7, SAST/DAST, SCA, container and cloud posture management (CSPM), EDR/XDR.

• Enterprise environments: Windows/Unix, networks, databases, microservices, SaaS, public cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP).

• Secure SDLC/DevSecOps and CI/CD integration of controls.

• Reporting and metrics for executive forums and risk committees.

Languages

• English: fluent (written and spoken).

• French - strong advantage.

Personal skills

• Leadership: coaching mindset, able to build high-performing teams and upskill junior colleagues.

• Communication: clear, concise, and audience-appropriate; strong presentation and writing skills.

• Decision-making: risk-based prioritisation, data-driven, and pragmatic under time pressure.

• Collaboration: strong stakeholder management across IT, Risk, Compliance, and business lines.

• Adaptability: navigates ambiguity; balances regulatory rigor with business practicality.

• Integrity: high professional ethics and commitment to client and bank protection.

Others

• Location: Geneva

• Swiss Residence

• Hybrid working arrangements aligned with UBP policy.

• Candidates must have the right to work in the relevant jurisdiction.

• Background checks required consistent with banking standards.

Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives

descriptionByLocale.it:
Mission Lead e rafforzare la cybersicurezza UBP prima linea di difesa, supervisionando Security Risk & Governance and Vulnerability Management. Stabilire, mantenere e evolvere un solido e trasparente quadro di controllo allineato alle normative bancarie globali (FINMA, UE, Regno Unito, Hong Kong, Singapore). Partner con le parti interessate Tecnologia, Business, Rischio e conformità per gestire proattivamente i rischi informatici, garantire l'adesione alla normativa e salvaguardare i clienti e le attività UBP.

Principali responsabilità

Governance & Risk Management - Proprio ed evolve il quadro di gestione del rischio in materia di sicurezza informatica, politiche, standard e controlli di sicurezza per la prima linea di difesa. - Guidare l'identificazione, la valutazione e garantire che piani di trattamento adeguati e realizzabili siano definiti e attuati in tempi effettivi. - Mantenere registri di rischio e indicatori di rischio chiave (KRI). Garantire che i rischi discreti siano chiaramente identificati, sfidati e catalogati senza duplicazioni o sovrapposizioni inutili.

- Garantire l'allineamento con l'appetito di gruppo, le aspettative normative e le migliori pratiche del settore (ISF, NIST CSF, ISO/IEC 27001/27005).

Gestione della vulnerabilità - Strategia e operazioni di gestione delle vulnerabilità aziendali (infrastrutture, applicazioni, cloud, terze parti). - Superare la scansione delle vulnerabilità, la valutazione, la priorità basata sul rischio e la riparazione tempestiva in linea con gli SLA. - Partner con l'infrastruttura, DevSecOps e i proprietari di applicazioni per eliminare i principi di sicurezza per progettazione e i controlli a sinistra-spostamento. - Relazione sull'esposizione, tendenze e posizione dei rischi per i comitati di gestione e rischio senior.

Supporto alla conformità e all'audit normativi - Interpretazione e implementazione dei requisiti informatici in tutta la FINMA, UE (compreso DORA/NIS2 se del caso), Regno Unito (PRA/FCA), Hong Kong (HKMA) e Singapore (MAS). - Preparare prove e risposte per audit interni/esterni, esami di regolamentazione e relazioni a livello di consiglio di amministrazione. - Mantenere la mappatura dei controlli ai quadri normativi; garantire la disponibilità e la chiusura continua dei risultati. - Gestire e guidare una piccola squadra; costruire capacità e crescita della carriera per il personale più giovane.

- Comunicare chiaramente ai soggetti di alto livello di gestione e non tecnici temi complessi di rischio informatico. - Champion una cultura del rischio consapevole attraverso la tecnologia e le funzioni aziendali.

Leadership & Stakeholder Management - Champion una cultura consapevole del rischio tra le funzioni tecnologiche e aziendali.

Il tuo profilo - Leader esperto in sicurezza informatica con profonda esperienza di prima linea in materia di servizi finanziari. - Conoscenza di ambienti normativi in Svizzera (FINMA), UE, Regno Unito, Hong Kong e Singapore, con comprovata capacità di operare requisiti. - Pensatore strategico con risorse pratiche in grado di sostenere i quadri attuali maturandoli per la capacità di scalabilità e trasparenza. - Comunicazione influente e partner collaborativo confortevole coinvolgendo dirigenti senior e guidando personale junior.

Istruzione - Laurea magistrale in sicurezza dell'informazione, informatica, ingegneria, gestione del rischio, o un campo correlato. - Certificazioni pertinenti preferite: CISSP, CISM, CRISC, ISO 27001 Implementatore/Auditore di piombo, CEH, o equivalente.

Esperienza e competenze tecniche - 8.12+ anni in sicurezza informatica con significativa esposizione al rischio di prima linea e gestione del controllo in una banca regolamentata. - Proven record in: - Progettazione e gestione di quadri di controllo e rischio informatici (politiche, standard, KRI/KPI, test di controllo). - Gestione leader delle vulnerabilità aziendali (strumenti, processi, SLA, metriche, governance di bonifica). - Impegno normativo, risposta alla revisione e gestione delle prove. - Allineamento normativo transfrontaliero (FINMA, EU/DORA, UK PRA/FCA, HKMA, MAS).

- Gestione pratica delle applicazioni e dei sistemi di gestione delle posture (CSPM), EDR/XDR. - Ambienti aziendali: Windows/Unix, reti, database, microservizi, SaaS, cloud pubblico (AWS/Azur/GCP). - Sicurezza SDLC/DevSecOps e integrazione dei controlli CI/CD. - Comunicazione e metriche per forum esecutivi e comitati di rischio.

Lingue - Inglese: fluente (scritto e parlato). - Francese - forte vantaggio.

Capacità personali - Leadership: mentalità di coaching, in grado di costruire team ad alte prestazioni e colleghi giovani esperti. - Comunicazione: chiara, concisa e adeguata al pubblico; forte capacità di presentazione e scrittura. - Decision-making: priorità basata sul rischio, dati guidati e pragmatici sotto pressione temporale. - Collaborazione: una forte gestione delle parti interessate attraverso le linee IT, Risk, Compliance e business. - Adattabilità: naviga in ambiguità; equilibrio tra rigor normativo e praticità aziendale. - Integrità: elevata etica professionale e impegno per la protezione dei clienti e delle banche.

Altro - Ubicazione: Ginevra - Residenza Svizzera - Accordi di lavoro ibridi in linea con la politica UBP. - I candidati devono avere il diritto di lavorare nella giurisdizione competente. - Controlli di background richiesti in conformità con gli standard bancari.

Core Competence - Aderenza ai valori aziendali: Dedicazione, Convinzione, Agiltà e Responsabilità - Rispetto delle normative e delle direttive interne

descriptionByLocale.de:
Mission Leiten und stärken Sie die Cybersicherheit von UBP, der ersten Verteidigungslinie, indem Sie Security Risk & Governance und Vulnerability Management überwachen. Aufbau, Aufrechterhaltung und Weiterentwicklung eines robusten, transparenten Kontrollrahmens, der sich an globale Bankenvorschriften (FINMA, EU, UK, Hong Kong, Singapur) orientiert. Partner von Technologie-, Business-, Risiko- und Compliance-Stakeholdern, um Cyberrisiken proaktiv zu verwalten, die regulatorische Einhaltung zu gewährleisten und UBP, Kunden und Vermögenswerte zu schützen.

Hauptverantwortung

Governance & Risikomanagement - Eigene und Weiterentwicklung des Cybersecurity Risikomanagement-Rahmens, der Richtlinien, Standards und Sicherheitskontrollen Katalog für erste Verteidigungslinie. - Antrieb Risikoidentifikation, Bewertung und sicherzustellen, dass angemessene und erreichbare Behandlungspläne in effektiven Zeitskalen definiert und umgesetzt werden. - Pflege von Risikoregistern und Schlüsselrisikoindikatoren (KRIs). Stellen Sie sicher, dass diskrete Risiken klar identifiziert, herausgefordert und katalogisiert werden, ohne Doppelarbeit oder unnötige Überschneidungen.

- Gewährleistung der Angleichung an den Risikohunger der Gruppe, die Erwartungen an die Regulierung und die besten Praktiken der Industrie (ISF, NIST CSF, ISO/IEC 27001/2705).

Vulnerability Management - Lead Enterprise Vulnerability Management Strategie und Operationen (Infrastruktur, Anwendungen, Cloud, Dritte). - Überwachen Sie die Schwachstellen-Scanning, Bewertung, risikobasierte Priorisierung und rechtzeitige Sanierung im Einklang mit SLAs. - Partner mit Infrastruktur, DevSecOps, und Anwendungsinhaber, um sichere-by-Design-Prinzipien und Shift-Links-Steuerungen zu integrieren. - Bericht über Exposition, Trends und Risikohaltung an Senior Management und Risikoausschüsse.

Regulatory Compliance & Audit Support - Beenden und operationalisieren Cyber-Anforderungen in der FINMA, EU (einschließlich DORA/NIS2, soweit zutreffend), UK (PRA/FCA), Hong Kong (HKMA) und Singapur (MAS). - Bereiten Sie Beweise und Antworten für interne / externe Audits, regulatorische Prüfungen und Board-Level-Berichterstattung. - Aufrechterhaltung der Kontrolle Kartierung auf regulatorischen Rahmen; Gewährleistung der kontinuierlichen Bereitschaft und Schließung von Erkenntnissen. - Verwalten und Mentor ein kleines Team; Aufbau von Fähigkeiten und Karrierewachstum für Nachwuchskräfte.

- Kommunikation komplexer Cyber-Risiko-Themen klar zu Senior Management und nicht-technische Stakeholder. - Champion eine Risiko-aware-Kultur über Technologie und Geschäftsfunktionen.

Leadership & Stakeholder Management - Champion eine Risiko-aware-Kultur über Technologie und Geschäftsfunktionen.

Ihr Profil - Erfahrener Cybersicherheits-Risikoführer mit tiefer erster Verteidigungserfahrung in Finanzdienstleistungen. - Starkes Wissen über regulatorische Rahmenbedingungen in der Schweiz (FINMA), EU, Großbritannien, Hongkong und Singapur, mit nachgewiesener Fähigkeit, Anforderungen zu operationalisieren. - Strategischer Denker mit Hands-on-rigor-fähig, um aktuelle Rahmenbedingungen zu erhalten, während sie für Skalierbarkeit und Transparenz reifen. - Einflussreicher Kommunikator und kollaborativen Partner komfortabel mit Führungskräften und leitenden Nachwuchskräften.

Ausbildung - Bachelor, Master, Master in Informationssicherheit, Informatik, Engineering, Risikomanagement, oder ein verwandtes Gebiet. - Relevante Zertifizierungen bevorzugt: CISSP, CISM, CRISC, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer/Auditor, CEH, oder gleichwertig.

Erfahrung & technische Fähigkeiten - 8–12+ Jahre in Cybersicherheit mit signifikanter Exposition gegenüber First-Line-Risiko- und Control-Management in einer regulierten Bank. - Bewährte Erfolgsbilanz in: - Designing and operating Cyber-Risiko- und Control-Frameworks (Policies, Standards, KRIs/KPIs, Control-Tests). - Führendes Enterprise-Anfälligkeitsmanagement (Tools, Prozesse, SLAs, Metriken, Sanierungs-Governance). - Regulatorische Engagement, Audit-Response, und Evidence-Management. - Grenzübergreifende Regulierungs-Anpassung (FINMA, EU/DORA, UK PRA/FCA, HKMA, MAS).

- Die Veröffentlichung von Informationen über die Auswirkungen der Veröffentlichungen auf die Umwelt und die Umwelt, die in den letzten Jahren auf die Umwelt und die Umwelt in Europa und in den Mitgliedstaaten der Europäischen Union stattgefunden haben, ist ein wichtiger Schritt in Richtung auf die Schaffung eines europäischen Raums, der die Entwicklung der europäischen Wirtschaft und die Entwicklung der europäischen Wirtschaft und der europäischen Wirtschaft in den nächsten Jahren voranbringen wird.

Sprachen - Englisch: fließend (geschrieben und gesprochen). - Französisch - starker Vorteil.

Persönliche Fähigkeiten - Führung: Coaching Mindset, in der Lage, hochperformante Teams und upskill Junior Kollegen aufzubauen. - Kommunikation: klar, prägnant, und Publikumsgerecht; starke Präsentation und Schreibkompetenzen. - Entscheidungsfindung: Risikobasierte Priorisierung, datengetrieben, und pragmatisch unter Zeitdruck. - Zusammenarbeit: starke Stakeholder-Management über IT, Risiko, Compliance und Geschäftsfelder. - Anpassungsfähigkeit: Navigiert Ambiguität; balanciert regulatorische Strenge mit Business-Practice. - Integrität: hohe professionelle Ethik und Engagement für Kunden-und Bankschutz.

Andere - Ort: Genf - Swiss Residence - Hybride Arbeitsvereinbarungen nach UBP-Politik. - Bewerber müssen das Recht haben, in der jeweiligen Gerichtsbarkeit zu arbeiten. - Hintergrundkontrollen erforderlich, die mit Bankstandards.

Kernkompetenzen - Unternehmensverträglichkeit, Werte: Widmung, Überzeugung, Agilität und Verantwortung - Einhaltung von Vorschriften und internen Richtlinien
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Mission Diriger et renforcer UBP, la cybersécurité première ligne de défense en supervisant la gestion des risques et de la vulnérabilité en matière de sécurité. Établir, maintenir et développer un cadre de contrôle solide et transparent aligné sur les réglementations bancaires mondiales (FINMA, UE, Royaume-Uni, Hong Kong, Singapour).

Principales responsabilités

Gouvernance et gestion des risques - Procéder à l'identification, à l'évaluation et à la mise en oeuvre de plans de traitement adéquats et réalisables à l'échelle des délais. - Tenir des registres des risques et des indicateurs de risque clés (IRC). Veiller à ce que les risques distincts soient clairement identifiés, contestés et catalogués sans chevauchement ni chevauchement inutile.

- Assurer l'alignement sur l'appétit des groupes pour les risques, les attentes réglementaires et les meilleures pratiques de l'industrie (ISF, NIST CSF, ISO/IEC 27001/27005).

Gestion de la vulnérabilité - Stratégie et opérations de gestion de la vulnérabilité de l'entreprise (infrastructure, applications, nuage, tiers). - Superviser la vérification de la vulnérabilité, l'évaluation, le système de suivi des risques et la correction en temps opportun conformément aux ALS. - Associé avec Infrastructure, DevSecOps et les propriétaires d'applications pour intégrer des principes de sécurité par conception et des contrôles par décalage gauche. - Rapport sur l'exposition, les tendances et la posture de risque aux cadres supérieurs et aux comités de risque.

Compliance réglementaire et soutien à l'audit - Interpréter et rendre opérationnel les cyberexigences dans l'ensemble de la FINMA, de l'UE (y compris DORA/NIS2, le cas échéant), du Royaume-Uni (PRA/FCA), de Hong Kong (HKMA) et de Singapour (MAS). - Préparer des preuves et des réponses pour les audits internes/externes, les examens réglementaires et les rapports au niveau des conseils d'administration. - Maintenir la cartographie des contrôles aux cadres réglementaires; assurer la préparation continue et la clôture des conclusions. - Gérer et encadrer une petite équipe; renforcer les capacités et l'avancement professionnel des employés subalternes.

- Communiquer clairement les sujets complexes du cyberrisque aux cadres supérieurs et aux intervenants non techniques. - Faire la promotion d'une culture de sensibilisation au risque dans toutes les fonctions technologiques et opérationnelles.

Leadership et gestion des intervenants - Championne une culture de sensibilisation aux risques dans toutes les fonctions technologiques et opérationnelles.

Votre profil - Leader expérimenté du risque de cybersécurité avec une expérience de première ligne profonde en matière de défense dans les services financiers. - Une connaissance solide des environnements réglementaires en Suisse (FINMA), dans l'UE, au Royaume-Uni, à Hong Kong et à Singapour, avec une capacité éprouvée de rendre les exigences opérationnelles. - Un penseur stratégique avec rigueur pratique, capable de maintenir les cadres actuels tout en les évoluant pour l'évolutivité et la transparence. - Un communicateur influent et un partenaire collaboratif à l'aise en engageant les cadres supérieurs et en guidant le personnel junior.

Études - Baccalauréat ou maîtrise en sécurité de l'information, informatique, génie, gestion des risques ou un domaine connexe. - Certifications pertinentes préférées : CISSP, CISM, CRISC, ISO 27001 Mise en œuvre/Auditeur en chef, CEH ou équivalent.

Expérience et compétences techniques - 8-12 ans en cybersécurité avec une exposition significative à la gestion du risque et du contrôle de première ligne dans une banque réglementée. - Expérience en : - conception et exploitation de cadres de cyberrisque et de contrôle (politiques, normes, KRI/ICP, essais de contrôle). - Gestion de la vulnérabilité de l'entreprise (outils, processus, SLA, métriques, gouvernance de l'assainissement). - Engagement réglementaire, réponse aux audits et gestion des données. - Harmonisation réglementaire transfrontalière (FINMA, EU/DORA, UK PRA/FCA, HKMA, MAS).

- Connaissance pratique des cadres et des normes : NIST CSF, NIST 800-53, ISO/IEC 27001/27002/27005, OWASP, CIS Controls, MITRE ATT&CK. - Outils et écosystèmes VM : Qualys/Tenable/Rapid7, SAST/DAST, SCA, conteneur et gestion de la posture dans le cloud (CSPM), EDR/XDR. - Environnements d'entreprise : Windows/Unix, réseaux, bases de données, microservices, SaaS, nuage public (AWS/Azure/GCP). - Sécuriser les SDLC/DevSecOps et l'intégration des contrôles CI/CD. - Rapports et mesures pour les forums exécutifs et les comités de risque.

Langues - Anglais : couramment (écrit et parlé). - Français - fort avantage.

Compétences personnelles - Leadership : encadrement de l'esprit, capacité de former des équipes performantes et des collègues juniors de haut niveau. - Communication : claire, concise et adaptée au public; forte capacité de présentation et d'écriture. - Prise de décision : fondée sur le risque, l'initiative de l'initiative des IRSC, axée sur les données et pragmatique sous pression temporelle. - Collaboration : forte gestion des intervenants dans les secteurs de l'informatique, du risque, de la conformité et de l'activité. - Adaptabilité : oriente l'ambiguïté; concilie rigueur réglementaire et praticité opérationnelle. - Intégrité : haute éthique professionnelle et engagement envers la protection des clients et des banques.

Autres - Lieu: Genève - Résidence suisse - Aménagements de travail hybrides conformes à la politique UBP. - Les candidats doivent avoir le droit de travailler dans la juridiction compétente. - Vérifications de l'historique requises conformément aux normes bancaires.

Compétences de base - Adhérence à l'entreprise, valeurs : Dedication, Conviction, Agilité et Responsabilité - Conformité aux règlements et directives internes

jobs.title: System Engineer - Messaging
jobs.description:
• Mission

• As a Senior Systems Engineer, you will play a crucial role in managing and improving our Microsoft/Citrix based systems and infrastructure. Your expertise will be essential in ensuring high availability, performance, and security of our IT services.

• Challenges:

• Evolve in a challenging, regulated environment for a fast and growing Private Bank

• Main responsibilities

• Design, implementation, and management of Microsoft-related technologies, including but not limited to Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, Exchange, Microsoft PKI, DFS, MS Teams.

jobs.title: Head of Cyber Security Engineering
jobs.description:
Mission
Lead the Bank’s Cyber Engineering function to design, build, and operate secure-by-design platforms and controls that proactively prevent, detect, and respond to cyber threats. Own the end-to-end engineering roadmap for cyber capabilities, ensuring resilience, reliability, and compliance across hybrid on prem and cloud environments.
 Main responsibilities
• Define and execute the cyber engineering roadmap aligned to the Bank’s risk appetite and business goals.
• Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing team across security engineering, DevSecOps, and cyber platform operations.
• Own budget, vendor strategy, and capacity planning for cyber tooling and platforms.
• Establish and enforce security-by-design and security-by-default patterns across infrastructure, applications, and data.
• Industrialize security controls via automation, IaC, and CI/CD integration; shift-left security in development lifecycle.
• Own the roadmap, implementation, and lifecycle management of enterprise-class security platforms (e.g., EDR/XDR, PAM, CSPM, DLP, HSM, etc.).
• Ensure availability, scalability, and performance of cyber platforms with robust SLAs and KPIs.

Your Profile
• Visionary cyber engineering leader with deep hands-on and the ability to translate complex security requirements into scalable engineering solutions.
• Proven experience building and running security platforms in complex, regulated financial environments.

Education
• Master’s or bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Security, Engineering, or related field.
Experience Technical skills
• Senior: 7-10 years of experience.
• 5+ years of experience in Information Security area related to one or more of the following domains: security architecture, security engineering and integration or secure application development.

Languages
• French : fluent
• English : Strong advantage
 Personal skills
• Self-motivated leader with ownership mindset; able to operate strategically while remaining hands-on when needed.
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management; able to translate technical risk into business impact.
• Strong critical thinking, analytical problem-solving, and decision-making under pressure.
• Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams and drive complex, multi-department initiatives.
• High integrity, resilience, and commitment to continuous improvement.

Others
• Swiss Residence: Mandatory

Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives

jobs.title: Microsoft Cloud Engineer - Consultant
jobs.description:
Function purpose

We are seeking a Cloud Engineer specializing in Microsoft 365 and Modern Workplace solutions, with a strong background in leading or supporting on-premises to cloud transformations. In this role, you will drive the migration, implementation, and optimization of cloud-based solutions, ensuring seamless adoption of M365 and modern workplace technologies. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to modernize our IT infrastructure, enhance productivity, and improve security.

Key Responsibilities

Cloud Transformation and Migration

• Lead or contribute to on-premises to cloud migration projects, including email, collaboration tools, identity management, and endpoint management.

• Plan, execute, and validate migrations from on-premises Exchange, SharePoint, and Active Directory to Microsoft 365 and Azure AD.

• Assess and mitigate risks during migration, ensuring minimal disruption to business operations.

M365 Administration and Optimization

• Administer and optimize Microsoft 365 services, including Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, Teams, and Power Platform and others SaaS services.

• Configure and manage Azure Active Directory (Azure AD), including identity and access management (IAM), conditional access policies, and multi-factor authentication (MFA).

• Automate workflows and processes using PowerShell, Power Automate.

Modern Workplace Solutions

• Deploy and manage modern workplace solutions, including Windows 10/11, Intune, Autopilot, Microsoft Endpoint Manager and Workspace One.

• Implement and support internal and external collaboration tools like Microsoft Teams and SharePoint Online.

• Ensure compliance with security and governance policies for endpoints and cloud services with Purview, Intune.

Security and Compliance

• Monitor and enforce security best practices for M365 and cloud environments.

• Conduct regular audits and implement security controls to protect data and user identities.

• Collaborate with the security team to mitigate risks and respond to incidents.

User Support and Training

• Provide technical support and troubleshooting for M365 and modern workplace issues.

• Develop and deliver training programs to promote user adoption and best practices.

• Create documentation for processes, configurations, and user guides.

Collaboration and Innovation

• Work with stakeholders to identify opportunities for improving productivity and collaboration.

• Evaluate and recommend new M365 features and third-party integrations.

• Stay updated on industry trends and actor’s roadmap for cloud and workplace technologies.

Qualifications and Skills

• 3+ years of experience in administering and supporting Microsoft 365 and modern workplace technologies.

• Proven experience in leading or contributing to on-premises to cloud migration projects (e.g., Exchange to Exchange Online, SharePoint on-prem to SharePoint Online, AD to Azure AD, on-prem to on cloud configuration management with Intune).

• Strong knowledge of Azure AD, Intune, Exchange Online, SharePoint, Teams, and Power automate.

• Experience with PowerShell scripting for automation and administration.

• Familiarity with Windows 10/11 deployment, management, and security.

• Understanding of security best practices (CIS Framework) and identity protection, data governance and compliance (e.g., GDPR, ISO 27001).

• Excellent problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.

Preferred

• Microsoft certifications

• Experience with Microsoft Defender for Office 365, Purview, and Sentinel.

• Knowledge of hybrid cloud environments (Azure, on-premises AD, and M365 integration).

Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives

• Resta aggiornato sulle tendenze del settore e sulla roadmap dell’attore per le tecnologie cloud e sul posto di lavoro. Qualifiche e competenze
• 3+ anni di esperienza nell'amministrazione e nel supporto di Microsoft 365 e moderne tecnologie di lavoro.
• Provata esperienza nel portare o contribuire a on-premises a progetti di migrazione cloud (ad esempio, Exchange to Exchange Online, SharePoint on-prem to SharePoint Online, AD to Azure AD, on-prem to on-prem on-prem on-prem to su cloud di configurazione management con Intune).
• Forte conoscenza di Azure AD, Intune, Exchange Online, SharePoint, Teams e Power automatizzare.
• Esperienza con lo scripting PowerShell per l'automazione e l'amministrazione.
• Familiarità con Windows 10/11 distribuzione, gestione e sicurezza.
• Comprensione delle best practice di sicurezza (CIS Framework) e protezione dell'identità, governance dei dati e conformità (ad esempio, GDPR, ISO 27001).
• Eccellente capacità di problem solving, comunicazione e collaborazione. Preferito
• Certificazioni Microsoft
• Esperienza con Microsoft Defender per Office 365, Purview e Sentinel.
• Conoscenza degli ambienti cloud ibridi (Azure, on-premises AD e integrazione M365). Competenze fondamentali: Aderenza ai valori dell’azienda: Dedicazione, Convizione, Agility e Responsabilità - Rispetto dei regolamenti e delle direttive interne

jobs.title: Operations Transformation manager

titleByLocale.fr: Gestionnaire de la transformation des opérations

jobs.description:
Drive the next wave of operational excellence by leveraging data, digital, and AI to streamline processes, reduce risk, and deliver measurable impact across Operations :

• Mission
 Join the Operations team to review and streamline end‑to‑end processes, gaining efficiency, service quality, and control.
 Working closely with Operations, Management, and IT, you will identify opportunities into tangible outcomes leveraging AI and automation where they create clear value while ensuring governance and compliance in a regulated environment.

• Main responsibilities

• Identify and prioritize AI/automation use cases in Operations to reduce inefficiencies, bottlenecks, operational risk

• Partner with Data/IT to translate business problems into AI solutions, define data requirements, and ensure model governance and traceability.

• Coordinate AI delivery lifecycle: data sourcing, feature engineering, model training/validation, UAT, deployment, and monitoring

• Conduct comprehensive reviews of existing operational processes and workflows across the department

• Facilitate workshops and interviews with stakeholders to gather requirements and understand operational challenges

• Design and implement process improvements to enhance efficiency, service quality and operational control

• Define and monitor key performance indicators (KPI to measure process effectiveness and improvements outcomes

• Support change management activities and ensure successful adoption of new processes and operating models

• Ensure that proposed changes comply with regulatory framework, internal policies and risk management

• Document processes, procedures and target operating models

• Your Profile
• Master’s degree in finance or Information Technology/Minimum 10 years of experience in Banking Operations

• Hands-on experience partnering with Data/IT on AI or advanced automation initiatives in an Operations context

• Proven experience in process review, process re-engineering or continuous improvement initiatives

• Strong communication and stakeholders management skills across all organisational levels

• Experience with Lean, Six Sigma; Business Process Management or similar methodologies is a strong advantage

• Fluent in French and English; any other language would be a plus

• Strong critical thinking, analytical and problem-solving skills

• Others
• Swiss Residence

Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives

descriptionByLocale.it:

• Missione
Unisciti al team Operazioni per rivedere e ottimizzare i processi end-to-end, ottenendo efficienza, qualità del servizio e controllo.
Lavorando a stretto contatto con le operazioni, la gestione e l'IT, identificherete le opportunità in risultati tangibili sfruttando l'IA e l'automazione in cui creano un valore chiaro, garantendo al contempo la governance e la conformità in un ambiente regolamentato.

• Identificare e dare priorità ai casi di utilizzo di AI/automazione nelle operazioni per ridurre inefficienze, strozzature, rischio operativo

• Condurre valutazioni complete dei processi operativi e dei flussi di lavoro esistenti in tutto il dipartimento

• Progettare e implementare miglioramenti di processo per migliorare l'efficienza, la qualità dei servizi e il controllo operativo

• Definire e monitorare gli indicatori chiave delle prestazioni (KPI per misurare l'efficacia del processo e migliorare i risultati

• Sostenere le attività di gestione dei cambiamenti e garantire l'adozione di nuovi processi e modelli operativi

• Assicurarsi che le modifiche proposte siano conformi al quadro normativo, alle politiche interne e alla gestione dei rischi

• Processi, procedure e modelli operativi target

• Il tuo profilo
• Laurea magistrale in finanza o Information Technology/Minimum 10 anni di esperienza nelle operazioni bancarie

• Esperienza comprovata nel processo di revisione, riingegneria dei processi o iniziative di miglioramento continuo

• Forte capacità di comunicazione e gestione degli stakeholder in tutti i livelli organizzativi

• Esperienza con Lean, Six Sigma; Business Process Management o metodologie simili è un forte vantaggio

• Fluente in francese e inglese; qualsiasi altra lingua sarebbe un plus

• Forte pensiero critico, abilità analitiche e problem solving

• Residenza svizzera

jobs.title: Microsoft Cloud & Digital Workplace Architect
jobs.description:
• Mission
 Function purpose: The Microsoft Cloud & Digital Workplace Architect is responsible for defining, designing, and leading the implementation of enterprise cloud and workplace solutions across Microsoft Azure and Microsoft 365. This strategic and technical leadership role combines Cloud Architecture, Modern Workplace, Security, Identity, Collaboration, and Infrastructure expertise to deliver secure, scalable, resilient, and user-centric digital services.
The Architect leads the cloud committee which represent an authority of approval for new cloud service adoption and deployment within the group

• Main responsibilities

Cloud Strategy & Architecture
• Define and maintain the enterprise Microsoft Cloud strategy and roadmap.
• Design secure, scalable, highly available, and cost-effective cloud architectures.
• Ensure cloud solutions align with business objectives, security requirements, and compliance standards.
• Establish Azure Landing Zones and cloud governance models.
 Digital Workplace Architecture
• Define the Digital Workplace vision and architecture.
• Design collaboration and productivity platforms using Microsoft 365.
• Lead workplace transformation initiatives supporting hybrid and remote work.
• Improve employee productivity and digital experience through innovative workplace services.
 Identity, Security & Compliance
• Architect enterprise identity and access management using Microsoft Entra ID.
• Define and implement Zero Trust security principles.
• Design Conditional Access, Identity Governance, MFA, and Privileged Access Management.
• Establish security controls mastering: Microsoft Defender Suite, Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Purview, Data Loss Prevention (DLP), Information Protection.
 Ensure compliance with industry regulations and corporate policies.
 Endpoint & Device Management
• Define modern endpoint management strategy.
• Lead Microsoft Intune initiative.
• Implement: Windows Autopilot, Mobile Device Management (MDM), Mobile Application Management (MAM), Endpoint Security, Device Compliance Policies
 Technical Leadership
• Act as the senior technical authority for Cloud and Workplace technologies.
• Lead architecture review boards and technical governance committees.
• Define engineering standards and best practices.
• Serve as escalation point for critical technical issues.

• Your Profile

• Qualifications and Skills
• 10+ years of IT Infrastructure, Cloud, and Workplace Services experience.
• 5+ years designing Azure cloud solutions.
• 5+ years architecting Microsoft 365 enterprise environments.
• Proven leadership of digital transformation and cloud migration programs.
• Experience managing enterprise-scale cloud and workplace platforms.
• Strong background in security, compliance, and identity management.

• Required Technical Skills
• Cloud Technologies: Microsoft Azure, Azure Landing Zones, Azure Networking, AKS, Azure Virtual Desktop, Azure Monitor, Azure Backup & Recovery, Azure Governance, Azure Cost Management.
• Microsoft 365: Microsoft Teams, SharePoint Online, Exchange Online, OneDrive for Business, Microsoft Viva, Microsoft Copilot, Power Platform.
• Security & Identity: Microsoft Entra ID, Conditional Access, Privileged Identity Management (PIM), Microsoft Defender XDR, Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Purview, Zero Trust Architecture
• Endpoint Management: Microsoft Intune, Windows 11, Autopilot, Endpoint Analytics, Mobile Device Management
• Automation & DevOps: PowerShell, Terraform, Azure DevOps, GitHub, Power Automate, Microsoft Graph API

• Preferred Certifications:
• Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305)

• Microsoft 365 Certified: Enterprise Administrator Expert

• Microsoft Certified: Cybersecurity Architect Expert

• Microsoft Certified: Identity and Access Administrator Associate

• Microsoft Certified: DevOps Engineer Expert

• Microsoft Certified: Power Platform Solution Architect Expert.

Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives

• Mission
Function purpose: The Microsoft Cloud & Digital Workplace Architect is responsible for defining, designing, and leading the implementation of enterprise cloud and workplace solutions across Microsoft Azure and Microsoft 365. This strategic and technical leadership role combines Cloud Architecture, Modern Workplace, Security, Identity, Collaboration, and Infrastructure expertise to deliver secure, scalable, resilient, and user-centric digital services.
The Architect leads the cloud committee which represent an authority of approval for new cloud service adoption and deployment within the group

• Establish Azure Landing Zones and cloud governance models.
Digital Workplace Architecture

• Design collaboration and productivity platforms using Microsoft 365.
• Lead workplace transformation initiatives supporting hybrid and remote work.
• Improve employee productivity and digital experience through innovative workplace services.
Identity, Security & Compliance
• Architect enterprise identity and access management using Microsoft Entra ID.

• Design Conditional Access, Identity Governance, MFA, and Privileged Access Management.
• Establish security controls mastering: Microsoft Defender Suite, Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Purview, Data Loss Prevention (DLP), Information Protection.
Ensure compliance with industry regulations and corporate policies.
Endpoint & Device Management

jobs.title: Control-M Batch Engineer - Consultant
jobs.description:
Mission

• Design, maintain and optimize scheduling batch workflows for production and test environment (production, uat, …) for a leading banking environment

• Ensure high availability, performance, compliance, and security of end‑to‑end processing chains supporting payments, treasury, accounting, risk, and regulatory reporting.

• Deal with different projects at the same time liaising with different technical stakeholders

• Industrialize a multi-application billing chain with prerequisites, windows, and alerting.

• Migrate job estate to Control-M Automation API + GitOps workflow.

• Maintain and update Documentation

Key Responsibilities

• Design & Industrialization
• Analyze business/IT needs and model workflows in Control-M (Jobs, Folders, Calendars, Conditions, Resources, Variables).

• Apply scheduling standards (naming, reuse, conventions).

• Automate job deployments via Control-M Application Integrator, CTM/CLI, and Automation API.

• Operations & Monitoring
• Perform daily follow-up of batches, critical jobs, SLAs, and processing windows.

• Handle production incidents (diagnosis, restart/recovery, escalation, RCA).

• Optimize runtimes, parallelism, windows, and capacity.

• Integration & DevOps
• Integrate Control-M with CI/CD (Automation API, CTM/CLI, Jenkins/GitLab CI, artifact repos).

• Package and version Control-M objects (JSON, Git).

• Document pipelines, recovery procedures, and runbooks.

• Security & Compliance
• Comply, operate and leverage the Bank’s security framework and conforming to the published security applications RACI matrix provided to all stakeholders.

• Manage access and roles (Control-M/EM, LDAP/AD).

• Apply security policies (encryption, audit, traceability).

• Contribute to audits, risk management, and continuity planning (DR/BCP).

Technical Environnent

• BMC Control-M : V9.21/9.22 Control-M/EM, Server, Agents, Workload Archiving, Automation API, CTM/CLI, Application Integrator, MFT/MFT-E

• Systems : Linux/Unix, Windows Server; z/OS knowledge a plus.

• Scripting & Languages : Shell/Bash, PowerShell, Python, SQL.

• Databases : PostgreSQL (queries, DB job scheduling).

• Middleware & Cloud : FTP/SFTP, REST/Web Services, MQ; AWS/Azure/GCP integration (Control-M for Cloud, Agents).

• CI/CD & SCM : Git, Jenkins/GitLab CI, JSON artifacts, automated testing/deployments.

• Monitoring : Integration with tools like Dynatrace, Prometheus, Splunk, Centreon.

• Security : LDAP/AD, credential management (e.g., Vault, Control-M Secrets).

Required Skills

• Mastery of Control-M scheduling (design, conditions, calendars, resources, alerting).

• Hands-on with Automation API and CTM/CLI for “jobs as code”.

• Scripting for automation and remediation.

• Understanding of batch application architectures and production constraints.

• Incident and problem management , RCA writing and corrective actions.

• Clear communication with RUN, DEV, and business teams.

Profile

• Bachelor’s/ Master’s in computer science (or equivalent experience).

• 5+ years’ experience with Control-M in production environments.

• BMC Control-M and/or ITIL certifications preferred.

• Fluent French/English required.

Soft Skills

• Rigor, service-oriented mindset, reliability in 24/7 contexts.

jobs.description:
• Mission

• Design, deploy, and maintain Red Hat OpenShift platforms

• Adapt and optimize OpenShift clusters (filesystem management, access control, quotas, policies) on underlying Unix/Linux systems.

• Install, migrate, and operate Unix/Linux environments according to our standards and processes.

• Plan and manage system storage and related capacity (including persistence of OpenShift volumes).

• Ensure security, resilience, and compliance across environments.

• Participate in on-call rotations.
 Challenges

• Adapt to heterogeneous environments (AIX/Solaris/RHEL, virtualization) and existing processes.

• Align Unix/Linux operations practices with container, Kubernetes, and OpenShift paradigms.

• Support application migrations to OpenShift with minimal impact, while meeting financial-sector security requirements.

• Main responsibilities
 General competencies

• Knowledge of major Unix/Linux distributions: IBM AIX, Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL), Solaris.

• Proven experience deploying and operating OpenShift or Kubernetes in production.

• Understanding of storage and network technologies: memory, disk arrays, NAS/SAN, networking (TCP/IP, VLAN, load balancing).

• Understanding of database concepts: maintenance, recovery, failover, high availability.

• Understanding of routine maintenance, recovery, and handling failover of a Database

• Familiarity with at least one enterprise backup solution (e.g., NetBackup, Commvault, Veeam).
 Specific competencies

• Install, configure, and maintain Red Hat OpenShift clusters (IPI/UPI, bare metal/virtualized/cloud).

• Mastery of Kubernetes/OpenShift concepts: projects, routes, services, deployments, statefulsets, operators, CRD, RBAC, SCC, NetworkPolicy.

• OpenShift lifecycle management: controlled upgrades, patches, channels, image mirroring, oc CLI.

• Security and compliance:

• Configuration of RBAC, SCC, PSa/PSP equivalents, secrets, encryption.

• OIDC/SAML integration with IdPs (e.g., Keycloak, Azure AD).

• Policies and admission control (Gatekeeper/OPA), auditing, hardening.

• OpenShift networking:

• CNI (OpenShiftSDN/OVNK), ingress/egress, routes, load balancers, service mesh (Istio/Service Mesh).

• Storage and persistence:

• Provisioning PersistentVolume/PersistentVolumeClaim, StorageClasses, CSI drivers, NAS/SAN integration (NFS, Ceph, …).

• Observability:

• Logging and metrics (Cluster Logging, Loki/EFK, Prometheus/Grafana), alerting, SIEM integration.

• CI/CD and images:

• BuildConfigs/ImageStreams, registry management (Quay/Artifactory), image policies.

• Operations and SRE:

• Cluster and application backup/restore (Velero, etcd backup).

• Capacity planning, autoscaling (HPA/VPA/Cluster Autoscaler), performance tuning.

• Troubleshooting: pods, nodes, networking, storage, scheduling.

Primary Responsibilities

• Install and configure OpenShift components and RHEL and Unix OSes to host workloads.

• Deploy, maintain, and upgrade OpenShift clusters and their operators.

• Apply and test OS and platform patches; manage compliance and hardening.

• Develop and implement security and management procedures (OS and OpenShift).

• Update standard policies based on environmental changes and audit findings.

• Improve system and cluster performance; propose optimization initiatives.

• Identify, diagnose, and resolve system and platform incidents (L2/L3).

• Plan, coordinate, and execute installation, testing, and maintenance of system software and OpenShift components.

• Lead projects within approved timelines, including migrations to OpenShift and workload rationalization.

• Analyze software and hardware environments to detect defects and risks; propose remediations.

• Maintain up-to-date documentation: architecture, operator procedures, component inventory, runbooks.

• Implement backup and recovery strategies (OS, etcd, applications) and validate their effectiveness.

• Implement and test disaster recovery and business continuity (DR/BCP) procedures for OS and OpenShift.

• Perform performance maintenance routines to ensure continuous availability.

• Your Profile

• Years of experience: 3–7.

• Financial sector: preferred.

• Required experience:

• Minimum 3 years as Unix/Linux systems administrator.

• Required knowledge:

• OS: RHEL, OpenShift.

• Storage, memory, disk arrays, NAS/SAN, networking (DNS, TLS, firewalling)

• Others
• Swiss Residence

Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives

• Knowledge of major Unix/Linux distributions: IBM AIX, Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL), Solaris.

• Proven experience deploying and operating OpenShift or Kubernetes in production.

• Understanding of storage and network technologies: memory, disk arrays, NAS/SAN, networking (TCP/IP, VLAN, load balancing).

• Familiarity with at least one enterprise backup solution (e.g., NetBackup, Commvault, Veeam).

• Install, configure, and maintain Red Hat OpenShift clusters (IPI/UPI, bare metal/virtualized/cloud).

jobs.description:
Mission :
As a QA Engineer, you will ensure the quality, reliability, and security of our private banking e-banking platforms. You will design and execute comprehensive test strategies across web and mobile channels, drive operational excellence in manual and automated testing, and ensure full alignment with regulatory and data privacy requirements.

Key Responsibilities :

• Strategy & Planning
• Design and implement risk-based test strategies aligned to project timelines, scope, and regulatory constraints.

• Define and maintain test plans covering functional, integration, system, performance, and regression testing.

• Test Execution (Manual & Automated)
• Execute test cases and end-to-end scenarios across web and mobile e-banking journeys (onboarding, payments, trading, client communications, alerts).

• Operate and execute existing automation packs

• Exposure to automated testing tools or frameworks like Selenium, Playwright is a plus, CI pipelines, and test management tools (JIRA X-Ray)

• Analyze logs and results to triage failures.

• Validate back-end behavior via SQL queries, API validations, and log analysis.

• Quality Governance & Reporting
• Enforce QA standards, test traceability, and documentation across the SDLC.

• Use JIRA and Xray for test management, traceability, defect lifecycle, and coverage reporting.

• Provide concise QA dashboards and KPIs to QA Lead, Release Management, and Project Management.

• Defect & Risk Management
• Log, prioritize, and track defects; facilitate triage with Development, DevOps, and Business.

• Ensure clean entry/exit criteria by release; contribute to go/no-go decisions.

• UAT & Stakeholder Collaboration
• Co-define UAT strategy with business stakeholders, document acceptance criteria and success metrics.

• Support UAT execution, defect triage, and sign-off readiness.

• Continuous Improvement
• Drive process improvements in test design, data management, and automation reliability; contribute to playbooks and reusable assets.

Required Technical Proficiency :

• Test Operations
• Strong experience executing manual and automated tests across web and mobile in an Agile environment.

• Hands-on with test management using JIRA and Xray (test plans, executions, traceability to requirements and defects).

• Basic understanding of version control workflows (Git) for fetching branches and running tagged suites.

• Data & API Validation
• Proficient in SQL for data validation, reconciliation, and back-end testing.

• Experience validating REST APIs (e.g., Postman, Swagger, etc..) and reviewing application logs.

• Tooling
• Defect tracking and reporting using JIRA; test design and execution in Xray is essential.

• Analytics/reporting on test KPIs and coverage using Xray/JIRA dashboards or BI tools.

Preferred Skills :

• Financial Services
• 5+ years in banking, ideally Private Banking/Wealth Management; solid grasp of payments, trading flows, client onboarding/KYC, and portfolio reporting.

• Technical
• Exposure to automation tools (e.g., Selenium) and familiarity with languages like Java or Python is preferred for reading test code and interpreting failures.

• Experience with mobile testing (e.g., Appium) and cross-browser/device testing.

• Process
• Experience defining UAT strategies, test data management, and environment orchestration.

Soft Skills :

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a detail-oriented, risk-aware mindset.

• Clear, concise communicator; able to translate complex technical findings for business stakeholders.

• Collaborative, proactive, and comfortable facilitating cross-team triage.

• Adaptable, with a continuous learning mindset and ownership of quality outcomes.

Languages :

• Proficiency in French and English required; German is a plus.

Education :

• Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, or related field (or equivalent experience).

Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives

Potrai progettare ed eseguire strategie di test complete su canali web e mobili, guidare l'eccellenza operativa in test manuali e automatizzati, e garantire l'allineamento completo con le normative e i requisiti di privacy dei dati.

• Principali responsabilità

• Strategia e pianificazione
• Progettare e implementare strategie di test basate sui rischi allineate a tempi di progetto, portata e vincoli normativi.

• Definire e mantenere i piani di prova che coprono test funzionali, integrazione, sistema, prestazioni e regressione.

• Eseguire casi di test e scenari end-to-end attraverso viaggi web e mobile e-banking (a bordo, pagamenti, trading, comunicazioni client, avvisi).

• Operare ed eseguire i pacchetti di automazione esistenti

• Esposizione a strumenti di prova automatizzati o quadri come Selenium, Playwright è un plus, CI pipelines e strumenti di gestione dei test (JIRA X-Ray)

• Analizzare i log e i risultati dei guasti di triage.

• Convalida il comportamento di back-end tramite query SQL, convalida API e analisi di log.

• Gestione della Qualità & Reporting
• Applicare gli standard QA, la tracciabilità dei test e la documentazione sullo SDLC.

• Utilizzare JIRA e Xray per la gestione dei test, tracciabilità, ciclo di vita difettoso e report di copertura.

• Fornire dashboard QA concisi e KPI a QA Lead, Gestione dei comunicati e Project Management.

• Gestione dei difetti e dei rischi
• Log, priorità e tracciare i difetti; facilitare il triage con lo sviluppo, DevOps e Business.

• Assicurare criteri di entrata/uscita puliti per rilascio; contribuire a decisioni di go/no-go.

• UAT & Stakeholder Collaborazione
• Codefinire la strategia UAT con gli stakeholder aziendali, i criteri di accettazione dei documenti e le metriche di successo.

• Supporta l'esecuzione UAT, il triage difettoso e la prontezza di segnale.

• Miglioramento continuo

• Miglioramento del processo di guida nella progettazione di test, nella gestione dei dati e nell'affidabilità dell'automazione; contribuire ai playbook e alle attività riutilizzabili.

• Competenza tecnica richiesta

• Operazioni di test
• Forte esperienza eseguendo test manuali e automatizzati su web e mobile in un ambiente Agile.

• Hands-on con gestione dei test utilizzando JIRA e Xray (progetti di prova, esecuzioni, tracciabilità a requisiti e difetti).

• Comprensione di base dei flussi di lavoro di controllo della versione (Git) per l'acquisizione di rami e l'esecuzione di suite etichettate.

• Convalida dati e API
• Proficiente in SQL per la convalida dei dati, la riconciliazione e il test back-end.

• Esperienza validazione delle API REST (ad esempio, Postman, Swagger, ecc.) e revisione dei registri delle applicazioni.

• Strumenti

• Difetti di tracciamento e reporting utilizzando JIRA; la progettazione e l'esecuzione di test in Xray è essenziale.

• Analisi/reporting sui KPI di prova e copertura utilizzando dashboard Xray/JIRA o strumenti BI.

• Competenze consigliate

• Servizi finanziari
• 5+ anni nel settore bancario, idealmente Private Banking/Wealth Management; solida comprensione dei pagamenti, flussi di trading, client onboarding/KYC, e reporting portafoglio.

• Tecnica
• L'esposizione agli strumenti di automazione (ad esempio, Selenium) e la familiarità con linguaggi come Java o Python è preferita per la lettura del codice di prova e l'interpretazione dei guasti.

• Esperienza con test mobili (ad esempio, Appium) e test cross-browser/device.

• Processo
• Esperienza nella definizione di strategie UAT, gestione dei dati di prova e orchestrazione dell'ambiente.

• Abilità morbide

• Forte capacità analitiche e problem solving con una mentalità orientata al dettaglio, con attenzione al rischio.

• comunicatore chiaro e conciso; in grado di tradurre complessi risultati tecnici per gli stakeholder aziendali.

• Triage collaborativo, proattivo e confortevole facilitando il cross-team.

• Adattabile, con una mentalità di apprendimento continuo e la proprietà dei risultati di qualità.

• Lingue

• La competenza in francese e inglese richiesto; il tedesco è un plus.

• Istruzione

• Corso di laurea in informatica, sistemi informativi, o relativo campo (o esperienza equivalente).

Competenze fondamentali: Aderenza ai valori dell’azienda: Dedicazione, Convizione, Agility e Responsabilità - Rispetto dei regolamenti e delle direttive interne

Sie entwerfen und führen umfassende Teststrategien über Web- und Mobilkanäle aus, fördern operative Exzellenz bei manuellen und automatisierten Tests und stellen eine vollständige Abstimmung mit regulatorischen und Datenschutzanforderungen sicher.

• Hauptzuständigkeiten

• Strategie & Planung
• Entwerfen und implementieren Sie risikobasierte Teststrategien, die auf Projektzeitpläne, -umfang und regulatorische Einschränkungen ausgerichtet sind.

• Definieren und pflegen Sie Testpläne für Funktions-, Integrations-, System-, Leistungs- und Regressionstests.

• Testausführung (manuell und automatisiert)
• Führen Sie Testfälle und End-to-End-Szenarien über Web- und mobile E-Banking-Reisen aus (Onboarding, Zahlungen, Handel, Kundenkommunikation, Warnungen).

• Betreiben und Ausführen vorhandener Automatisierungspakete

• Exposition gegenüber automatisierten Test-Tools oder Frameworks wie Selenium, Playwright ist ein Plus, CI-Pipelines und Testmanagement-Tools (JIRA X-Ray)

• Analysieren Sie Protokolle und Ergebnisse auf Triage-Ausfälle.

• Validieren Sie das Backend-Verhalten über SQL-Abfragen, API-Validierungen und Protokollanalysen.

• Quality Governance & Reporting
• Erzwingen Sie QA-Standards, Testrückverfolgbarkeit und Dokumentation im gesamten SDLC.

• Verwenden Sie JIRA und Xray für Testmanagement, Rückverfolgbarkeit, Defektlebenszyklus und Coverage Reporting.

• Stellen Sie prägnante QA-Dashboards und KPIs für QA Lead, Release Management und Projektmanagement bereit.

• Fehler & Risikomanagement
• Fehler protokollieren, priorisieren und verfolgen; Triage mit Development, DevOps und Business erleichtern.

• Stellen Sie saubere Ein- / Ausreisekriterien durch Freigabe sicher; tragen Sie zu Go / No-Go-Entscheidungen bei.

• UAT & Stakeholder Zusammenarbeit
• Definieren Sie die UAT-Strategie mit den Geschäftsbeteiligten, Dokumentakzeptanzkriterien und Erfolgsmetriken.

• Unterstützen Sie UAT-Ausführung, Defekttriage und Abmeldebereitschaft.

• Kontinuierliche Verbesserung

• Prozessverbesserungen in Testdesign, Datenmanagement und Automatisierungszuverlässigkeit; Beitrag zu Playbooks und wiederverwendbaren Assets.

• Erforderliche technische Kompetenz

• Prüfung
• Starke Erfahrung mit der Durchführung manueller und automatisierter Tests im Web und Mobile in einer agilen Umgebung.

• Hands-on mit Testmanagement mit JIRA und Xray (Testpläne, Ausführung, Rückverfolgbarkeit auf Anforderungen und Defekte).

• Grundlegendes Verständnis von Versionskontroll-Workflows (Git) zum Abrufen von Branchs und zum Ausführen markierter Suiten.

• Daten- und API-Validierung
• Proficient in SQL für Datenvalidierung, Abgleich und Back-End-Tests.

• Erleben Sie die Validierung von REST-APIs (z. B. Postman, Swagger usw.) und die Überprüfung von Anwendungsprotokollen.

• Werkzeuge

• Fehlerverfolgung und -berichterstattung mit JIRA; Testdesign und -ausführung in Xray ist unerlässlich.

• Analytics/Reporting zu Test-KPIs und Coverage mit Xray/JIRA-Dashboards oder BI-Tools.

• Bevorzugte Fähigkeiten

• Finanzdienstleistungen
• 5+ Jahre im Bankwesen, idealerweise Private Banking / Wealth Management; solides Verständnis von Zahlungen, Handelsströmen, Kunden-Onboarding / KYC und Portfolio-Reporting.

• Technische
• Die Exposition gegenüber Automatisierungstools (z. B. Selenium) und die Vertrautheit mit Sprachen wie Java oder Python werden bevorzugt, um Testcode zu lesen und Fehler zu interpretieren.

• Erfahrung mit mobilen Tests (z. B. Appium) und Cross-Browser- / Gerätetests.

• Prozess
• Erfahrung in der Definition von UAT-Strategien, Testdatenmanagement und Umgebungsorchestrierung.

• Soft Skills

• Starke analytische und problemlösende Fähigkeiten mit einer detailorientierten, risikobewussten Denkweise.

• Klarer, prägnanter Kommunikator; in der Lage, komplexe technische Erkenntnisse für Geschäftsbeteiligte zu übersetzen.

• Kollaborativ, proaktiv und komfortabel erleichtern Cross-Team-Triage.

• Anpassbar, mit einer kontinuierlichen Lernmentalität und dem Besitz von Qualitätsergebnissen.

• Sprachen

• Kenntnisse in Französisch und Englisch erforderlich; Deutsch ist ein Plus.

• Bildung

• Bachelor-Abschluss in Informatik, Informationssysteme oder verwandten Bereich (oder gleichwertige Erfahrung).

Kernkompetenzen : Einhaltung der Werte des Unternehmens: Hingabe, Überzeugung, Agilität und Verantwortung - Einhaltung von Vorschriften und internen Richtlinien
