jobs.title: Entreprise Functional Architect - Consultant
jobs.description:
Mission
 We are looking for a Senior Enterprise Functional Architect to join our Enterprise Architecture team. You will play a key role in structuring the bank's data, processes and information flows, ensuring consistency, quality and control across a highly regulated environment supporting wealth management, compliance and reporting.
 What you will do

• Define and validate the bank's enterprise data requirements and their end-to-end lifecycle, from transactional to analytical systems, based on business process analysis.

• Design and maintain a federation of enterprise data models serving as the reference for in-house development and data flows.

• Define golden sources for each business concept and validate the design of data flows.

• Build and maintain functional maps of the information system.

• Allocate functional capabilities across the organisation and applications, working closely with business analysts and solution architects.

• Support actively the governance of the bank's critical data, in line with FINMA Circular 2023/1.

• Define enterprise architecture standards and support their adoption across project and IT teams.
 What you bring

• Senior-level experience in enterprise architecture, ideally gained within a private bank or wealth management institution.

• Strong command of enterprise data modelling and data governance principles.

• Good understanding of Swiss regulatory requirements for banking data, including FINMA Circular 2023/1 on critical data management.

• Experience with functional mapping and business process modelling (BPMN or equivalent).

• Proven ability to collaborate across business, business analysis, solution architecture and IT teams.

• Exposure to modern data architectures (data lake, data warehouse, analytics platforms).

• Understanding of data quality and Master Data Management (MDM) principles.

• Knowledge of wealth management business processes (client onboarding, portfolio management, compliance, reporting).

• Excellent communication skills in French and English.
 Required certifications

• CDMP (Certified Data Management Professional) — Practitioner level (Level 2).

• TOGAF certified (or equivalent enterprise architecture certification).

• Capacità comprovata di collaborare tra business, analisi aziendale, architettura delle soluzioni e team IT.

Certificazioni richieste

• CDMP (Certified Data Management Professional) — livello Practitioner (Level 2).

• Certificato TOGAF (o certificazione di architettura aziendale equivalente).

jobs.description:
• Role Summary

• We are seeking an experienced IT Tooling / DevOps Specialist to improve the IT tooling platform that support the organization’s Software Development Life Cycle — SDLC.

• The role sits within a team of 13 people in charge of the administration, maintenance, support, and evolution of more than 15 DevOps and SDLC tools among which Git, Ansible Automation Platform, Azure DevOps, Artifactory,…

• The team is organized around four main streams:

• DevOps onboarding of application and infrastructure teams

• IT tooling platform enhancements / optimization / maintenance

• DevOps governance definition

• User support

• While contributing to platform maintenance and user support activities, the primary focus of this role will be the platform enhancements, optimization, automation, standardization, and continuous improvement across the IT tooling landscape.

• Key Responsibilities

• Propose and implement enhancements to existing tools such as Git, Azure DevOps, Ansible Automation Platform, Artifactory,…

• Assess new features, plugins, integrations, and automation opportunities to improve developer experience and operational efficiency

• Define and maintain platform configuration standards, usage guidelines, governance models, and best practices

• Contribute to the onboarding and the support of users

• Identify opportunities to improve platform performance, reliability, scalability, usability, security, and cost efficiency

• Partner with architecture, cybersecurity, infrastructure, and application teams to ensure tooling platforms remain aligned with enterprise standards and technology strategy

• Contribute to the definition and execution of the IT tooling roadmap.

• Required Qualifications

• 5+ years of hands-on DevOps tools experience , especially with Azure DevOps Jira, Ansible Automated Platform and Git

• Strong experience designing and implementing DevOps solutions

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to design solutions where no standard pattern exists

• Technical Skills

• Tools: GIT, Azure DevOps Server, Docker, SonarQube, Artifactory, Ansible Automated Platform, AppDynamics, JIRA, OpenShift, confluence

• Languages: python , PowerShell, ksh, groovy, Ansible Experience in continuous integration and continuous delivery, scripting for tasks automation.

• Soft Skills

• Ability to prioritize competing demands across operations, support, onboarding, and enhancement activities

• Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to work across IT, development, security, infrastructure, and business teams

• Ability to translate user needs and operational pain points into actionable platform improvements

• Strong documentation, communication, and presentation skills

jobs.title: Fees specialist
jobs.description:
• Mission
 Integrated within UBP’s Operations department, the Fees team manages the day to day application and collection of fees from clients’ accounts and market counterparties group wise. The team has an interdisciplinary role in a fast-paced environment : it supports the Front Office for fees queries and works in close collaboration with the other departments of the Asset and Wealth management divisions of UBP.

• Main responsibilities

Its main missions are as follows:

• Create, amend and maintain the base fees schedules group wise.

• Set-up, amend and manage the clients’ fees exceptions.

• Set-up, amend and manage the brokers and other internal counterparties fees exceptions.

• Perform appropriate follow-up on outstanding fee setups or requests.

• Daily support to internal clients, including but not limited to Front Office, WM Business leads, Finance and other teams within the Operations department.

• Prepare and manage the quarterly fees billing, follow-up on quarterly billing tasks, including manual billing exceptions.

• Actively take part in the bank’s repricing initiatives, support WM leads on fees opportunities.

• Actively take part in other projects impacting the Fees team.

• Core competencies

The successful candidate will possess the following skills:

• Analytical and problem solving skills: be at ease with numbers and larger datasets. Be able to think in “problem-action-results” terms.

• Flexibility: Be proactive and driven. Be able to adjust to urgent requests or shifting priorities, maange time effectively. Adjust decision-making in light of unforeseen circumstances.

• Client service ethic: Professional conduct with strong focus on client service, build lasting relationships with other departments of the group.

• Risk management : Review existing control framework to identify procedural loopholes or enhancement opportunities. Be able to raise concerns and propose mitigations or enhancement solutions. Be able to support audit requests, in coordination with the team’s supervisor or manager.

• Team spirit : Proactively help others and work for a common goal. Be open to others’ ideas, express opinion in a constructive way.

• Your Profile

• French and English speaking mandatory. Other languages is a plus.

• Preferrably knowledgeable in market finance : understands the various financial instruments, the trading and reconciliation flows as well as the custody chain.

• Proficient with Microsoft Office pack, specifically Microsoft Excel. Other VBA/Python/R skills is a plus.

• Others
• Swiss Residence

Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives

Integrato all'interno del dipartimento Operazioni UBP, il team di Fees gestisce l'applicazione giorno per giorno e la raccolta di tasse da account clienti e controparti di mercato gruppo saggi. Il team ha un ruolo interdisciplinare in un ambiente frenetico: supporta il Front Office per le richieste di tasse e lavora in stretta collaborazione con gli altri dipartimenti delle divisioni di gestione Asset e Wealth di UBP.

Le sue principali missioni sono le seguenti:

• Creare, modificare e mantenere le spese di base programma gruppo saggio.

• Impostare, modificare e gestire le tasse dei clienti eccezioni.

• Impostare, modificare e gestire i broker e altre controparti interne tasse eccezioni.

• Eseguire il follow-up appropriato su impostazioni o richieste di pagamento eccezionali.

• Supporto giornaliero a clienti interni, inclusi ma non limitati a Front Office, WM Business, Finanza e altre squadre all'interno del reparto Operazioni.

• Preparare e gestire le commissioni trimestrali fatturazione, follow-up sulle attività di fatturazione trimestrale, comprese le eccezioni di fatturazione manuale.

• Partecipa attivamente alle iniziative di riformulazione della banca, supporto WM conduce alle opportunità di commissioni.

• Partecipa attivamente ad altri progetti che influenzano il team Fees.

• Servizio clienti etico: condotta professionale con forte attenzione al servizio clienti, costruire relazioni durature con altri dipartimenti del gruppo.

• Spirito di squadra: Proattivamente aiutare gli altri e lavorare per un obiettivo comune. Sii aperto alle idee altrui, esprimere l’opinione in modo costruttivo.

• Francese e inglese che parlano obbligatorio. Altre lingue sono un plus.

• Preferibilmente conoscibile nella finanza di mercato: comprende i vari strumenti finanziari, i flussi di negoziazione e riconciliazione e la catena di custodia.

• Proficiente con Microsoft Office pack, in particolare Microsoft Excel. Altre abilità VBA/Python/R sono un plus.

• Residenza svizzera

jobs.description:
• Mission
 At UBP, you will join the CLM (Client Lifecycle Management) team to operate, stabilize, and enhance Appway workflows (onboarding, KYC reviews, remediations). The role is primarily focused on Level 2/Level 3 support and run activities (80%), with a development/engineering component (20%) for fixes, minor enhancements, and industrialization.
 The mission is to ensure the availability, performance, and compliance of Appway CLM solutions while delivering targeted improvements and securing multi-environment deployments.

• Main responsibilities

Support & Run (80%)

• Provide L2/L3 application support: triage, diagnosis, incident/problem resolution, and coordination with the vendor/integrators.

• Monitor workflow health: SLAs, queues, jobs, logs; set up and maintain dashboards and alerts.

• Conduct root cause analyses (RCA) and define/implement preventive and corrective actions.

• Manage releases and package promotion (CAB, validations, smoke tests, rollback plans).

• Document operating procedures, runbooks, a Known Error Database, and user guides.

• Participate in on-call/extended hours as scheduled; ensure incident communications (IT/Business) and reporting.

• Optimize stability and performance: housekeeping, capacity management, tuning, error handling, and resilience.

• Ensure operational compliance (traceability, auditability, data protection, banking secrecy).

Development & Engineering (20%)

• Design and deliver fixes and minor enhancements on Appway (FNZ Studio): business rules, UI, connectors, mappings.

• Integrate/invoke REST/SOAP services, manage JSON/XML schemas and data transformation.

• Contribute to industrialization: CI/CD scripts/pipelines, packaging, recurring automations.

• Perform unit/integration testing, code reviews, and produce technical documentation (light HLD/LLD).

• Advise on CLM process design and Appway implementation best practices.
 Governance & Collaboration

• Work closely with business and development teams.

• Participate in Agile ceremonies (backlog, planning, reviews, retrospectives) with a strong quality-of-service focus.

• Train and support key users; contribute to adoption and continuous improvement.

• Your Profile
 Technical

• Proven mastery of Appway/FNZ Studio in support/run and packaging/deployment contexts.

• Application integration: REST/SOAP APIs, JSON/XML.

• Observability and SRE: logging, metrics, tracing, alerting; ability to read/interpret Appway logs.

• CI/CD and version control (Git, pipelines), multi-environment management.

• Knowledge of banking ecosystems is a plus: core banking, screening (sanctions/PEP/adverse media), ECM/archiving, IAM/SSO.
 Functional

• Solid banking background (private banking/wealth management preferred).

• Proven experience in CLM/KYC operations: onboarding, periodic reviews, remediations; FATCA/CRS is a plus.

• AML/KYC knowledge: risk scoring, due diligence, evidence, and auditability.

• Ability to translate business incidents into technical hypotheses and action plans.

Soft Skills

• Service-oriented mindset, responsiveness, and clear communication with IT and Business.

• Rigor, autonomy, prioritization, and composure in incident situations.

• Analytical mindset, quality focus, and drive for continuous improvement.

Profile

• 5+ years with Appway/FNZ Studio, with a strong L2/L3 support component in a banking environment.

• Higher education degree in Computer Science or equivalent; Appway/FNZ certifications are a plus.

• Agile practice.

• Languages: fluent English required; French is an asset.

• Others
• Swiss Residence mandatory

Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives

descriptionByLocale.it:
• Missione
A UBP, si unirà al team CLM (Client Lifecycle Management) per operare, stabilizzare e migliorare i flussi di lavoro Appway (a bordo, recensioni KYC, remediazioni). Il ruolo è incentrato principalmente sulle attività di supporto e di esecuzione del Livello 2/Level 3 (80%), con un componente di sviluppo/ingegneria (20%) per correzioni, miglioramenti minori e industrializzazione.
La missione è garantire la disponibilità, le prestazioni e la conformità delle soluzioni CLM Appway, offrendo al contempo miglioramenti mirati e garantendo implementazioni multi-ambiente.

• Principali responsabilità

Supporto e corsa (80%)

• Fornire supporto all'applicazione L2/L3: triage, diagnosi, risoluzione incidente/problema e coordinamento con il fornitore/integratore.

• Monitorare la salute del flusso di lavoro: SLA, code, lavori, registri; configurare e mantenere dashboard e avvisi.

• Condurre analisi causa radice (RCA) e definire / implementare azioni preventive e correttive.

• Gestisci i comunicati e la promozione dei pacchetti (CAB, validazioni, test di fumo, piani di rollback).

• Procedura di funzionamento del documento, cartelle di funzionamento, un database di errore noto e guide dell'utente.

• Partecipa alle ore di accesso/orario prolungato come previsto; assicura le comunicazioni incidente (IT/Business) e la segnalazione.

• Ottimizzare la stabilità e le prestazioni: pulizia, gestione della capacità, sintonizzazione, gestione degli errori e resilienza.

• Assicurare la conformità operativa (tracciabilità, verificabilità, protezione dei dati, segreto bancario).

Sviluppo e Ingegneria (20%)

• Progettare e fornire correzioni e miglioramenti minori su Appway (FNZ Studio): regole aziendali, UI, connettori, mappature.

• Integrare/invocare i servizi REST/SOAP, gestire gli schemi JSON/XML e la trasformazione dei dati.

• Contribuire all'industrializzazione: CI/CD scripts/pipelines, packaging, automazione ricorrenti.

• Eseguire test unità / integrazione, recensioni di codice e produrre documentazione tecnica (leggero HLD/LLD).

• Consigliare la progettazione di processo CLM e le migliori pratiche di implementazione di Appway.
Governance e collaborazione

• Lavorare a stretto contatto con i team aziendali e di sviluppo.

• Partecipa a cerimonie Agile (backlog, pianificazione, recensioni, retrospettive) con un forte focus di qualità del servizio.

• Formare e supportare gli utenti chiave; contribuire all'adozione e al miglioramento continuo.

• Il tuo profilo
Tecnica

• Dimostrata padronanza di Appway/FNZ Studio in contesti di supporto/run e packaging/deployment.

• Integrazione delle applicazioni: API REST/SOAP, JSON/XML.

• Osservabilità e SRE: registrazione, metriche, tracciamento, allerta; capacità di leggere/interpretare i log delle Appway.

• Controllo CI/CD e versione (Git, pipelines), gestione multi-ambiente.

• La conoscenza degli ecosistemi bancari è un plus: core banking, screening (sanzioni/PEP/adverse media), ECM/archiving, IAM/SSO.
Funzionale

• Sfondo bancario solido (privato bancario / gestione della ricchezza preferito).

• Esperienza comprovata nelle operazioni CLM/KYC: onboarding, revisioni periodiche, bonifiche; FATCA/CRS è un plus.

• Conoscenza AML/KYC: punteggio di rischio, due diligenza, prove e verificabilità.

• Capacità di tradurre gli incidenti aziendali in ipotesi tecniche e piani d'azione.

Abilità morbide

• mentalità orientata al servizio, reattività e comunicazione chiara con IT e Business.

• Rigor, autonomia, priorità e compostezza in situazioni di incidente.

• Mindset analitico, messa a fuoco di qualità e spinta per il miglioramento continuo.

Profilo

• 5+ anni con Appway/FNZ Studio, con un forte componente di supporto L2/L3 in un ambiente bancario.

• Grado di istruzione superiore in Informatica o equivalente; Le certificazioni Appway/FNZ sono un plus.

• Pratica agile.

• Lingue: inglese fluente richiesto; francese è un bene.

• Altri
• Residenza svizzera obbligatoria

Competenze fondamentali: Aderenza ai valori dell’azienda: Dedicazione, Convizione, Agility e Responsabilità - Rispetto dei regolamenti e delle direttive interne

jobs.title: Project Manager (Consultant)
jobs.description:
Mission

• Within the COO IT Change unit, the role is responsible for coordinating execution and performing business analysis across a portfolio of IT projects and small demands in the Asia Core Banking domain. Focus areas include digital transformation (ebanking, CRM) and regulatory initiatives (Payments, Regulatory reporting).

Challenges

• Manage a diverse array of projects with multiple stakeholders.

• Daily interactions and coordination with an external software/vendor partner responsible for delivery.

Main Responsibilities

• Partner with business and IT stakeholders, including an external vendor, across a wide and diverse project agenda.

• Ensure stakeholder and sponsor involvement and commitment.

• Define clear scope and requirements; manage scope changes.

• Identify and manage project risks and conflicts.

• Oversee budgeting processes and control project spend.

• Plan and manage IT resources.

• Implement technical solutions in line with the bank’s software development lifecycle, in partnership with the main software vendor in charge of the delivery.

• Coordinate and participate in testing; obtain customer sign-off.

• Publish project reporting; build and maintain KPIs and KRIs.

• Collect and formalize lessons learned among stakeholders; ensure their application to future projects.

Requested Skills & Experience

• Overall knowledge of Private Banking processes and IT banking architecture - Familiarity with Asia is a plus (e.g., regulatory environment).

• Experience in the Financial sector (mandatory); experience in Private Banking (mandatory).

• Strong vendor management capabilities.

• Ability to bridge the gap between business and technical teams.

• Comfortable with both Waterfall and Agile methodologies.

• Planning and budget control.

Education : Engineer (or equivalent technical education).
 Experience : At least 10 years (senior level).
 Languages : English: Fluent.

Personal Skills & Attributes

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Proactive, Drive, leadership, and positive attitude; stress resistant.

• Team player, resourceful, and independent.

Swiss Residence : Optional.

Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives

jobs.title: Media Relations & Content Specialist
jobs.description:
• Main Responsibilities
• Media Relations
• Support the Head of Media in implementing the Bank’s media strategy across Europe and the Middle East, with a particular focus on French-speaking Switzerland and key satellite markets.

• Coordinate with media agencies across EMEA to align priorities, timelines and deliverables

• Collaborate with Investment Services, regional teams and other subject-matter experts to source spokespeople and content, and coordinate the full approval process.

• Ensure timely, accurate and on-brand responses to journalists and media partners.

• Proactively coordinate interviews, briefings and market commentary with the relevant internal experts.

• Prepare and update key media materials (Q&As, talking points, short bios, background notes) as needed.

• Build and maintain strong relationships with journalists in core financial and business media.

• Content Management & Copywriting
• Contribute to the production of high-quality content that supports the Bank’s positioning in investment strategy and asset management.

• Draft and edit press releases, statements, Q&As and opinion pieces in close collaboration with experts.

• Translate complex investment and market topics into clear, concise and compliant messages.

• Review and challenge the quality of content before it is offered to the media.

jobs.description:
• TEMPORARY MISSION ( 6 MONTHS)

• Mission

• Integrated within UBP’s Operations department, the Fees team manages the day to day application and collection of fees from clients’ accounts and market counterparties group wise. The team has an interdisciplinary role in a fast-paced environment : it supports the Front Office for fees queries and works in close collaboration with the other departments of the Asset and Wealth management divisions of UBP.

• Main responsibilities

• Its main missions are as follows:

• Create, amend and maintain the base fees schedules group wise.

• Set-up, amend and manage the clients’ fees exceptions.

• Set-up, amend and manage the brokers and other internal counterparties fees exceptions.

• Perform appropriate follow-up on outstanding fee setups or requests.

• Daily support to internal clients, including but not limited to Front Office, WM Business leads, Finance and other teams within the Operations department.

• Prepare and manage the quarterly fees billing, follow-up on quarterly billing tasks, including manual billing exceptions.

• Actively take part in the bank’s repricing initiatives, support WM leads on fees opportunities.

• Actively take part in other projects impacting the Fees team.

• Core competencies

• The successful candidate will possess the following skills:

• Analytical and problem solving skills: be at ease with numbers and larger datasets. Be able to think in “problem-action-results” terms.

• Flexibility: Be proactive and driven. Be able to adjust to urgent requests or shifting priorities, maange time effectively. Adjust decision-making in light of unforeseen circumstances.

• Client service ethic: Professional conduct with strong focus on client service, build lasting relationships with other departments of the group.

• Risk management : Review existing control framework to identify procedural loopholes or enhancement opportunities. Be able to raise concerns and propose mitigations or enhancement solutions. Be able to support audit requests, in coordination with the team’s supervisor or manager.

• Team spirit : Proactively help others and work for a common goal. Be open to others’ ideas, express opinion in a constructive way.

• Your Profile

• French and English speaking mandatory. Other languages is a plus.

• Preferrably knowledgeable in market finance : understands the various financial instruments, the trading and reconciliation flows as well as the custody chain.

• Proficient with Microsoft Office pack, specifically Microsoft Excel. Other VBA/Python/R skills is a plus.

• Others

• Swiss Residence

• Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives

descriptionByLocale.it:
• MISSIONE TEMPORARIA ( 6 MESE)

• Missione

• Integrato all'interno del dipartimento Operazioni UBP, il team di Fees gestisce l'applicazione giorno per giorno e la raccolta di tasse da account clienti e controparti di mercato gruppo saggi. Il team ha un ruolo interdisciplinare in un ambiente frenetico: supporta il Front Office per le richieste di tasse e lavora in stretta collaborazione con gli altri dipartimenti delle divisioni di gestione Asset e Wealth di UBP.

• Principali responsabilità

• Le sue principali missioni sono le seguenti:

• Creare, modificare e mantenere le spese di base programma gruppo saggio.

• Impostare, modificare e gestire le tasse dei clienti eccezioni.

• Impostare, modificare e gestire i broker e altre controparti interne tasse eccezioni.

• Eseguire il follow-up appropriato su impostazioni o richieste di pagamento eccezionali.

• Sostegno giornaliero a clienti interni, inclusi, ma non limitati a Front Office, WM Business, Finanza e altre squadre all'interno del reparto Operazioni.

• Preparare e gestire le commissioni trimestrali fatturazione, follow-up sulle attività di fatturazione trimestrale, comprese le eccezioni di fatturazione manuale.

• Partecipa attivamente alle iniziative di riformulazione della banca, supporto WM conduce alle opportunità di pagamento.

• Partecipa attivamente ad altri progetti che influenzano il team Fees.

• Competenze fondamentali

• Il candidato di successo possederà le seguenti competenze:

• Analitica e problem solving competenze: essere a proprio agio con numeri e dataset più grandi. Essere in grado di pensare in termini “problem-action-results”.

• Flessibilità: Sii proattivo e guidato. Essere in grado di adattarsi alle richieste urgenti o alle priorità di spostamento, maange il tempo in modo efficace. Regolare il processo decisionale alla luce di circostanze impreviste.

• Servizio clienti etico: condotta professionale con forte attenzione al servizio clienti, costruire relazioni durature con altri dipartimenti del gruppo.

• Gestione del rischio: rivedere il quadro di controllo esistente per identificare scappatoie procedurali o opportunità di miglioramento. Essere in grado di sollevare preoccupazioni e proporre mitigazioni o soluzioni di miglioramento. Essere in grado di sostenere le richieste di audit, in coordinamento con il supervisore del team o manager.

• Spirito di squadra: Proattivamente aiutare gli altri e lavorare per un obiettivo comune. Sii aperto alle idee altrui, esprimere l’opinione in modo costruttivo.

• Il tuo profilo

• Francese e inglese che parlano obbligatorio. Altre lingue sono un plus.

• Preferibilmente conoscibile nella finanza di mercato: comprende i vari strumenti finanziari, i flussi di negoziazione e riconciliazione e la catena di custodia.

• Proficiente con Microsoft Office pack, specificamente Microsoft Excel. Altre abilità VBA/Python/R sono un plus.

• Altri

• Residenza svizzera

• Competenze fondamentali: Aderenza ai valori dell’azienda: Dedicazione, Convizione, Agility e Responsabilità - Rispetto dei regolamenti e delle direttive interne

• Préparer et gérer la facturation trimestrielle, le suivi des tâches de facturation trimestrielle, y compris les exceptions à la facturation manuelle.

• Participer activement aux initiatives de la banque, soutenir WM mène sur les opportunités de frais.

• Compétences de base

Être en mesure d'appuyer les demandes de vérification, en coordination avec le superviseur ou le gestionnaire de l'équipe.

jobs.title: Security engineer
jobs.description:
Mission
 Design, build, and operate secure-by-design controls and services that protect the Bank’s platforms, applications, and data. Implement and maintain security tools to prevent, detect, and respond to threats, ensuring resilience, reliability, and compliance with banking regulations.

Main responsibilities

• Engineer, deploy, and maintain security platforms and controls (PAM, DAM, CSPM, DLP, Vulnerability Management).

• Review application designs and verify compliance with security requirements; provide actionable guidance, identify gaps, and track remediation through to closure.

• Implement security-by-design and security-by-default patterns across infrastructure, applications, and data services.

• Perform operational duties for ticketing: triage, prioritize, and resolve security tickets; escalate and coordinate with platform and application teams;

• Define secure configuration baselines, and compliance checks.

• Support incident response lifecycle: containment, eradication, recovery, and post-incident improvements; contribute to root cause analysis.

• Monitor cyber platform SLAs/KPIs (availability, performance, coverage, detection efficacy) and drive continuous improvement.

Your Profile

• Hands-on security engineer with strong problem-solving skills and a passion for automation and reliability.

• Able to translate security requirements into practical, scalable engineering solutions aligned to a regulated financial environment.

• Comfortable with modern platform tooling.

Education

• Master’s or bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Security, Engineering, or related field.

Experience Technical skills

• Mid to Senior: 3–7+ years of experience in Security Engineering, Security Operations Engineering, or Secure Platform Engineering.

Languages

• French : Fluent

• English : Strong advantage

Personal skills

• Self-motivated with ownership mindset; able to operate strategically while remaining hands-on when needed.

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management; able to translate technical risk into business impact.

• Strong critical thinking, analytical problem-solving, and decision-making under pressure.

• Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams and drive complex, multi-department initiatives.

• High integrity, resilience, and commitment to continuous improvement.

Others

• Swiss Residence: Mandatory

Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives

Implementare e mantenere strumenti di sicurezza per prevenire, rilevare e rispondere alle minacce, garantire resilienza, affidabilità e conformità alle normative bancarie.

Principali responsabilità

• Ingegnere, distribuire e mantenere piattaforme e controlli di sicurezza (PAM, DAM, CSPM, DLP, Vulnerability Management).

• Verificare i progetti di applicazione e verificare la conformità ai requisiti di sicurezza; fornire indicazioni attuabili, identificare le lacune e tracciare la bonifica attraverso la chiusura.

• Implementare modelli di sicurezza-by-design e di sicurezza-by-default in infrastrutture, applicazioni e servizi dati.

• Eseguire i dazi operativi per la biglietteria: triage, priorità e risolvere i biglietti di sicurezza; escalare e coordinare con i team di piattaforma e applicazioni;

• Definire le basi di configurazione sicure e i controlli di conformità.

• Supporto ciclo di vita di risposta incidente: contenimento, eradicazione, recupero e miglioramenti post-incidenti; contribuire all'analisi di causa radice.

• Monitorare la piattaforma informatica SLAs/KPIs (disponibilità, prestazioni, copertura, efficienza di rilevamento) e guidare il miglioramento continuo.

Il tuo profilo

• In grado di tradurre i requisiti di sicurezza in soluzioni ingegneristiche pratiche e scalabili allineate ad un ambiente finanziario regolamentato.

• Confortevole con moderni strumenti di piattaforma.

Istruzione

• Master o laurea in informatica, sicurezza delle informazioni, ingegneria, o campo relativo.

• Da metà a Senior: 3–7 anni di esperienza in ingegneria della sicurezza, ingegneria delle operazioni di sicurezza, o ingegneria della piattaforma sicura.

• Forte pensiero critico, problem solving analitico e processo decisionale sotto pressione.

• Prove capacità di guidare squadre interfunzionali e di guidare iniziative complesse e multi-dipartimento.

• Alta integrità, resilienza e impegno al miglioramento continuo.

jobs.description:
• Mission
 We’re looking for a hands-on Senior Consultant to support an electronic content management (ECM) migration between two banking information systems. Our mission is to deliver a secure, timely, and compliant migration by assessing counterparty data, aligning data semantics, and operating robust integration processes. As a consultant you’ll design and run migration workflows, coordinate with business and technical teams from both organizations, and ensure high-quality outcomes—with a pragmatic, production-focused approach. Experience using AI as a productivity tool is a plus.

• Main responsibilities

• Assist Business and IT ECM teams to plan and execute the migration of content and metadata from one bank’s information system to the target bank’s system.

• Organize and lead data mapping workshops with business units; capture requirements and align data semantics across both banks.

• Conduct system assessments using input from domain business lines to evaluate counterparty data, identify integration challenges, and propose remediation strategies.

• Design, implement, and operate ETL processes and migration pipelines to move content and metadata into target ECM systems in a timely manner; leverage FME Migration Tool where applicable.

• Execute migration tasks hands-on, coordinating cutover and post-migration stabilization activities.

• Emphasize maintainability (modular, well-structured migration components), observability (structured logging, metrics, traceability), and operability (standardized error handling and troubleshooting runbooks) across the migration lifecycle.

• Ensure data quality and compliance through reconciliation checks, consistency validations, and regulatory controls; resolve discrepancies with stakeholders.

• Collaborate with stakeholders to align integration goals and manage expectations across business and IT.

• Document data mappings, functional and technical specifications, runbooks, and operational procedures to enable IT–business alignment and knowledge transfer.

• Ramp up quickly on both organizations’ systems and processes; contribute to cross-team collaboration.

• Your Profile

• Proven experience delivering ECM/content/data migrations in complex, regulated environments (preferably banking/financial services).

• Deep knowledge of Documentum architecture and administration, including:
• D2, Content Server, JMS, API, DFS, DFC, DqMan

• Captiva / InputAccel / Intelligent Capture platform knowledge

• Strong ETL design and implementation skills for content and metadata migrations; experience with reconciliation, rollback strategies, and performance considerations.

• Knowledge of the FME Migration Tool is a strong plus.

• Proficient in Java development (e.g., Eclipse) and familiar with DevOps principles for packaging, deployment, and CI integration.

• Understanding of Documentum security models (user roles, ACLs, access controls) and compliance requirements related to content management.

jobs.description:
Mission
 As a Credit Structuring Officer you will support the Luxembourg-based Credit Structuring Team reporting to the Senior Credit Structuring Manager. The team provides support to the front-office to face any client request related to credits by setting up the best solution according to the Bank internal procedures and risk appetite.
 Main Duties

• Structure tailor-made financing solutions for private banking clients, including Lombard loans, mortgage loans, insurance-backed lending and other secured financing solutions, in compliance with the Bank’s internal policies and procedures, applicable regulations and relevant legal requirements.

• Advise Relationship Managers on optimal financing structures, pricing, collateral packages and credit terms.

• Perform comprehensive credit analysis, including the assessment of repayment capacity, collateral quality, legal structure, concentration risks and the overall client risk profile.

• Prepare, review and present credit applications to the relevant approval authorities (Local Credit Committee, Group Credit Committee, Board Credit Committee, etc.).

• Draft, review and negotiate credit documentation, including term sheets, loan agreements, amendments, security documentation and side letters.

• Coordinate complex financing transactions with internal stakeholders (Legal, Compliance, Credit Administration, Operations, Finance, Tax) and external advisers (law firms, notaries, valuers, insurance companies and other service providers).

• Conduct periodic reviews of existing credit facilities, reassess clients’ creditworthiness, collateral adequacy and covenant compliance, and prepare recommendations for the relevant approval authorities where required.

• Identify and escalate emerging credit risks, recommend appropriate risk mitigation measures and contribute to maintaining a sound and consistent credit risk framework.

• Participate in the development, review and continuous improvement of lending standards, templates and internal procedures.

Technical Skills

• University degree in Finance, Economics, or Business Administration.

• 3 years of experience in private banking including a significant experience in lending area.

• Good knowledge of lending products, particularly Lombard and mortgage financing.

• Solid understanding of credit risk assessment, financial analysis and collateral valuation.

• Good knowledge of legal documentation relating to financing and security interests.

Personal Skills

• Strong analytical thinking and sound judgement.

• High attention to detail and accuracy.

• Proactive, solution-oriented and pragmatic mindset.

• High level of integrity, discretion and confidentiality.

• Ability to work independently and collaboratively across multiple departments.

Languages

• Fluent English and French (written and spoken).

• Additional languages are considered an asset.

Union Bancaire Privée (UBP) is a family-owned company, driven by an entrepreneurial vision, innovation and independence. UBP is one of the most strongly-capitalised private banks.
 By joining UBP Asset Management (Europe) S.A. you will embrace a team of supportive high qualified professionals in Private Banking that will lead you to develop your career to the top level. We encourage continuous learning, development and knowledge sharing. We foster a culture of Agility, Conviction, Dedication and high degree of Responsibility.
 UBP Asset Management (Europe) S.A encourages all suitable qualified and eligible candidates to apply regardless of their gender identity or expression, age, racial, ethnic and cultural background, religion and beliefs, sexual orientation, disability or neurodiversity.
 In accordance with the provisions of the Luxembourg law of 23 July 2016 amending the law of 29 March 2013, retained candidate will be required to provide an extract from their criminal record as a part of UBP screening process.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Mission
As a Credit Structuring Officer you will support the Luxembourg-based Credit Structuring Team reporting to the Senior Credit Structuring Manager. The team provides support to the front-office to face any client request related to credits by setting up the best solution according to the Bank internal procedures and risk appetite.
Main Duties

• Structure tailor-made financing solutions for private banking clients, including Lombard loans, mortgage loans, insurance-backed lending and other secured financing solutions, in compliance with the Bank’s internal policies and procedures, applicable regulations and relevant legal requirements.

• Advise Relationship Managers on optimal financing structures, pricing, collateral packages and credit terms.

• Perform comprehensive credit analysis, including the assessment of repayment capacity, collateral quality, legal structure, concentration risks and the overall client risk profile.

• Prepare, review and present credit applications to the relevant approval authorities (Local Credit Committee, Group Credit Committee, Board Credit Committee, etc.).

• Draft, review and negotiate credit documentation, including term sheets, loan agreements, amendments, security documentation and side letters.

• Coordinate complex financing transactions with internal stakeholders (Legal, Compliance, Credit Administration, Operations, Finance, Tax) and external advisers (law firms, notaries, valuers, insurance companies and other service providers).

• Conduct periodic reviews of existing credit facilities, reassess clients’ creditworthiness, collateral adequacy and covenant compliance, and prepare recommendations for the relevant approval authorities where required.

• Identify and escalate emerging credit risks, recommend appropriate risk mitigation measures and contribute to maintaining a sound and consistent credit risk framework.

• Participate in the development, review and continuous improvement of lending standards, templates and internal procedures.

Technical Skills

• University degree in Finance, Economics, or Business Administration.

• 3 years of experience in private banking including a significant experience in lending area.

• Good knowledge of lending products, particularly Lombard and mortgage financing.

• Solid understanding of credit risk assessment, financial analysis and collateral valuation.

• Good knowledge of legal documentation relating to financing and security interests.

Personal Skills

• Strong analytical thinking and sound judgement.

• High attention to detail and accuracy.

• Proactive, solution-oriented and pragmatic mindset.

• High level of integrity, discretion and confidentiality.

• Ability to work independently and collaboratively across multiple departments.

Languages

• Fluent English and French (written and spoken).

• Additional languages are considered an asset.

Union Bancaire Privée (UBP) is a family-owned company, driven by an entrepreneurial vision, innovation and independence. UBP is one of the most strongly-capitalised private banks.
By joining UBP Asset Management (Europe) S.A. you will embrace a team of supportive high qualified professionals in Private Banking that will lead you to develop your career to the top level. We encourage continuous learning, development and knowledge sharing. We foster a culture of Agility, Conviction, Dedication and high degree of Responsibility.
UBP Asset Management (Europe) S.A encourages all suitable qualified and eligible candidates to apply regardless of their gender identity or expression, age, racial, ethnic and cultural background, religion and beliefs, sexual orientation, disability or neurodiversity.
In accordance with the provisions of the Luxembourg law of 23 July 2016 amending the law of 29 March 2013, retained candidate will be required to provide an extract from their criminal record as a part of UBP screening process.

• Connaissance approfondie de l'évaluation des risques de crédit, de l'analyse financière et de l'évaluation des garanties.

• Bonne connaissance des documents juridiques relatifs au financement et aux sûretés.

• Une mentalité proactive, orientée vers la solution et pragmatique.

• Haute intégrité, discrétion et confidentialité.

jobs.title: Anonymization Developer
jobs.description:
Mission

• Design, implement, and operate services and tooling for enterprise-grade data anonymization and protection across production databases.

• Develop and maintain REST API backends enabling anonymization workflows and integration with upstream/downstream systems.

• Build automation and operational scripts in PowerShell and Bash to deploy, monitor, and manage DAP services.

• Contribute to backend services and utilities in Java and/or C# with clean, testable, and secure code.

• Integrate with and support multiple database engines (MongoDB, MS SQL Server, Oracle), including schema discovery, profiling, and rules application.

• Collaborate with security, data governance, and application teams to define and enforce data masking/tokenization standards and policies.

• Implement observability (logging, metrics, tracing) and CI/CD pipelines for reliable delivery and operations.

• Troubleshoot incidents, perform root-cause analysis, and drive continuous improvements in scalability, reliability, and performance.

• Document APIs, runbooks, and operational procedures; contribute to knowledge sharing and onboarding materials.

Key Qualifications

• Strong, practical experience building and operating REST API backends (designing endpoints, versioning, authentication/authorization, performance tuning, resilience).

• Hands-on programming in at least two of the following: Java, C#; and scripting proficiency in PowerShell and Bash.

• Solid database fundamentals and hands-on experience with:
• MongoDB (collections, indexing, aggregation, performance basics)

• Microsoft SQL Server (T-SQL, schema design, indexing strategies)

• Oracle Database (PL/SQL fundamentals, performance considerations)

• Experience integrating backends with databases securely (connection handling, secrets management, least privilege).

• Familiarity with data anonymization/masking/tokenization concepts and patterns.

• Good understanding of secure software development practices (Kerberos, OWASP, input validation, secrets handling, TLS, logging without leakage).

• Comfortable with CI/CD tools and version control; experience with automated testing and code quality practices.

Nice to Have

• Experience with enterprise data masking/tokenization tools or libraries.

• Knowledge of data governance and privacy frameworks (GDPR, data minimization, DPIA).

• Exposure to event-driven architectures, message queues, or ETL/ELT pipelines.

• Containerization and orchestration (eg Docker/Podman, OpenShift) and infrastructure-as-code (e.g., Ansible).

• Observability stacks (Prometheus/Grafana, ELK/EFK, OpenTelemetry).

• Performance profiling and capacity planning for API services and databases.

• Experience in regulated environments (banking/financial services).

Mindset & Soft Skills

• Ownership mentality with a bias for clean, pragmatic solutions.

• Strong problem-solving skills and ability to debug complex, distributed issues.

• Clear communication and collaboration with cross-functional teams.

• Attention to detail in security and compliance.

Our Tech Environment

• Languages: Java, C#

• Scripting: PowerShell, Bash

• Databases: MongoDB, MS SQL Server, Oracle

• APIs: REST-first design, OpenAPI/Swagger, OAuth2/OIDC, Kerberos

• DevOps: Git-based workflows, CI/CD in Azure Dev Ops, containers, observability

What We Offer

• Opportunity to shape a bank-wide platform critical to data protection and privacy.

• Collaborative environment with security, data, and platform engineers.

• Professional development, certifications, and training support.

• Competitive compensation and benefits aligned with industry standards.

• Flexible work practices in a modern engineering environment.

• Location
• Swiss Residence : Mandatory

Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives

Il nostro ambiente tecnico

• Scrittura: PowerShell, Bash

Mission

• Concevoir, mettre en œuvre et exploiter des services et des outils pour l'anonymisation et la protection des données à l'échelle de l'entreprise dans les bases de données de production.

• Concevoir et maintenir des moteurs d'API REST permettant l'anonymisation des flux de travail et l'intégration avec les systèmes en amont/en aval.

• Construisez l'automatisation et les scripts opérationnels dans PowerShell et Bash pour déployer, surveiller et gérer les services DAP.

• Contribuez aux services et utilitaires de sauvegarde en Java et/ou C# avec un code propre, testable et sécurisé.

• Intégrez et supportez plusieurs moteurs de base de données (MongoDB, MS SQL Server, Oracle), y compris la découverte de schéma, le profilage et l'application de règles.

• Collaborer avec les équipes de sécurité, de gouvernance des données et d'application pour définir et faire respecter les normes et les politiques de masquage/tokenisation des données.

• Mettre en oeuvre des pipelines d'observation (encombrement, mesures, traçage) et d'IC/CD pour une livraison et des opérations fiables.

• Dépannage des incidents, analyse des causes profondes et amélioration continue de l'évolutivité, de la fiabilité et des performances.

• Documenter les API, les livres d'exécution et les procédures opérationnelles; contribuer au partage des connaissances et au matériel d'embarquement.

Qualifications clés

• Forte expérience pratique de construction et d'exploitation de moteurs d'API REST (conception des paramètres, version, authentification/autorisation, réglage des performances, résilience).

• Programmation pratique dans au moins deux des domaines suivants : Java, C#; et compétences de script dans PowerShell et Bash.

• Bases de données solides et expérience pratique avec:
• MongoDB (collections, indexation, agrégation, bases de performance)

• Microsoft SQL Server (T-SQL, conception de schéma, stratégies d'indexation)

• Base de données Oracle (fondamentaux PL/SQL, considérations de performance)

• Connaissance des concepts et des modèles d'anonymisation/masking/tokenisation des données.

• Bonne compréhension des pratiques de développement de logiciels sécurisés (Kerberos, OWASP, validation d'entrée, manipulation de secrets, TLS, enregistrement sans fuite).

• Confortable avec les outils CI/CD et le contrôle de version; expérience avec les tests automatisés et les pratiques de qualité de code.

Sympa d'avoir

• Expérience des outils ou bibliothèques de masquage/tokenisation de données d'entreprise.

• Connaissance des cadres de gouvernance des données et de protection des renseignements personnels (RGPD, minimisation des données, DPIA).

• Exposition aux architectures d'événements, aux files d'attente de messages ou aux pipelines ETL/ELT.

• Containerization et orchestration (par exemple Docker/Podman, OpenShift) et infrastructure-as-code (par exemple Ansible).

• Piles d'observabilité (Prometheus/Grafana, ELK/EFK, OpenTelemetry).

Compétences mentales et douces

• Compétences solides en résolution de problèmes et capacité de déboguer des questions complexes et réparties.

jobs.description:
Mission

• Design, implement, and operate backend services and APIs using Java (17/11/8), Spring (4/5), and Spring Boot (2.x/3.x).

• Build and maintain REST and SOAP APIs; manage HTTP layers and API specifications using OpenAPI / Swagger.

• Develop supporting front-end/admin consoles in Vue.js or Angular where relevant to platform operations.

• Integrate with Oracle and MS SQL Server using JPA/Hibernate; contribute SQL/PL-SQL and manage schema changes via Liquibase.

• Implement CI/CD pipelines (YAML-based) with Maven and Git, including quality gates and test automation.

• Apply secure authentication and authorization patterns (Kerberos, OAuth2/OIDC); follow AppSec best practices (OWASP, input validation, secrets handling).

• Contribute to test strategy and automation (unit, integration, BDD/ATDD with JUnit 5, Mockito, Cucumber; Jest on frontend).

• Support production operations: troubleshoot incidents, analyze performance, and drive reliability improvements.

• Document APIs, architecture decisions, runbooks, and operational procedures; track work in JIRA.

• Collaborate cross-functionally to align software architecture with business goals and platform standards.

Key Qualifications

• 7–15 years of professional software engineering experience; proven track record supporting production systems.

• Strong backend development with:
• Java (from 8 to the latest LTS being the target for all apps)

• Spring 4/5 and Spring Boot 2.x/3.x

• REST and SOAP API design; HTTP layer fundamentals; OpenAPI standard

• Frontend exposure with Vue.js or Angular for operational/admin UIs.

• Databases: Oracle and MS SQL Server, with hands-on experience in:
• JPA/Hibernate

• SQL, DB performance fundamentals

• Liquibase for schema migrations

• PL/SQL (beginner level, <2 years)

• CI/CD and DevOps practices:
• Git, Maven

• Pipeline management in YAML

• Test automation integration in pipelines

• Security and authentication:
• Kerberos and OAuth2/OIDC

• Good knowledge of AppSec (SQL injection, XSS, RCE) and secure coding practices

• Testing practices:
• JUnit 5, Mockito, Cucumber (BDD/ATDD)

• Jest for frontend unit tests

• Note: Team does not practice strict TDD; emphasis is on pragmatic, automated testing

• Software architecture proficiency and ability to document clearly.

• Languages: Fluent in English. French is useful.

• Soft skills: Organized, reliable in production support, able to communicate clearly and collaborate across teams.

Nice to Have

• Rule engines and BPMN tools (e.g., Drools; beginner <2 years).

• Node.js for tooling or auxiliary services.

• E2E testing experience (Cypress, Protractor, Selenium WebDriver, PlayWright).

• API/Load testing (JMeter) — Note: Tool may not be available in current environment.

• Familiarity with vulnerability scanning tools (e.g., Checkmarx or Fortify).

• Strong sensitivity to code quality (Sonar rules/Clean Code) and OWASP guidelines.

• Experience in regulated environments (banking/financial services).

Mindset & Soft Skills

• Ownership mentality and practical problem-solving under production constraints.

• Clear communication and effective collaboration with developers, QA, and security.

• Attention to detail in security, documentation, and code quality.

• Pragmatic approach to process; comfort operating without full agile maturity.

Our Tech Environment

• Languages: Java (17/11/8); Node.js [Optional]

• Frameworks: Spring 4/5, Spring Boot 2.x/3.x

• Frontend: Vue.js, Angular; Jest for unit tests

• Databases: Oracle, MS SQL Server; JPA/Hibernate; SQL/PL-SQL (beginner); Liquibase

• APIs: REST and SOAP; HTTP layers; OpenAPI/Swagger; Kerberos; OAuth2/OIDC

• DevOps: Git, Maven; CI/CD pipelines (YAML); Test Automation; Sonar/Clean Code

• Tools/Process: JIRA; BDD/ATDD with Cucumber

• AI: internal framework accessible from the dev platform

• What We Offer

• Opportunity to build and operate production services with real impact in a leading bank.

• Collaboration with experienced application, platform, and security engineers.

• Professional development and training support.

• Pragmatic work practices focused on delivery and reliability.

• Location

• Mandatory Swiss Residency close to Geneva

Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives

• SQL, les fondamentaux de performance DB

• Approche pragmatique du processus; confort fonctionnant sans pleine maturité agile.

jobs.description:
Mission
 UBP has been working on a program to further enhance its Compliance and Risk framework, which is also leading to significant change in the first line of defense in Wealth Management – Business Risk Management, Periodic Client Reviews, and Business Monitoring.
 As part of this effort, the position holder is responsible for coordinating and delivering cross-functional change initiatives at the first line of defense (1.5LOD) within Wealth Management (WM), jointly with the second line of defense (2LOD = Risk & Compliance) and WM stakeholders. It is a unique opportunity to shape change within an agile organization that encourages employee initiative.
 The role oversees execution of projects, represents 1.5LOD in programs, manages the operational interface with 2LOD, and ensures timely, high‑quality reporting and data provisioning to management and governance forums.

Main responsibilities
 Drive WM projects across the first line of defense:

• Plan and execute initiatives of 1.5LOD (e.g., enhancement of account opening process), defining scope, milestones, and stakeholder engagement.

• Coordinate change management activities (e.g., targeted trainings, communications, procedure updates) to implement new processes and controls.

• Act as the central point of contact for user feedback during implementation; channel insights into backlog/prioritization.

• Coordinate incident resolution end to end with contributing teams, ensuring root cause analysis and action plan tracking.

• Closely work with the Head of Business Risk Management and the Head of Periodic Client Reviews, delivering support as required

Support projects initiated by second line of defense:

• Represent WM in project committees for initiatives for AML and controls-related topics.

• Deliver and/or coordinate all WM deliverables and commitments, ensuring traceability and quality.

• Lead specific project streams on behalf of WM (e.g., rollout of an incident management system), aligning timelines, resources, and acceptance criteria.
 Manage coordination between Risk & Compliance and WM control functions:

• Serve as the primary entry point for all 1.5LOD requests; own the intake, triage, and delivery of requests.

• Manage day to day coordination with 2LOD, aligning expectations, timelines, and governance for deliverables.
 Provide reporting and answer data requests of stakeholders:

• Coordinate with responsible SMEs to provide accurate, timely data for committees (e.g., Conduct & Culture Committee), regulatory reporting (e.g., FINMA), internal and external audit queries, and WM management requests.

• Perform sanity checks and quality assurance on submissions; ensure proper evidencing and auditability.

• Drive the evolution and optimization of existing reporting requirements and tooling in partnership with teams that provide standardized reporting.

Your Profile

• Minimum 10 years of experience in business risk management and/or Compliance within Wealth Management/Private Banking.

• Proven experience leading cross functional projects at the 1.5LOD/2LOD interface with Risk and Compliance, including process and control changes.

• Strong understanding of non-financial risk management frameworks, incident management, and regulatory expectations relevant to WM.

• Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills; ability to influence without formal authority.

• Demonstrated ability to manage multiple initiatives concurrently and deliver to governance and regulatory deadlines.

• Strong analytical skills with attention to detail for data validation, reporting, and documentation.

• Fluent in French and English (written and spoken); any additional language is an asset.

Others

• Swiss Residence mandatory

Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives

descriptionByLocale.it:
Missione
UBP ha lavorato su un programma per migliorare ulteriormente il suo framework Compliance e Risk, che sta anche portando a significativi cambiamenti nella prima linea di difesa in Wealth Management – Business Risk Management, Periodic Client Recensioni e Business Monitoring.
Nell'ambito di questo sforzo, il titolare della posizione è responsabile del coordinamento e della fornitura di iniziative di cambiamento interfunzionale alla prima linea di difesa (1.5LOD) all'interno di Wealth Management (WM), in collaborazione con la seconda linea di difesa (2LOD = Risk & Compliance) e le parti interessate WM. È un'opportunità unica per modellare il cambiamento all'interno di un'organizzazione agile che incoraggia l'iniziativa dei dipendenti.
Il ruolo supervisiona l'esecuzione dei progetti, rappresenta 1.5LOD nei programmi, gestisce l'interfaccia operativa con 2LOD e garantisce reportistica tempestiva e di alta qualità e la fornitura di dati ai forum di gestione e governance.

Principali responsabilità
Guidare i progetti WM attraverso la prima linea di difesa:

• Pianificare ed eseguire iniziative di 1.5LOD (ad esempio, la valorizzazione del processo di apertura del conto), definendo lo scopo, le pietre miliari e l'impegno degli stakeholder.

• Coordinate attività di gestione dei cambiamenti (ad esempio, formazione mirata, comunicazioni, aggiornamenti procedurali) per implementare nuovi processi e controlli.

• Agire come punto centrale di contatto per il feedback degli utenti durante l'attuazione; intuizioni del canale su backlog/prioritization.

• Coordinate la risoluzione degli incidenti finiscono per finire con i team che contribuiscono, assicurando l'analisi delle cause e il monitoraggio del piano d'azione.

• Lavorare con il capo della gestione del rischio aziendale e con il capo delle recensioni periodiche dei clienti, fornendo supporto come richiesto

Progetti di supporto avviati dalla seconda linea di difesa:

• Rappresentare WM in comitati di progetto per iniziative per AML e temi correlati ai controlli.

• Fornire e/o coordinare tutti i prodotti e gli impegni WM, garantendo tracciabilità e qualità.

• Condurre flussi di progetto specifici per conto di WM (ad esempio, rollout di un sistema di gestione degli incidenti), allineando tempi, risorse e criteri di accettazione.
Gestire il coordinamento tra le funzioni di controllo Risk & Compliance e WM:

• Servire come punto di ingresso primario per tutte le richieste 1.5LOD; possedere l'assunzione, il triage e la consegna delle richieste.

• Gestisci il coordinamento di giorno in giorno con 2LOD, allineando le aspettative, i tempi e la governance per i responsabili.
Fornire informazioni e rispondere alle richieste dei dati degli stakeholder:

• Coordinare le PMI responsabili a fornire dati precisi e tempestivi per i comitati (ad esempio, Comitato di Conduct & Culture), reporting normativo (ad esempio, FINMA), domande di audit interni ed esterni e richieste di gestione WM.

• Esegui i controlli sulla sanità e l'assicurazione sulla qualità sulle presentazioni; assicura una corretta prova e verificabilità.

• Guidare l'evoluzione e l'ottimizzazione dei requisiti di reporting esistenti e tooling in partnership con i team che forniscono report standardizzati.

Il tuo profilo

• Minimo 10 anni di esperienza nella gestione del rischio aziendale e/o nella gestione della ricchezza/Private Banking.

• Esperienza comprovata che porta avanti progetti funzionali all'interfaccia 1.5LOD/2LOD con Risk e Compliance, compresi i cambiamenti di processo e di controllo.

• Forte comprensione dei quadri di gestione del rischio non finanziari, della gestione degli incidenti e delle aspettative regolamentari rilevanti per il WM.

• Eccellente capacità di gestione e comunicazione degli stakeholder; capacità di influenzare senza autorità formale.

• Dimostrata capacità di gestire più iniziative contemporaneamente e fornire ai termini di governance e regolamentazione.

• Forte capacità analitiche con attenzione ai dettagli per la convalida dei dati, la segnalazione e la documentazione.

• Fluente in francese e inglese (scritto e parlato); qualsiasi lingua aggiuntiva è un bene.

Altri

• Residenza svizzera obbligatoria

Competenze fondamentali: Aderenza ai valori dell’azienda: Dedicazione, Convizione, Agility e Responsabilità - Rispetto dei regolamenti e delle direttive interne

descriptionByLocale.de:
Mission
UBP hat an einem Programm zur weiteren Verbesserung seines Compliance- und Risiko-Frameworks gearbeitet, das auch zu signifikanten Veränderungen in der ersten Verteidigungslinie im Bereich Wealth Management – Business Risk Management, Periodic Client Reviews und Business Monitoring führt.
Im Rahmen dieser Bemühungen ist der Positionsinhaber für die Koordination und Durchführung funktionsübergreifender Veränderungsinitiativen in der ersten Verteidigungslinie (1.5LOD) innerhalb des Wealth Management (WM) verantwortlich, gemeinsam mit der zweiten Verteidigungslinie (2LOD = Risk & Compliance) und den WM-Stakeholdern. Es ist eine einzigartige Gelegenheit, Veränderungen in einer agilen Organisation zu gestalten, die die Initiative der Mitarbeiter fördert.
Die Rolle überwacht die Ausführung von Projekten, stellt 1.5LOD in Programmen dar, verwaltet die operative Schnittstelle mit 2LOD und gewährleistet eine zeitnahe, qualitativ hochwertige Berichterstattung und Datenbereitstellung für Management- und Governance-Foren.

Hauptzuständigkeiten
Fahren Sie WM-Projekte über die erste Verteidigungslinie:

• Planung und Durchführung von Initiativen von 1.5LOD (z. B. Verbesserung des Kontoeröffnungsprozesses), Definition von Umfang, Meilensteinen und Stakeholder-Engagement.

• Koordination von Change Management-Aktivitäten (z.B. gezielte Schulungen, Kommunikation, Verfahrensaktualisierungen), um neue Prozesse und Kontrollen zu implementieren.

• Sie fungieren als zentrale Anlaufstelle für User-Feedback während der Implementierung; kanalisieren Einblicke in Backlog/Priorisierung.

• Koordinieren Sie die Lösung von Vorfällen Ende-zu-Ende mit den beitragenden Teams, um die Ursachenanalyse und die Verfolgung des Aktionsplans sicherzustellen.

• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem Head of Business Risk Management und dem Head of Periodic Client Reviews bei Bedarf

Unterstützungsprojekte, die von Second Line of Defense initiiert wurden:

• Repräsentieren Sie WM in Projektausschüssen für Initiativen zu AML- und Kontrollthemen.

• Liefern und / oder koordinieren Sie alle WM-Deliverables und -Verpflichtungen, um die Rückverfolgbarkeit und Qualität zu gewährleisten.

• Führen Sie spezifische Projektströme im Auftrag von WM (z. B. Rollout eines Incident Management Systems), indem Sie Zeitpläne, Ressourcen und Akzeptanzkriterien aufeinander abstimmen.
Verwalten Sie die Koordination zwischen Risk & Compliance und WM-Kontrollfunktionen:

• Dienen Sie als primärer Einstiegspunkt für alle 1.5LOD-Anfragen; besitzen Sie die Annahme, Triage und Lieferung von Anfragen.

• Verwalten Sie die tägliche Koordination mit 2LOD und stimmen Sie Erwartungen, Zeitpläne und Governance für die zu erbringenden Leistungen ab.
Berichterstattung und Beantwortung von Datenanfragen von Stakeholdern:

• Koordination mit verantwortlichen KMU, um genaue, zeitnahe Daten für Ausschüsse (z. B. Conduct & Culture Committee), regulatorische Berichterstattung (z. B. FINMA), interne und externe Auditanfragen und WM-Managementanfragen bereitzustellen.

• Durchführung von Sanitätsprüfungen und Qualitätssicherung bei Einreichungen; Gewährleistung ordnungsgemäßer Nachweise und Überprüfungsfähigkeit.

• Betreiben Sie die Weiterentwicklung und Optimierung bestehender Berichtspflichten und Tools in Zusammenarbeit mit Teams, die standardisierte Berichte bereitstellen.

Ihr Profil

• Mindestens 10 Jahre Erfahrung im Business Risk Management und / oder Compliance im Wealth Management / Private Banking.

• Bewährte Erfahrung in der Leitung funktionsübergreifender Projekte an der 1.5LOD/2LOD-Schnittstelle mit Risiko und Compliance, einschließlich Prozess- und Kontrolländerungen.

• Starkes Verständnis von nicht-finanziellen Risikomanagement-Frameworks, Incident Management und regulatorischen Erwartungen, die für WM relevant sind.

• Exzellentes Stakeholder-Management und Kommunikationsfähigkeit; Fähigkeit, ohne formale Autorität zu beeinflussen.

• Demonstrierte Fähigkeit, mehrere Initiativen gleichzeitig zu verwalten und die Governance- und Regulierungsfristen einzuhalten.

• Starke analytische Fähigkeiten mit Liebe zum Detail für Datenvalidierung, Berichterstattung und Dokumentation.

• Fließend in Französisch und Englisch (geschrieben und gesprochen); jede zusätzliche Sprache ist ein Gewinn.

Andere

• Schweizer Residenz obligatorisch

Kernkompetenzen : Einhaltung der Werte des Unternehmens: Hingabe, Überzeugung, Agilität und Verantwortung - Einhaltung von Vorschriften und internen Richtlinien
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Mission
UBP a travaillé sur un programme pour améliorer son cadre de conformité et de risque, ce qui entraîne également un changement important dans la première ligne de défense dans la gestion de patrimoine – gestion des risques d'entreprise, examens périodiques des clients et surveillance des affaires.
Dans le cadre de cet effort, le titulaire du poste est responsable de la coordination et de la prestation des initiatives de changement interfonctionnel à la première ligne de défense (1,5LOD) au sein de Gestion de patrimoine (WM), conjointement avec la deuxième ligne de défense (2LOD = Risque et Conformité) et les parties prenantes de WM. C'est une occasion unique de façonner le changement au sein d'une organisation agile qui encourage l'initiative des employés.
Le rôle est de superviser l'exécution des projets, de représenter 1,5LOD dans les programmes, de gérer l'interface opérationnelle avec 2LOD et d'assurer la production de rapports et de données de haute qualité en temps opportun aux forums de gestion et de gouvernance.

Principales responsabilités
Diriger les projets WM à travers la première ligne de défense:

• Planifier et exécuter des initiatives de 1,5LOD (p. ex., amélioration du processus d'ouverture des comptes), définir la portée, les jalons et la participation des intervenants.

• Coordonner les activités de gestion du changement (p. ex. formation ciblée, communications, mises à jour des procédures) pour mettre en oeuvre de nouveaux processus et contrôles.

• Agir comme point de contact central pour la rétroaction des utilisateurs pendant la mise en oeuvre; canaliser les informations sur l'arriéré/priorisation.

• Coordonner la résolution des incidents en fin de compte avec les équipes participantes, en assurant l'analyse des causes profondes et le suivi du plan d'action.

• Collaborer étroitement avec le chef de la gestion des risques opérationnels et le chef des examens périodiques des clients, en fournissant le soutien nécessaire

Projets de soutien initiés par la deuxième ligne de défense :

• Représenter le MF dans les comités de projet pour les initiatives relatives à la LAM et aux sujets liés aux contrôles.

• Fournir et/ou coordonner tous les produits livrables et tous les engagements du MG, en assurant la traçabilité et la qualité.

• Diriger des volets de projets particuliers au nom de la GM (p. ex., mise en place d'un système de gestion des incidents), aligner les délais, les ressources et les critères d'acceptation.
Gérer la coordination entre les fonctions de contrôle du risque et de la conformité et du MF :

• Servir de point d'entrée principal pour toutes les demandes de 1,5LOD; posséder l'admission, le triage et la livraison des demandes.

• Gérer la coordination quotidienne avec 2LOD, en alignant les attentes, les échéanciers et la gouvernance pour les produits livrables.
Fournir des rapports et répondre aux demandes de données des intervenants :

• Coordonner avec les PME responsables la fourniture de données exactes et en temps opportun pour les comités (p. ex., le Comité de la conduite et de la culture), les rapports réglementaires (p. ex., la FINMA), les demandes de vérification interne et externe et les demandes de gestion de la GM.

• Effectuer des vérifications de la santé mentale et l'assurance de la qualité sur les présentations; assurer une vérification et une vérification adéquates.

• Diriger l'évolution et l'optimisation des exigences actuelles en matière de rapports et d'outils en partenariat avec des équipes qui fournissent des rapports normalisés.

Votre profil

• Au moins 10 ans d'expérience dans la gestion des risques d'entreprise et/ou la conformité au sein de la gestion de patrimoine/banque privée.

• Expérience éprouvée menant des projets transfonctionnels à l'interface 1.5LOD/2LOD avec Risque et Conformité, y compris les changements de processus et de contrôle.

• Une bonne compréhension des cadres de gestion des risques non financiers, de la gestion des incidents et des attentes réglementaires pertinentes à la gestion des risques.

• Excellente capacité de gestion et de communication des intervenants; capacité d'influencer sans pouvoir officiel.

• Capacité démontrée de gérer simultanément plusieurs initiatives et de respecter les échéances en matière de gouvernance et de réglementation.

• Fortes compétences analytiques en vue de la validation des données, de la production de rapports et de la documentation.

• Fluent en français et en anglais (écrit et parlé); toute autre langue est un atout.

Autres

• Résidence suisse obligatoire

Compétences de base : Adhérence aux valeurs de l'entreprise : Dédicace, Conviction, Agilité et Responsabilité - Respect des règlements et des directives internes

jobs.description:
• Mission:

• As a Systems Engineer, you will play a crucial role in managing and improving our Microsoft/Citrix based systems and infrastructure. Your expertise will be essential in ensuring high availability, performance, and security of our IT services.

• Challenges :

• Evolve in a challenging, regulated environment for a fast and growing Private Bank

• Main responsibilities :

• Design, implementation, and management of Microsoft-related technologies, including but not limited to Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, Exchange, Microsoft PKI, DFS, MS Teams.

• Troubleshoot and improve AD replication, DNS, and Group Policy Objects (GPOs).

• Implement and enforce security policies, including password policies, account lockout policies, and auditing.

• Integrate Active Directory with other systems, such as Office 365, Azure AD, and third-party applications.

• Develop and maintain PowerShell scripts for automation of routine tasks and reporting

• Develop and maintain disaster recovery plans for Active Directory.

• Setting up and maintaining Root and Intermediate Certificate Authorities.

• Design, implementation, and management of Citrix-related technologies,

• Provide production support for our Microsoft environments, ensuring optimal performance and reliability.

• Manage and resolve complex incidents and problems, minimizing downtime and mitigating impacts on business operations.

• Implement and maintain system monitoring solutions to pre-emptively identify potential issues (SCOM / NIMSOFT).

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams for system enhancements and integration of new technologies.

• Ensure compliance with security policies and procedures, including regular system audits and updates.

• Conduct root cause analysis for major incidents and lead problem management processes.

• Develop and maintain comprehensive documentation for system configurations, procedures, and service records.

• Be part of an on-call service rotation one week per month (24/24-7j/7)

• Must have with strong expertise in:

• Microsoft Infra (AD, DHCP, SCOM)

• PKI and certificat management

• SCCM

• Exchange 2019

• Powershell scripting

• MS Teams

• Ansible

• Nice to have :

• M365

• Citrix

• AirWatch MDM Mobility plateform

• Intune

• Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives
