jobs.description:
Mission
 The Senior Transversal Business Analyst will support a multi-year banking transformation programme involving the continued implementation of Murex.
The role operates across individual programme workstreams and provides an end-to-end business perspective , ensuring that business processes, operating models, data, controls and system responsibilities remain coherent across Murex, Core Banking, Operations, Finance, Risk and other impacted functions.
The Transversal BA will focus particularly on dependencies and functional boundaries between projects and systems, identifying gaps that may not be visible within individual project workstreams.
The role requires a strong combination of business analysis, banking product and process knowledge, business architecture and transformation experience , with particular exposure to Treasury, FX and FX Options environments.

Main responsibilities

• End-to-End Business Analysis: Provide a holistic, end-to-end process view across functions and systems, closing gaps and maintaining critical scenarios.

• Cross-Programme Dependency Management: Map and manage inter-stream dependencies, escalate conflicts, and optimize change sequencing.

• Target Operating Model: Define a future operating model with clear responsibilities and sourcing aligned to Murex and Core Banking.

• Product and Business Process Analysis: Specify front-to-back processing and lifecycles for Treasury products, filtering out legacy-only practices.

• Systems and Functional Architecture: Assign system-of-records and responsibilities, remove overlaps, and design target interactions and data flows.

• Data and Migration: Set data ownership and golden sources, define migration rules, and reconcile/validate data across Murex and Core Banking.

• Controls and Reconciliations: Refresh the control framework, define future reconciliations, automate manual controls, and formalize exceptions.

• Integration and Business Events: Catalogue interfaces and events, define information flows and timing, and set failure and recovery requirements.

• Testing and Business Acceptance: Ensure end-to-end scenario coverage with UAT criteria, analyze cross-boundary defects, and trace to readiness.

• Cutover and Business Readiness: Coordinate integrated cutover, validate and reconcile during go-live, apply go/no-go, and prepare operations.

Your Profile
 The successful candidate is likely to be a senior Business Analyst / Lead Business Analyst with approximately 8–15+ years of relevant banking experience , although depth and breadth of experience are more important than years alone.
The ideal profile combines:
 Treasury / FX product knowledge + Operations knowledge + Murex experience + transformation/business architecture skills.
The role is not intended to replace detailed Murex or Core Banking Business Analysts. Instead, the Transversal BA ensures that the solutions designed by individual streams work together as a coherent end-to-end banking operating model .

Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives

descriptionByLocale.it:
Missione L'Analista Business Senior Transversal sosterrà un programma pluriennale di trasformazione bancaria che prevede la continua attuazione di Murex. Il ruolo opera attraverso i singoli programmi e fornisce una prospettiva di business end-to-end, assicurando che i processi aziendali, i modelli operativi, i dati, i controlli e le responsabilità di sistema rimangano coerenti tra Murex, Core Banking, Operations, Finance, Risk e altre funzioni impattate.

Il BA trasversale si concentrerà in particolare sulle dipendenze e sui confini funzionali tra progetti e sistemi, individuando lacune che potrebbero non essere visibili all'interno dei singoli flussi di lavoro del progetto. Il ruolo richiede una forte combinazione di analisi aziendale, conoscenza dei prodotti bancari e dei processi, architettura aziendale e esperienza di trasformazione, con particolare esposizione agli ambienti Treasury, FX e FX Options.

Principali responsabilità

• Analisi end-to-end Business: fornire una visione olistica e di processo end-to-end attraverso funzioni e sistemi, colmare le lacune e mantenere scenari critici.

• Gestione delle dipendenze tra programmi: mappare e gestire le dipendenze inter-stream, intensificare i conflitti e ottimizzare il sequenziamento dei cambiamenti.

• Modello operativo Target: Definire un futuro modello operativo con chiare responsabilità e approvvigionamento allineato a Murex e Core Banking.

• Analisi dei processi di produzione e di business: specificare processi di lavorazione frontale e cicli di vita per i prodotti del Tesoro, filtrando le pratiche di esclusiva tradizione.

• Sistemi e Architettura Funzionale: Assegnare il sistema di registrazione e responsabilità, rimuovere sovrapposizioni e progettare interazioni target e flussi di dati.

• Dati e migrazione: impostare la proprietà dei dati e le sorgenti dorate, definire le regole di migrazione e riconciliare/convalidare i dati in Murex e Core Banking.

• Controlli e ridingibriche: aggiornare il quadro di controllo, definire future riconciliazioni, automatizzare i controlli manuali e formalizzare le eccezioni.

• Integrazione ed eventi aziendali: interfacce ed eventi di catalogo, definizione dei flussi e dei tempi di informazione e definizione dei requisiti di guasto e recupero.

• Testing e Accettazione Business: garantire la copertura degli scenari end-to-end con criteri UAT, analizzare difetti transfrontalieri e tracciare la prontezza.

• Cutover e Pronto Impresa: coordinare il cutover integrato, convalidare e riconciliarsi durante il go-live, applicare go/no-go e preparare le operazioni.

Il tuo profilo Il candidato di successo è probabilmente un senior Business Analyst / Lead Business Analyst con circa 8.15+ anni di esperienza bancaria rilevante, anche se la profondità e l'ampiezza dell'esperienza sono più importanti di anni solo. Il profilo ideale combina: Treasury / FX conoscenza del prodotto + Operations conoscenze + Murex esperienza + trasformazione / business architecture competenze. Il ruolo non è destinato a sostituire dettagliate Murex o Core Banking Business Analysts.

Invece, la Transversal BA assicura che le soluzioni progettate dai singoli flussi di lavoro lavorino insieme come un modello operativo end-to-end coerente.

Core Competence: Aderenza ai valori aziendali: Dedicazione, Convinzione, Agiltà e Responsabilità - Rispetto delle normative e delle direttive interne

descriptionByLocale.de:
Mission Das Senior Transversal Business-Ansager unterstützt ein mehrjähriges Banktransformationsprogramm mit der weiteren Umsetzung von Murex. Die Rolle ist programmübergreifend und bietet eine durchgängige Geschäftsperspektive, die sicherstellt, dass Geschäftsprozesse, Betriebsmodelle, Daten, Kontrollen und Systemverantwortung in Murex, Core Banking, Operations, Finance, Risk und anderen betroffenen Funktionen kohärent bleiben.

Der Transversal BA wird sich insbesondere auf Abhängigkeiten und funktionale Grenzen zwischen Projekten und Systemen konzentrieren und Lücken identifizieren, die in einzelnen Projektarbeitsströmen nicht sichtbar sind. Die Rolle erfordert eine starke Kombination aus Businessanalyse, Bankprodukt- und Prozesswissen, Geschäftsarchitektur und Transformationserfahrung, wobei insbesondere die Bereiche Treasury, FX und FX Optionen betroffen sind.

Hauptverantwortung

• Business-Analyse Ende-zu-Ende: Bereitstellung einer ganzheitlichen, durchgängigen Prozessansicht über Funktionen und Systeme hinweg, Schließung von Lücken und Aufrechterhaltung kritischer Szenarien.

• Cross- (2003) Dependency Management: Interstream-Abhängigkeiten ordnen und verwalten, Konflikte eskalieren und die Änderungssequenzierung optimieren.

• Target Operating Model: Definieren Sie ein zukünftiges Betriebsmodell mit klaren Verantwortlichkeiten und einer auf Murex und Core Banking ausgerichteten Beschaffung.

• Produkt- und Geschäftsprozessanalyse: Spezifizieren Sie die vordere Verarbeitung und Lebenszyklus von Treasury-Produkten, indem Sie die Verfahren, die nur noch in der Vergangenheit angewandt wurden, ausfiltern.

• Systeme und Funktionale Architektur: System-of-Records und Verantwortlichkeiten zuweisen, Überschneidungen beseitigen und Zielinteraktionen und Datenflüsse entwerfen.

• Daten und Migration: Setzen Sie Datenbesitz und goldene Quellen, definieren Migrationsregeln und versöhnen/validieren Sie Daten über Murex und Core Banking.

• Kontrollen und Aussöhnungen: Aktualisieren des Kontrollrahmens, Festlegung künftiger Aussöhnungen, automatische manuelle Kontrollen und formalisieren von Ausnahmen.

• Integration und Business Events: Katalogschnittstellen und Events, Definition von Informationsflüssen und Timing, und Festlegung von Ausfall- und Wiederherstellungsanforderungen.

• Testing and Business Acceptance: Stellen Sie eine durchgängige Szenarioabdeckung mit UAT-Kriterien sicher, analysieren Sie grenzüberschreitende Defekte und verfolgen Sie die Bereitschaft.

• Cutover und Business Readiness: Integrierte Cutover-Koordination, Validierung und Abstimmung während des Go-Live, Go/No-Go und Vorbereitung der Operationen.

Ihr Profil Der erfolgreiche Kandidat wird wahrscheinlich ein Senior Business-Ansister / Lead Business-Ansister mit etwa 8-15+ Jahren relevanter Bankerfahrung sein, obwohl Tiefe und Breite der Erfahrung wichtiger sind als Jahre allein. Das ideale Profil kombiniert: Treasury / FX-Produktwissen + Betriebswissen + Murex-Erfahrung + Transformations-/Business-Architektur-Fähigkeiten. Die Rolle ist nicht dazu gedacht, detaillierte Murex oder Core Banking-Business-Ansister zu ersetzen.

Stattdessen stellt die Transversal BA sicher, dass die von einzelnen Streams entwickelten Lösungen als kohärentes End-to-End-Banking-Betriebsmodell zusammenarbeiten.

Kernkompetenzen : Unternehmensverträglichkeit, Werte: Widmung, Überzeugung, Agilität und Verantwortung - Einhaltung von Vorschriften und internen Richtlinien
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Mission L'analyste principal des opérations transversales appuiera un programme pluriannuel de transformation bancaire qui prévoit la poursuite de la mise en œuvre de Murex. Le rôle de l'analyste principal des opérations transversales s'exerce dans les différents secteurs de travail du programme et offre une perspective opérationnelle de bout en bout, assurant que les processus opérationnels, les modèles opérationnels, les données, les contrôles et les responsabilités du système demeurent cohérents entre les fonctions Murex, Core Banking, Operations, Finance, Risque et autres.

Le BA transversal se concentrera particulièrement sur les dépendances et les limites fonctionnelles entre les projets et les systèmes, en identifiant les lacunes qui peuvent ne pas être visibles dans les différents secteurs de travail des projets. Le rôle exige une forte combinaison d'analyses commerciales, de connaissances sur les produits et les processus bancaires, d'architecture opérationnelle et d'expérience de transformation, avec une exposition particulière aux environnements du Trésor, des options FX et FX.

Principales responsabilités

• Analyse opérationnelle de bout en bout : fournir une vue globale des processus de bout en bout entre les fonctions et les systèmes, combler les lacunes et maintenir des scénarios critiques.

• Gestion de la dépendance trans-programmes : cartographier et gérer les dépendances inter-streams, intensifier les conflits et optimiser le séquençage des changements.

• Modèle opérationnel cible : Définir un modèle opérationnel futur avec des responsabilités claires et un approvisionnement en fonction de Murex et Core Banking.

• Analyse des produits et des processus opérationnels : Précisez le traitement de front à dos et les cycles de vie des produits du Trésor, en filtrant les pratiques du passé seulement.

• Systèmes et architecture fonctionnelle: attribuer des systèmes d'enregistrement et de responsabilité, supprimer les chevauchements et concevoir des interactions et des flux de données cibles.

• Données et migration: définir la propriété des données et les sources d'or, définir les règles de migration et rapprocher/valider les données dans Murex et Core Banking.

• Contrôles et rapprochements : Actualiser le cadre de contrôle, définir les rapprochements futurs, automatiser les contrôles manuels et formaliser les exceptions.

• Intégration et événements commerciaux: Catalogue des interfaces et événements, définir les flux d'information et le calendrier, et définir les exigences en matière de défaillance et de récupération.

• Test et acceptation commerciale : assurer la couverture de bout en bout des scénarios avec les critères de TAU, analyser les défauts transfrontaliers et remonter jusqu'à la préparation.

• Cutover et Business Readiness : Coordonner la cutover intégrée, valider et concilier pendant la mise en route, appliquer go/no-go et préparer les opérations.

Votre profil Le candidat retenu est susceptible d'être un analyste principal / Analyste principal d'affaires avec environ 8-15 ans d'expérience bancaire pertinente, bien que la profondeur et l'étendue de l'expérience soient plus importantes que les seules années. Le profil idéal combine: connaissances de produit Trésorerie / FX + Connaissances opérationnelles + Expérience Murex + compétences en transformation / architecture d'entreprise.

Au lieu de cela, le BA Transversal assure que les solutions conçues par les différents flux fonctionnent ensemble comme un modèle d'exploitation bancaire cohérent de bout en bout.

 Lead the Front Office Treasury Roll-out in Murex and contribute to integrate operating model for banking book risk, funding and liquidity, settlement-aware inventory, collateral optimization, FTP, hedge accounting, and connectivity to external triparty, margin, and post-trade platforms—ensuring consistency across Front Office, Risk, Finance, Operations, and Accounting.

Main responsibilities
 Core responsibilities

• Murex delivery: maximize standard MX.3; typologies/booking/market data; cross-functional design; unit/SIT/UAT/regression; migration/reconciliation; root-cause analysis and backlog management.

• Proven delivery of large front-to-back Murex programs, migrations, complex testing and integrations; resolves cross-platform issues end-to-end.

• Hands-on experience on Murex Implementation.

• Practical expertise in repo/triparty, collateral management, securities inventory/settlement, cash/liquidity, FTP, hedge accounting, and external interfaces.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Mission Leader the Front Office Treasury Roll-out in Murex e contribuire ad integrare il modello operativo per il rischio di portafoglio bancario, il finanziamento e la liquidità, l'inventario dei regolamenti, l'ottimizzazione delle garanzie, FTP, la contabilizzazione delle operazioni di copertura e la connettività a piattaforme esterne tripartite, margin e post-trade.

Principali responsabilità

• Consegna Murex: massimizzare standard MX.3; tipologie/prenotazioni/dati di mercato; progettazione cross-funzionale; unità/SIT/UAT/regressione; migrazione/reconciliazione; analisi delle cause e gestione del ritardo.

• Rischio di tesoreria e portafoglio bancario: setup di portafoglio/libro; valutazione, P&L, sensibilità, flussi di cassa, reporting del rischio; curve coerenti/prelievo tra le entità.

• Cassa e liquidità: finanziamento e rollover overnight automatizzato/semi-automatizzati; prenotazione/ciclo di vita/controlli; previsione vs effettiva riconciliazione del contante.

• Ambito di applicazione del prodotto: FX funding swaps; G7 bond e ABS/CDO/CLO; IRD (IRS, FRA, XCCY, swaps, caps/floor, asset swaps, futures, inflation); mercati monetari e finanziari (prestiti/depositi, pronti contro termine, compresi triparti/paniere, prestiti, garanzie).

E' bello avere

• FTP: modello di finanziamento interno, curve/diffusori/metodologie FTP; attribuzione e integrazione con le interfacce FTP esterne Finance/P&L.

• Inventario di regolamento: inventario di cassa/securie a livello aziendale con stato di regolamento; disponibilità/incumbrance; utilizzo di finanziamenti/collaboratori/securie; riconciliazione dei custodi.

• Contabilità di copertura: definire relazioni, designazione, valutazione e test di efficacia; allinearsi con Finanza; supportare swaps/XCCY; testare e riconciliare.

• Gestione delle garanzie: operazioni di pronti contro termine/retro, prestiti/prestazioni, swaps, derivati; idoneità, allocazione, scarti di garanzia; flussi di lavoro dei margini; coerenza triparti/custodi.

• integrazioni esterne: BNY Mellon, Euroclear (tripartito), Acadia (margina), MarkitWire (OTC); dati/2002ging, identificatori, ciclo di vita, riconciliazione, eccezioni, test end-to-end.

• Leadership cross-funzionale: partner con Treasury/Funding, ALM, Collateral, Securities Finance, Risk, Product Control, Finance/Accounting, Operations, Market Data, Technology e vendor.

Il tuo profilo

• MX.3 Senior Treasury PMI con copertura di prodotti profondi (Indevi fissi, IRD, Mercati Money, Repo/SecFin) e comprensione integrata del finanziamento/liquidità, rischio di portafoglio bancario, inventario, garanzie, regolamento e contabilità.

• Consegna di proven di grandi programmi Murex front-to-back, migrazioni, test complessi e integrazioni; risolve problemi di piattaforma multi-end-to-end.

• Esperienza pratica sull'implementazione di Murex.

• Competenza pratica in materia di acquisto/triparty, gestione delle garanzie, inventario/insediamento titoli, liquidità/cash, FTP, contabilità di copertura e interfacce esterne.

• Plus: Tier 1/global bank delivery; BNY/Euroclear/Acadia/MarkitWire integrazioni; inventario consolidato multi-entità/collaboratorio; disattivazione del patrimonio; operazioni multi-ente/valuta/regione.

Core Competence: Aderenza ai valori aziendali: Dedicazione, Convinzione, Agiltà e Responsabilità - Rispetto delle normative e delle direttive interne

descriptionByLocale.de:
Mission Führen Sie die Front Office Treasury Roll-out in Murex und tragen dazu bei, das Betriebsmodell für Bankenbuchrisiken, Finanzierung und Liquidität, zahlungsbewusste Inventare, Sicherheitenoptimierung, FTP, Hedge Accounting und Konnektivität mit externen Dreiparteien-, Margin- und Post-Trade-Plattformen zu integrieren – und die Konsistenz zwischen Front Office, Risk, Finance, Operations und Accounting zu gewährleisten.

Hauptverantwortungen Kernverantwortungen

• Murex-Lieferung: Maximierung der Standard-MX.3; Typologien/Buchungen/Marktdaten; cross-funktionales Design; Unit/SIT/UAT/Regression; Migration/Versöhnung; Root-Cause-Analyse und Backlog-Management.

• Treasury-Risiko und Bankbuch: Portfolio/Buchaufbau; Bewertung, P&L, Sensitivitäten, Cashflows, Risikoberichterstattung; einheitliche Kurven/Preise zwischen Unternehmen.

• Bargeld und Liquidität: automatisierte/halbautomatische Mittel für die Nachtfinanzierung und den Rollover; Buchung/Lebenszyklus/Kontrollen; projiziert gegen tatsächliche Zahlungsabgleich.

• Produktumfang: FX-Finanzierungsswaps; G7-Anleihen und ABS/CDO/CLO; IRDs (IRS, FRA, XCCY, Swaps, Caps/Floors, Asset Swaps, Futures, Inflation); Geldmärkte und Wertpapierfinanzierungen (Kredite/Depositen, Repo inkl. Dreiparteien/Basket, Kredite, Sicherheiten Swaps).

Schön, dass Sie

• FTP: interne Finanzierung des Modells, FTP-Kurven/Spreads/Methoden; Attribution und Integration mit Finance/P&L; externe FTP-Schnittstellen.

• Bestandsverzeichnis für die Abwicklung: firmenweites Bestandsverzeichnis für Bargeld/Wertpapiere mit Abwicklungsstatus; Verfügbarkeit/Umlauf; Finanzierungs-/Kollateral-/Versicherungsfinanzierung; Kustodienabgleich.

• Hedge Accounting: Definition von Beziehungen, Bezeichnung, Bewertung und Wirksamkeitstest; Abstimmung mit Finance; Unterstützungsswaps/XCCY; Prüfung und Abstimmung.

• Sicherheitenmanagement: Repo/Reverse, Kredit/Borrowing, Wertpapierswaps, Derivate; Förderfähigkeit, Zuweisung, Abschläge; Margenworkflows; Dreiparteien-/Kustodische Konsistenz.

• Externe Integrationen: BNY Mellon, Euroclear (Triparty), Acadia (Margin), Markit Wire (OTC); Daten/Messaging, Kennungen, Lebenszyklus, Versöhnung, Ausnahmen, End-to-End-Tests.

• Cross-funktionale Führung: Partner mit Treasury/Fonds, ALM, Sicherheiten, Wertpapierfinanzierung, Risiko, Produktkontrolle, Finanzen/Budget, Operationen, Marktdaten, Technologie und Anbietern.

Ihr Profil

• Senior MX.3 Treasury KMU mit hoher Produktabdeckung (Fixed Income, IRD, Money Markets, Repo/SecFin) und integriertem Verständnis von Finanzierung/Liquidität, Bankbuchrisiko, Inventar, Sicherheiten, Abwicklung und Rechnungslegung.

• Bewährte Lieferung von großen Murex-Vorderseite-Programmen, Migrationen, komplexen Tests und Integrationen; löst plattformübergreifende Probleme Ende-zu-Ende.

• Hands-on Erfahrung über Murex Umsetzung.

• Praktische Expertise in Repo/Triparty, Sicherheitenmanagement, Wertpapierbestand/-verrechnung, Bargeld/Liquidität, FTP, Hedge Accounting und externen Schnittstellen.

• Plus: Tier 1/globale Banklieferung; BNY/Euroclear/Acadia/Markit Wire Integrationen; konsolidiertes Multi-Entity-Inventar/Kollateral; Altbetriebs stilllegung; Multi-Entity/Währung/Regionenoperationen.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Mission Diriger le déploiement du Trésor du Front Office à Murex et contribuer à intégrer le modèle opérationnel pour le risque de livres bancaires, le financement et la liquidité, les stocks de matériel de règlement-livraison, l'optimisation des garanties, la FTP, la comptabilité de couverture et la connectivité aux plates-formes externes de tripartite, de marge et de post-commerce – assurant la cohérence entre le Front Office, le Risque, les Finances, les Opérations et la Comptabilité.

Principales responsabilités Responsabilités essentielles

• Livraison de Murex : maximiser la norme MX.3; données de la réservation/marché des années 90; conception interfonctionnelle; unité/SIT/UAT/régression; migration/recombinaison; analyse des causes profondes et gestion de l'arriéré.

• Risques de trésorerie et livres bancaires : configuration du portefeuille/du livre; évaluation, P&L, sensivities, flux de trésorerie, rapports sur les risques; courbes et prix cohérents entre les entités.

• Encaisse et liquidités : financement et roulement automatisés/semi-automatisés à la journée; réservation/cycle de vie/contrôles; rapprochement des liquidités prévu par rapport aux opérations réelles.

• Portée du produit: swaps de fonds FX; obligations du G7 et ABS/CDO/CLO; DIR (IRS, FRA, XCCY, swaps, plafonds/planchers, swaps d'actifs, futur, inflation); marchés monétaires et financement des titres (prêts/dépôts, prises en pension, participations, prêts, swaps de garantie).

C'est bien d'avoir

• FTP : modèle de financement interne, courbes/répartitions/méthodologies FTP; attribution et intégration avec Finance/P&L; interfaces FTP externes.

• Stock de trésorerie/sécurités à l'échelle de l'entreprise, avec statut de règlement; disponibilité/encours; utilisation du financement/collatéral/sécurités; rapprochement des dépositaires.

• Comptabilité de couverture: définir les relations, la désignation, l'évaluation et les tests d'efficacité; aligner sur les finances; soutenir les swaps/XCCY; tester et rapprocher.

• Gestion des garanties: prise en charge/rétroaction, prêts/emprunts, swaps de garantie, produits dérivés; éligibilité, attribution, décote; flux de marge; cohérence tripartite/détenue.

• Intégrations externes: BNY Mellon, Euroclear (triparty), Acadia (margin), MarkitWire (OTC); données/messageries, identifiants, cycle de vie, rapprochement, exceptions, essais de bout en bout.

• Leadership interfonctionnel: partenaire avec Trésorerie/Financement, ALM, Collateral, Securities Finance, Risque, Contrôle de Produit, Finance/Accounting, Opérations, Données du Marché, Technologie, et vendeurs.

Votre profil

• PME de haute technologie MX.3 Trésorerie avec une couverture de produits profonde (Revenus Fixés, IRD, Marchés monétaires, Repo/SecFin) et une compréhension intégrée du financement/liquidité, risque de comptabilité bancaire, stocks, garanties, règlement et comptabilité.

• Proven de la prestation de grands programmes de Murex avant-arrière, mi, tests complexes et intégrations; résolve les problèmes inter-platform de bout en bout.

• Expérience pratique sur la mise en œuvre de Murex.

• Expertise pratique en repo/tripartite, gestion des garanties, stocks/règlements de titres, trésorerie/liquidité, FTP, comptabilité de couverture et interfaces externes.

• Plus: niveau 1/ livraison bancaire globale; intégrations BNY/Euroclear/Acadia/MarkitWire; inventaire/collatéraux consolidés multientités; démantèlement des anciennes entités; opérations multientités/monnaie/région.

Compétences de base : Adhérence à l'entreprise, valeurs : Dedication, Conviction, Agilité et Responsabilité - Conformité aux règlements et directives internes

jobs.title: Head of Securities Transfer
jobs.description:
• Mission

• Support and be able to treat all processing covering the management of activities relating to Securities Transfer changes which will affect all kind of assets (including alternative assets such as mutual funds, Private Equities and Hedge Funds).

• Manage and oversee a team processing in light of the funds activities including private equities.

• Be able to work closely with our key players to meet our customers' expectations.

• Be responsible to lead, mentor staff and provide oversight to ensure events are processed timely and accurately. Be able to work closely with our key players to meet our customers' expectations.

Management responsibilities:

• Present strategic opportunities to mitigate risk.

• Maintain our KPI/KRI indices internal to our business with a view to mitigating the risk associated with the securities transfer activities.

• Be responsible for its activity by working closely with the various divisions of the bank in order to be up to date with the various regulations impacting our securities transfer activity.

• Ensure department procedures are adhered to, review and maintain client task list and related SLA's.

• Communicate effectively and efficiently across departments, with staff, with senior management.

• Lead staff meetings, participate on project management and industry events.

• Ensure daily follow up in respect of pending issues and take appropriate measures for resolution.

Daily business responsibilities:

• Crossed analysis of the received information: custodian’s swifts, agent prospectus, contract notes and financial providers such as: Bloomberg, Telekurs.

• Perform control of reconciliation of holdings, entitlements determination, pending positions management.

• Be able to manage and control securities transfer instructions received from Wealth Management and external parties (transfer IN/OUT/Internal and funds registration process).

• Control transmission of the deposits to our correspondents/Transfer Agents/Administrators and control of their safe delivery and acceptance.

• Follow-up of the topics and issues over the lifecycle of the securities transfer activities.

• Your Profile

• Education : Bachelor’s degree

• Languages : French and English: fluent

• Personal skills:
• Think in "Problem-Action-Results" terms.

• Be proactive and driven.

• Show strong client service ethic.

• Maintain quality standards despite schedule pressures.

• Highly organized, manage tight deadlines within a high risk environment, ability to work under pressure.

• Strong analytical skills with an ability to identify problems and propose solutions.

• Express opinions and criticism in a constructive way.

• Be a continuous learner.

• Adaptability, self-motivation and team work.

• Build lasting client relationships.

• Consistently comply with internal & external regulations.

• Strong analytical skills and organized.

• Attention to detail and accuracy.

• Others
• Swiss Residence: Mandatory

Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives

• Forte capacità analitiche con la capacità di identificare i problemi e proporre soluzioni.
• Esprimi opinioni e critiche in modo costruttivo.
• Sii un apprendista continuo.
• Adaptability, automotivation e lavoro di squadra.
• Costruire relazioni cliente durature.
• Conformemente alle normative interne ed esterne.
• Forte capacità analitiche e organizzato.
• Attenzione ai dettagli e alla precisione.

• Residenza svizzera: obbligatoria Competenze fondamentali: Aderenza ai valori dell’azienda: Dedicazione, Convizione, Agility e Responsabilità - Rispetto dei regolamenti e delle direttive interne

jobs.description:
Mission
 Within UBP, the Private Markets Group (PMG) is in charge of sourcing and introducing private markets opportunities to the UHNWI and institutional clients of the bank across Private Equity, Infrastructure, Private Debt, and Real Estate. Since the team was launched in 2015, we have deployed over USD 5 billion in to more than 90 investments.
 We are currently seeking a motivated and detail-oriented intern to join the team responsible for the selection of private equity funds, private equity co-investments, as well as the management of discretionary private markets mandates for high profile clients. The internship is for a period of 6 months.
 The Private Equity intern will actively participate in the screening, due diligence, execution and monitoring of investments in private equity funds and co-investments. They will also be highly involved in the management of discretionary private markets mandates and pitching for new mandates.

Main responsibilities

• Screen and analyse new investment opportunities in private equity and occasionally private infrastructure

• Conduct in depth financial analysis, modelling, and industry research for new investments

• Prepare investment briefings and memorandums, and help defend investment recommendations to the investment committee

• Support in the preparation of pitches and presentations

• Maintain and update investment databases and documentation

• Assist the team in the execution and monitoring of private markets transactions

Your Profile

• Bachelors degree obtained (or close to being obtained) in business administration, finance, economics or related field with outstanding academic credentials

• Technical skills: Strong analytical skills, financial modelling skills, solid understanding of financial concepts

• Language: Fluency in English and French

• Previous experience in private equity, investment banking, strategy consulting, or corporate finance is preferred

Others

• Swiss Residence

Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives

jobs.description:
Mission
 Within the Group Internal Audit and reporting to the Head of Audit Data Analytics, the Data Analyst contributes to the development of Data Analytics/AI tools to support Internal Audit’s core processes, including risk assessment, audit planning, audit execution, reporting, and follow-up.

Main responsibilities

• Designing and maintaining a robust, scalable, and secure data-processing environment (data collection, transformation, using ETL tools and/or code).

• Developing reusable analytical assets, including statistical models, scripts, and AI/machine-learning models to automatize audit testing procedures.

• Supporting the integration of analytical results into Internal Audit deliverables such as dashboards, automated reports, and analytical products for non-technical users.

• Collaborating with auditors and subject-matter experts to prioritize relevant audit use cases, translating audit objectives into analytical requirements and developing appropriate data-based solution.

• Maintaining documentation for existing solutions, analytical methodologies, data sources, and model development.

• Providing IT support for the administration and maintenance of audit management software.

• Building effective relationships with key stakeholders, including data owners, data governance and IT teams.

• Participating in data-related working groups and communities of practice across the Bank.

• Keeping up to date with technological developments.

Your Profile

• At least 3 years of relevant experience in data transformation and analysis within a medium-sized or large organization, preferably in banking or financial services.

• Master’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Physics or a related field.

• Expertise in core data science programming languages (e.g. Python, R, SQL) and libraries (e.g. Scikit-learn, Seaborn, PyTorch, TensorFlow).

• Experience in using Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs) to develop and apply AI-drive solution and AI-assisted automation, including competences in designing and operationalizing AI and ML platforms and pipelines.

• Experience with the design and implementation of ETL data-processing workflows.

• Knowledge in applying descriptive and inferential statistics, data-quality techniques, and analytical testing methodologies.

• Experience with data-visualization tools, knowledge of Power BI is an advantage.

• Integrity, independence, intellectual curiosity, and a constructive, solutions-oriented mindset.

• Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage several projects simultaneously.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to adapt communication to technical and non-technical audiences.

• Versatility and adaptability required to work effectively within a small team of Data Analysts.

• Fluent in French and English, both written and spoken; additional languages are an advantage.

Others

• Swiss Residence

Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives

Mission
Within the Group Internal Audit and reporting to the Head of Audit Data Analytics, the Data Analyst contributes to the development of Data Analytics/AI tools to support Internal Audit’s core processes, including risk assessment, audit planning, audit execution, reporting, and follow-up.

Main responsibilities

• Designing and maintaining a robust, scalable, and secure data-processing environment (data collection, transformation, using ETL tools and/or code).

• Developing reusable analytical assets, including statistical models, scripts, and AI/machine-learning models to automatize audit testing procedures.

• Supporting the integration of analytical results into Internal Audit deliverables such as dashboards, automated reports, and analytical products for non-technical users.

• Collaborating with auditors and subject-matter experts to prioritize relevant audit use cases, translating audit objectives into analytical requirements and developing appropriate data-based solution.

• Maintaining documentation for existing solutions, analytical methodologies, data sources, and model development.

• Providing IT support for the administration and maintenance of audit management software.

• Building effective relationships with key stakeholders, including data owners, data governance and IT teams.

• Participating in data-related working groups and communities of practice across the Bank.

• Keeping up to date with technological developments.

Your Profile

• At least 3 years of relevant experience in data transformation and analysis within a medium-sized or large organization, preferably in banking or financial services.

• Master’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Physics or a related field.

• Expertise in core data science programming languages (e.g. Python, R, SQL) and libraries (e.g. Scikit-learn, Seaborn, PyTorch, TensorFlow).

• Experience in using Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs) to develop and apply AI-drive solution and AI-assisted automation, including competences in designing and operationalizing AI and ML platforms and pipelines.

• Experience with the design and implementation of ETL data-processing workflows.

• Knowledge in applying descriptive and inferential statistics, data-quality techniques, and analytical testing methodologies.

• Experience with data-visualization tools, knowledge of Power BI is an advantage.

• Integrity, independence, intellectual curiosity, and a constructive, solutions-oriented mindset.

• Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage several projects simultaneously.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to adapt communication to technical and non-technical audiences.

• Versatility and adaptability required to work effectively within a small team of Data Analysts.

jobs.description:
Mission
 We are seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Tax Specialist to join our Client Documentation and Tax Services Department.
As part of the Fiscal Reporting team, you will play a key role in ensuring the accuracy and quality of our clients’ tax statements, while collaborating with various departments and external providers.
This is a unique opportunity to grow in a fast-paced, stimulating environment and contribute to impactful projects across the bank.

Main responsibilities

• Tax Statement Review & Validation
• Review and validate tax statements for over 20 international jurisdictions, including Switzerland, France, Portugal, Mexico, and others.

• Ensure that tax documents comply with local and international regulations before being sent to clients.

• Data Quality Assurance
• Collaborate with our external provider to ensure the quality and accuracy of tax data before statement production.

• Identify and correct anomalies or inconsistencies in the data to ensure reliable reporting.

• Client Support & Front Office Interaction
• Address inquiries and requests from the Front Office regarding tax statements, providing clear and precise explanations.

• Manage tax document orders in coordination with internal teams and external providers.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration
• Work closely with Compliance, Operations, Front Office, and IT teams to ensure smooth management of tax processes.

• Actively participate in cross-functional projects involving process improvements, regulatory updates, or strategic initiatives.

• Project Management
• Contribute to side projects related to tax data, information systems, and operational processes.

• Participate in the continuous improvement of tools and processes in collaboration with IT and other departments.

Key Skills & Qualifications

• Tax Expertise : In-depth knowledge of international tax regulations.

• Analytical Skills : Ability to analyze complex data and identify anomalies.

• Client Orientation : Excellent communication skills to address Front Office and client inquiries.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration : Experience working with multidisciplinary teams (Compliance, IT, Operations, etc.).

• Project Management : Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet deadlines.

Your Profile

• Experience : Minimum 2 years in banking, with a focus on tax services.

• Skills : Strong knowledge of financial instruments (Equities, Bonds, Structured Products, Derivatives – Listed or OTC) and their specific characteristics. Familiarity with European income and gains taxation is a plus. Proficiency in Microsoft Office is essential.

• Languages : Fluency in French and English is required; German, Italian, Spanish, or Portuguese is a plus.

• Mindset : Proactive, solution-oriented, and eager to learn. Strong problem-solving skills, ability to work quickly and efficiently, and a team player who thrives in a fast-paced environment.

Why Join Us

• Be part of a collaborative and innovative team.

• Work in a challenging yet rewarding environment.

• Develop your expertise and grow your career in a leading financial institution.

Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives

Nell’ambito del team Fiscal Reporting, svolgerai un ruolo chiave nel garantire l’accuratezza e la qualità delle dichiarazioni fiscali dei nostri clienti, collaborando con vari dipartimenti e fornitori esterni.
Questa è un'opportunità unica per crescere in un ambiente veloce e stimolante e contribuire a progetti impattanti in tutta la banca.

Principali responsabilità

• Valutazione e convalida delle dichiarazioni fiscali
• Verificare e convalidare le dichiarazioni fiscali per oltre 20 giurisdizioni internazionali, tra cui Svizzera, Francia, Portogallo, Messico e altri.

• Assicurarsi che i documenti fiscali siano conformi alle normative locali e internazionali prima di essere inviati ai clienti.

• Assicurazione sulla qualità dei dati
• Collabora con il nostro fornitore esterno per garantire la qualità e l'accuratezza dei dati fiscali prima della produzione di dichiarazioni.

• Identificare e correggere anomalie o incongruenze nei dati per garantire una segnalazione affidabile.

• Supporto clienti & Interazione ufficio anteriore
• Rivolgersi alle richieste e alle richieste del Front Office relative alle dichiarazioni fiscali, fornendo spiegazioni chiare e precise.

• Gestire gli ordini dei documenti fiscali in coordinamento con le squadre interne e i fornitori esterni.

• Collaborazione trasversale
• Lavorare a stretto contatto con i team Compliance, Operations, Front Office e IT per garantire una gestione regolare dei processi fiscali.

• Partecipa attivamente a progetti interfunzionali che coinvolgono miglioramenti di processo, aggiornamenti normativi o iniziative strategiche.

• Gestione dei progetti
• Contribuire a progetti collaterali relativi ai dati fiscali, sistemi informativi e processi operativi.

• Partecipa al continuo miglioramento di strumenti e processi in collaborazione con IT e altri reparti.

Abilità e qualifiche chiave

• Competenza fiscale: conoscenza approfondita delle normative fiscali internazionali.

• Capacità di analizzare i dati complessi e identificare le anomalie.

• Orientamento del cliente: eccellenti capacità di comunicazione per affrontare le richieste del cliente e dell'ufficio anteriore.

• Collaborazione trasversale: esperienza di lavoro con team multidisciplinari (Compliance, IT, Operazioni, ecc.).

• Gestione del progetto: Capacità di gestire più progetti contemporaneamente e rispettare le scadenze.

Il tuo profilo

• Esperienza: minimo 2 anni nel settore bancario, con un focus sui servizi fiscali.

• Competenze: Forte conoscenza degli strumenti finanziari (Equità, Obbligazioni, Prodotti Strutturati, Derivati – Elencati o OTC) e delle loro caratteristiche specifiche. La familiarità con il reddito europeo e i guadagni fiscali è un plus. La competenza in Microsoft Office è essenziale.

• Lingue: francese e inglese è richiesta la fluidità; tedesco, italiano, spagnolo o portoghese è un plus.

• Mindset: Proattivo, orientato alla soluzione, e desideroso di imparare. Forte capacità di problem solving, capacità di lavorare in modo rapido ed efficiente, e un giocatore di squadra che prospera in un ambiente veloce.

Perché unirsi a noi

• Partecipa a un team collaborativo e innovativo.

• Lavorare in un ambiente stimolante ma gratificante.

• Sviluppa la tua esperienza e crescere la tua carriera in un istituto finanziario leader.

• Participer activement à des projets interfonctionnels comportant des améliorations des processus, des mises à jour réglementaires ou des initiatives stratégiques.

jobs.title: Analyst - SQL/API Developer ( Consultant )
jobs.description:
Mission

• Nous recherchons un(e) Analyste Développeur pour rejoindre l’équipe IT HR dans le cadre d’un projet stratégique d’intégration d’Oracle HCM Cloud.

• Vous interviendrez sur la reconstruction de l’écosystème HR actuellement connecté à OHRMS. Vous serez responsable de vos interfaces de bout en bout : analyse de l’existant, conception de la solution cible, rédaction des spécifications, développement, tests, coordination des contributeurs, mise en production et stabilisation.

• Ce poste requiert une double compétence forte en analyse/conception et développement , ainsi qu’une capacité à comprendre les enjeux fonctionnels, techniques et d’architecture globale. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes d’architecture, de sécurité, Talend, Control-M, DBA, Oracle HCM et les équipes métier.

• La maîtrise d’ Oracle, PL/SQL et des technologies API est indispensable. L’autonomie, la capacité à être force de proposition, l’esprit de synthèse, la rigueur et l’orientation résultats sont essentiels pour réussir dans ce rôle.

Tâches principales

• Comprendre le fonctionnement actuel des interfaces avec OHRMS : flux de donnée, règle de gestion, les transformations et contrôles, les dépendances, impacts liés au remplacement OHRMS par Oracle HCM, les conditions permettant le parallèle run et à terme le décommissionnement OHRMS et des autres outils.

• Analyser les besoins fonctionnels, les contraintes techniques, identifier et proposer les solutions pertinentes dans l’écosystème Oracle HCM en prenant en compte les exigences de performance, de cohérence global HR IS et maintenabilité.

• Se coordonner et communiquer avec les différents contributeurs techniques et fonctionnels, suivre les prérequis et points bloquants.

• Rédiger et maintenir les spécifications fonctionnelles et techniques des interfaces, documenter les flux, règles de gestion et partager avec tous les contributeurs techniques.

• Réaliser les développements et participer à la revue du code en environnement Oracle / PL/SQL, participer à la mise en œuvre d’intégration basées sur des API et le tout dans le respect des standards de développement, sécurité performance et maintenabilité.

• Organiser et exécuter les tests unitaires, puis d’intégration avec les flux end to end (ctrl-M / Talend) et enfin les test UAT avec le métier. Documenter dans l’outil Jira / XRay les résultats de test. Procéder aux corrections et effectuer les tests de non-régression.

• Préparer le déploiement et le bon fonctionnement des interfaces en production, sanity check et participer à la stabilisation des interfaces après la mise en production.

• Communication et reporting régulier, proactif à l’équipe projet et contributeurs.

Profil recherché

• Formation supérieure en informatique ou domaine équivalent.

• Expérience confirmée en analyse, conception et développement d’interfaces dans le cadre de projets IT ou sur des projets impliquant du PL / SQL.

• Expérience significative sur des projets d’intégration ou de transformation de systèmes d’information.

• Expérience dans des environnements complexes impliquant plusieurs applications et équipes contributrices.

• Une expérience dans le domaine des Ressources Humaines ou des solutions Oracle HCM / OHRMS constitue un atout.

• Langues: Français, Anglais

Compétences techniques

• Très bonne maîtrise d’Oracle et de PL/SQL, bonne connaissance des bases de données relationnelles et de la manipulation de donnée.

• Expérience dans la conception et la mise en œuvre d’interfaces.

• Maîtrise ou bonne compréhension des technologies API REST et SOAP; des formats JSON et XML et mécanismes de sécurité des échanges.

• Connaissance des mécanismes de transformation de données tels que Talend, des outils d’ordonnancement tels que Control-M.

• Connaissance des outils de suivi et de documentation tels que Jira, Confluence.

Compétences personnelles

• Esprit d’analyse et de synthèse.

• Autonomie et capacité à prendre en charge un sujet de bout en bout.

• Rigueur dans la conception, la documentation et le suivi.

• Aisance relationnelle, Team spirit.

• Orienté résultats et respect des engagements.

Compétences clés : Adhésion aux valeurs de l’entreprise : engagement, conviction, agilité et responsabilité
 Respect des réglementations et des directives internes.

jobs.title: PMG Internship 2027 (Zurich, 6 months)
jobs.description:
We are currently seeking motivated students to join our Private Markets Group (PMG) Team for internship opportunities starting in February 2027 or August 2027 . The Private Markets Group Intern will actively participate in the screening, due diligence, and execution of direct private market transactions.

Within Union Bancaire Privée (UBP), the Private Markets Group (PMG) is responsible for sourcing and introducing private market investment opportunities to sophisticated HNWIs and institutional clients. Leveraging our extensive network of valuable contacts, we regularly provide privileged access to exclusive investment opportunities across all sectors of the so-called “Private Markets,” including real estate, private equity, private debt, and infrastructure assets. In doing so, the PMG enhances the differentiation of Union Bancaire Privée (UBP)’s product offering and supports the acquisition of new clients as well as the growth of Assets under Management (AuM).

Main responsibilities:

• Screen and analyse new investments opportunities across various sectors of the private markets;

• Conduct in-depth financial analysis and modelling, industry research and business analysis;

• Support on the due diligence of deals retained by the Team;

• Prepare investment briefings and memorandums, and help defend investment recommendations to the investment committee;

• Support on the preparation of sales pitches and presentations;

• Assist the Team in the execution process of private markets transactions;

Your Profile:

• Bachelor’s degree or ongoing master’s degree in business administration, finance, economics or a related field. ! Please note that this internship is open exclusively to students who are currently enrolled in their studies. Candidates who have already completed or are in the process of completing a master's degree unfortunately do not qualify for our internship positions. We kindly invite such candidates to instead explore our Graduate Programme, which is specifically designed for recent master's graduates. Students who are taking a gap year between their bachelor's and master's degree are also eligible to apply.

• Strong quantitative and financial modelling skills (DCF, LBOs, etc.)

• Internship experience in a similar field is preferred

• Fluent in English (German and/or French is an asset)

Application Process:
 Please note that we only accept applications submitted through our official online career page. Unfortunately, we are unable to consider applications sent via email or LinkedIn.
 Important: In your application, please clearly indicate whether you are available to start in February 2027, August 2027, or if both options are possible.
 Please make sure to include following documents in your application:

• CV

• Cover Letter (including your possible start date)

• Diplomas & certificates

• Grade-Transcripts

• Reference letters

We look forward to receiving your online application!

descriptionByLocale.it:
Siamo attualmente alla ricerca di studenti motivati ad aderire al nostro Private Markets Group (PMG) Team per opportunità di stage a partire dal febbraio 2027 o agosto 2027 . Il Private Markets Group Intern parteciperà attivamente alla proiezione, due diligence e all'esecuzione delle transazioni dirette sul mercato privato.

All'interno di Union Bancaire Privée (UBP), il Private Markets Group (PMG) è responsabile dell'approvvigionamento e dell'introduzione di opportunità di investimento sul mercato privato per sofisticati HNWIs e clienti istituzionali. Sfruttando la nostra vasta rete di contatti di valore, forniamo regolarmente l’accesso privilegiato alle opportunità di investimento esclusive in tutti i settori dei cosiddetti “Private Markets”, tra cui immobili, private equity, private debito e asset infrastrutturali. In tal modo, il PMG migliora la differenziazione dell’offerta di prodotti dell’Unione Bancaire Privée (UBP) e supporta l’acquisizione di nuovi clienti e la crescita dei beni sotto Management (AuM).

Principali responsabilità:

• Promuovere e analizzare nuove opportunità di investimento in vari settori dei mercati privati;

• condurre un'analisi finanziaria approfondita e la modellazione, la ricerca industriale e l'analisi aziendale;

• Sostegno alla due diligenza delle offerte tratte dal Team;

• Preparare briefing di investimento e memorandum, e contribuire a difendere le raccomandazioni di investimento al comitato di investimento;

• Sostegno alla preparazione di piazzole di vendita e presentazioni;

• Assistere il Team nel processo di esecuzione delle transazioni sui mercati privati;

Il tuo profilo:

• Corso di laurea o continuo master in amministrazione aziendale, finanza, economia o un campo correlato. ! Si prega di notare che questo stage è aperto esclusivamente agli studenti che sono attualmente iscritti nei loro studi. I candidati che hanno già completato o sono nel processo di completamento di un master purtroppo non si qualificano per le nostre posizioni di tirocinio. Invitiamo gentilmente tali candidati ad esplorare invece il nostro programma di laurea, che è specificamente progettato per i laureati di recente master. Gli studenti che stanno prendendo un anno di gap tra il loro diploma di laurea e master sono anche idonei ad applicare.

• Forte capacità di modellazione quantitativa e finanziaria (DCF, LBO, ecc.)

• Esperienza di stage in un campo simile è preferito

• Fluente in inglese (tedesco e/o francese è un bene)

Processo di applicazione:
Si prega di notare che accettiamo solo le domande presentate attraverso la nostra pagina ufficiale di carriera online. Purtroppo, non siamo in grado di considerare le applicazioni inviate via e-mail o LinkedIn.
Importante: Nella vostra applicazione, si prega di indicare chiaramente se siete disponibili per iniziare nel febbraio 2027, agosto 2027, o se entrambe le opzioni sono possibili.
Assicurarsi di includere i seguenti documenti nella vostra applicazione:

• CV

• Lettera di copertura (compresa la data di inizio possibile)

• Diploma e certificati

• Voce principale:

• Lettere di riferimento

Non vediamo l'ora di ricevere la vostra applicazione online!

Wir suchen derzeit motivierte Studenten, um unserem Team der Private Markets Group (PMG) für Praktika ab Februar 2027 oder August 2027 beizutreten. Die Private Markets Group Intern wird sich aktiv an der Überprüfung, Due Diligence und Durchführung von direkten privaten Markttransaktionen beteiligen.

Innerhalb der Union Bancaire Privée (UBP) ist die Private Markets Group (PMG) für die Beschaffung und Einführung von Anlagemöglichkeiten für anspruchsvolle HNWIs und institutionelle Kunden verantwortlich. Durch unser umfangreiches Netzwerk an wertvollen Kontakten bieten wir regelmäßig privilegierten Zugang zu exklusiven Anlagemöglichkeiten in allen Sektoren der sogenannten „Private Markets, einschließlich Immobilien, Private Equity, Private Debt und Infrastrukturanlagen. • Durchführung einer eingehenden Finanzanalyse und -modellierung, Branchenforschung und Geschäftsanalyse;

• Unterstützung bei der Due Diligence von Deals, die vom Team beibehalten werden;

• Vorbereitung von Investitionsbriefings und Memoranden und Unterstützung der Anlageempfehlungen an den Investitionsausschuss;

• Unterstützung bei der Vorbereitung von Verkaufsgesprächen und Präsentationen;

• Unterstützung des Teams bei der Ausführung von Transaktionen auf privaten Märkten;

• fließend Englisch (Deutsch und/oder Französisch ist ein Asset)

jobs.description:
Description
 Union Bancaire Privée (UBP) is one of Switzerland's leading private banks, serving private and institutional clients from Geneva, Zurich and a network of international offices. Within the bank, the Compliance Projects & Tools team is responsible for the applications, data flows and working methods that allow the Compliance function to monitor the bank's activity and meet its regulatory obligations.
 As a Data & Process Analyst, you will join this team on concrete, hands-on assignments. Your work will consist of understanding how a compliance process works today, locating and analysing the data behind it, and proposing a clearer, better documented and more automated way of running it. You will move between business questions, banking datasets and the tools that consume them.
 Alongside the analytical work, you will take part in the delivery of Compliance projects: gathering requirements from the business, writing specifications, preparing and running tests, and documenting how a new tool is meant to behave. Doing so, you will see in a short period, how a regulated process is designed, challenged and industrialised.
 Artificial intelligence is part of the toolbox. The bank provides its staff with secure enterprise generative-AI assistants, and Compliance is actively looking at how to use them well: summarizing and comparing regulatory documents, extracting structured information from free text, drafting and reviewing procedures, and answering recurring questions faster.
 Mission
 Support the Compliance Projects & Tools team in analysing, documenting and improving compliance processes and the data that feeds them, and in delivering the tools that support the function.
The role sits at the intersection of data analysis, process design and project delivery: taking an open question, breaking it down, testing it against real data and coming back with a clear, evidence-based recommendation – making full and sensible use of the analytical and artificial-intelligence tools the bank makes available.
• You will be mentored by a Change Manager in Compliance Projects & Tools team, based in our Geneva office, and will work closely with Compliance officers and IT teams.
 • Main responsibilities
 • ■ Map and document compliance processes, controls and data flows, and identify simplification or automation opportunities
• ■ Extract, clean and structure data from several internal banking systems in order to answer precise compliance questions
• ■ Build small scripts and prototypes, mainly in Python and SQL, to automate recurring manual tasks / reportings and reduce operational effort
• ■ Contribute to Compliance projects end to end: requirements, specifications, test cases and user acceptance testing
• ■ Turn analytical findings into clear, concise material that non-technical stakeholders and management can act upon

Education

■ Currently enrolled at EPFL (or an equivalent Swiss university) in a Bachelor's final year or Master's program in Computer Science, Data Science, Mathematics, Engineering or another quantitative discipline
■ Solid foundation in statistics and data handling; academic or personal projects involving AI are a plus

Experience

• ■ Working knowledge of Python and a genuine willingness to develop it further in a professional environment; familiarity with SQL is an advantage
• ■ Comfortable working with large or imperfect datasets: cleaning, joining, reconciling and validating data before drawing conclusions
• ■ Hands-on user of generative-AI assistants, with a realistic sense of what they do well, where they fail, and how to verify what they produce
• ■ Good command of Excel and the ability to produce clear, well-structured written documentation
• ■ Interest in banking, financial markets or regulation; previous experience in the financial industry is a plus but is not required
• ■ No prior compliance knowledge is expected: the regulatory context will be taught on the job
 • Language
 • ■ French: Fluent
• ■ English: Fluent
 • Personal Skills
 • ■ Curious and inventive: you want to understand how a process really works before proposing a solution, and you enjoy building things rather than only describing them
• ■ Structured, rigorous and quality conscious, with a critical eye on your own results
• ■ Sound judgement on AI-generated output: you verify it against the source before relying on it, and you say so when it does not hold
• ■ Able to explain technical work in simple terms, in writing and verbally, to non-technical stakeholders
• ■ Autonomous and pragmatic: you can take an open question, break it down and come back with something concrete within a short timeframe
• ■ Reliable, discreet and at ease with the confidentiality standards of a private bank
• ■ A flexible team player, comfortable in an environment where priorities evolve quickly

descriptionByLocale.it:
Descrizione
 Union Bancaire Privée (UBP) è una delle principali banche private della Svizzera, che serve clienti privati e istituzionali di Ginevra, Zurigo e una rete di uffici internazionali. All'interno della banca, il team Compliance Projects & Tools è responsabile per le applicazioni, i flussi di dati e i metodi di lavoro che permettono alla funzione Compliance di monitorare l'attività della banca e soddisfare i suoi obblighi normativi.
 Come Data & Process Analyst, si unirà a questo team su incarichi concreti e pratici. Il vostro lavoro consisterà nella comprensione di come un processo di conformità funziona oggi, individuando e analizzando i dati che lo stanno dietro, e proponendo un modo più chiaro, meglio documentato e più automatizzato di eseguirlo. Ti trasferirai tra le domande aziendali, i dataset bancari e gli strumenti che li consumano.
 Oltre al lavoro analitico, parteciperai alla consegna dei progetti Compliance: raccogliere i requisiti dal business, scrivere specifiche, preparare e eseguire test e documentare come un nuovo strumento è destinato a comportarsi. In questo modo, si vedrà in un breve periodo, come un processo regolamentato è progettato, sfidato e industrializzato.
 L'intelligenza artificiale fa parte della cassetta degli strumenti. La banca fornisce al suo personale assistenti generativi-AI aziendali sicuri, e Compliance sta attivamente cercando di utilizzarli bene: riassumere e confrontare i documenti normativi, estrarre le informazioni strutturate dal testo libero, la stesura e la revisione delle procedure, e rispondere alle domande ricorrenti più velocemente.
 Missione
 Supporta il team Compliance Projects & Tools per analizzare, documentare e migliorare i processi di conformità e i dati che li alimentano e per fornire gli strumenti che supportano la funzione.
Il ruolo si trova all'intersezione dell'analisi dei dati, della progettazione dei processi e della consegna dei progetti: prendere una domanda aperta, distruggerla, testarla contro i dati reali e tornare con una raccomandazione chiara, basata sulle prove – facendo uso pieno e sensibile degli strumenti analitici e artificiali-intelligence che la banca mette a disposizione.
• Sarete mentorizzati da un Change Manager in Compliance Projects & Tools team, con sede nel nostro ufficio di Ginevra, e lavorerà a stretto contatto con gli ufficiali di conformità e le squadre IT.
 • Principali responsabilità
 • ■ processi di conformità della mappa e dei documenti, controlli e flussi di dati e individuare opportunità di semplificazione o automazione
• ■ estrarre, pulire e strutturare i dati da diversi sistemi bancari interni al fine di rispondere a precise domande di conformità
• ■ Costruire piccoli script e prototipi, principalmente in Python e SQL, per automatizzare le attività manuali ricorrenti / report e ridurre lo sforzo operativo
• ■ Contribuire ai progetti di conformità finiscono alla fine: requisiti, specifiche, casi di test e test di accettazione degli utenti
• ■ trasformare i risultati analitici in materiale chiaro e conciso su cui gli stakeholder e la gestione non tecnici possono agire

Istruzione

■ Attualmente iscritta all'EPFL (o un'università svizzera equivalente) nell'ultimo anno di Bachelor o nel programma Master in Informatica, Scienza dei dati, Matematica, Ingegneria o un'altra disciplina quantitativa
■ solide basi per la statistica e la gestione dei dati; progetti accademici o personali che coinvolgono l'IA sono un plus

Esperienza

• ■ conoscenza di Python e una sincera volontà di svilupparla ulteriormente in un ambiente professionale; la familiarità con SQL è un vantaggio
• ■ Confortevole lavoro con set di dati grandi o imperfetti: pulizia, unione, riconciliazione e convalida dei dati prima di trarre conclusioni
• ■ utente pratico di assistenti generativi-AI, con un senso realistico di ciò che fanno bene, dove falliscono, e come verificare ciò che producono
• ■ Buon comando di Excel e la capacità di produrre una documentazione scritta chiara e ben strutturata
• ■ Interessi nel settore bancario, dei mercati finanziari o della regolamentazione; l'esperienza precedente nell'industria finanziaria è un vantaggio ma non è necessaria
• ■ Non è prevista alcuna conoscenza preventiva della conformità: il contesto normativo verrà insegnato sul lavoro
 • Lingua
 • ■ francese: fluente
• ■ inglese: Fluent
 • Competenze personali
 • ■ Curiosità e inventiva: vuoi capire come funziona davvero un processo prima di proporre una soluzione, e ti piace costruire cose piuttosto che descriverle
• ■ strutturato, rigoroso e consapevole della qualità, con un occhio critico sui propri risultati
• ■ Giudizio sonoro sull'output generato dall'AI: lo verifica contro la fonte prima di affidarsi a esso, e lo dici quando non regge
• ■ In grado di spiegare il lavoro tecnico in termini semplici, per iscritto e verbalmente, agli stakeholder non tecnici
• ■ Autonoma e pragmatica: si può prendere una domanda aperta, abbatterla e tornare con qualcosa di concreto entro un breve periodo di tempo
• ■ Affidabile, discreto e a suo agio con gli standard di riservatezza di una banca privata
• ■ Un team player flessibile, confortevole in un ambiente in cui le priorità si evolvono rapidamente
descriptionByLocale.de:
Beschreibung
 Die Union Bancaire Privée (UBP) ist eine der führenden Schweizer Privatbanken und betreut private und institutionelle Kunden aus Genf, Zürich und einem Netzwerk internationaler Niederlassungen. Innerhalb der Bank ist das Team von Compliance Projects & Tools für die Anwendungen, Datenflüsse und Arbeitsmethoden verantwortlich, die es der Compliance-Funktion ermöglichen, die Aktivitäten der Bank zu überwachen und ihren regulatorischen Verpflichtungen nachzukommen.
 Als Data & Process Analyst treten Sie diesem Team bei konkreten, praktischen Aufgaben bei. Ihre Arbeit besteht darin, zu verstehen, wie ein Compliance-Prozess heute funktioniert, die Daten dahinter zu lokalisieren und zu analysieren und eine klarere, besser dokumentierte und automatisierte Ausführung vorzuschlagen. Sie bewegen sich zwischen Geschäftsfragen, Bankdatensätzen und den Tools, die sie verbrauchen.
 Neben der analytischen Arbeit nehmen Sie an der Bereitstellung von Compliance-Projekten teil: Sammeln von Anforderungen aus dem Unternehmen, Schreiben von Spezifikationen, Vorbereitung und Durchführung von Tests und Dokumentation des Verhaltens eines neuen Tools. So sehen Sie in kurzer Zeit, wie ein geregelter Prozess gestaltet, herausgefordert und industrialisiert wird.
 Künstliche Intelligenz ist Teil der Toolbox. Die Bank stellt ihren Mitarbeitern sichere Enterprise-Generative-AI-Assistenten zur Verfügung, und Compliance untersucht aktiv, wie sie diese gut einsetzen können: Zusammenfassen und Vergleichen von regulatorischen Dokumenten, Extrahieren strukturierter Informationen aus freiem Text, Erstellen und Überprüfen von Verfahren und schnellere Beantwortung wiederkehrender Fragen.
 Mission
 Unterstützen Sie das Team von Compliance Projects & Tools bei der Analyse, Dokumentation und Verbesserung von Compliance-Prozessen und den Daten, die sie speisen, sowie bei der Bereitstellung der Tools, die die Funktion unterstützen.
Die Rolle liegt an der Schnittstelle von Datenanalyse, Prozessdesign und Projektabwicklung: eine offene Frage annehmen, sie aufschlüsseln, sie mit realen Daten testen und mit einer klaren, evidenzbasierten Empfehlung zurückkehren - die vollständige und sinnvolle Nutzung der analytischen und künstlichen Intelligenz-Tools, die die Bank zur Verfügung stellt.
• Sie werden von einem Change Manager in Compliance Projects & Tools Team mit Sitz in unserem Büro in Genf betreut und arbeiten eng mit Compliance Officers und IT Teams zusammen.
 • Hauptzuständigkeiten
 • ■ Compliance-Prozesse, Kontrollen und Datenflüsse abbilden und dokumentieren sowie Vereinfachungs- oder Automatisierungsmöglichkeiten identifizieren
• Extrahieren, Bereinigen und Strukturieren von Daten aus mehreren internen Bankensystemen, um präzise Compliance-Fragen zu beantworten
• Erstellen Sie kleine Skripte und Prototypen, hauptsächlich in Python und SQL, um wiederkehrende manuelle Aufgaben / Berichte zu automatisieren und den Betriebsaufwand zu reduzieren.
• ■ Beitrag zu Compliance-Projekten durchgängig: Anforderungen, Spezifikationen, Testfälle und Benutzerakzeptanztests
• Verwandeln Sie analytische Ergebnisse in klares, prägnantes Material, auf das nicht-technische Stakeholder und das Management reagieren können

Bildung

■ Derzeit an der EPFL (oder einer gleichwertigen Schweizer Universität) immatrikuliert in einem Bachelor-Abschlussjahr oder Master-Studiengang in Informatik, Data Science, Mathematik, Ingenieurwissenschaften oder einer anderen quantitativen Disziplin
Solide Grundlage in Statistik und Datenverarbeitung; akademische oder persönliche Projekte mit KI sind ein Plus

Erfahrung

• ■ Kenntnisse in Python und eine echte Bereitschaft, es in einem professionellen Umfeld weiterzuentwickeln; Vertrautheit mit SQL ist von Vorteil
• Komfortables Arbeiten mit großen oder unvollkommenen Datensätzen: Bereinigen, Verbinden, Abgleichen und Validieren von Daten, bevor Schlussfolgerungen gezogen werden
• Hands-on-Benutzer von Generativ-KI-Assistenten, mit einem realistischen Gefühl dafür, was sie gut machen, wo sie versagen und wie sie überprüfen können, was sie produzieren
• • Gute Beherrschung von Excel und die Fähigkeit, klare, gut strukturierte schriftliche Dokumentation zu erstellen
• Interesse an Banken, Finanzmärkten oder Regulierung; vorherige Erfahrung in der Finanzbranche ist ein Plus, aber nicht erforderlich
• ■ Es wird kein vorheriges Compliance-Wissen erwartet: Der regulatorische Kontext wird am Arbeitsplatz gelehrt
 • Sprache
 • Französisch: fließend
• Englisch: Fluent
 • Persönliche Fähigkeiten
 • Neugierig und erfinderisch: Sie möchten verstehen, wie ein Prozess wirklich funktioniert, bevor Sie eine Lösung vorschlagen, und Sie genießen es, Dinge zu bauen, anstatt sie nur zu beschreiben
• ■ Strukturiert, streng und qualitätsbewusst, mit einem kritischen Blick auf Ihre eigenen Ergebnisse
• ■ Gesundes Urteil über KI-generierte Produktion: Sie verifizieren es mit der Quelle, bevor Sie sich darauf verlassen, und Sie sagen es, wenn es nicht gilt
• ■ In der Lage, technische Arbeit in einfachen Worten, schriftlich und mündlich, für nicht-technische Stakeholder zu erklären
• Autonom und pragmatisch: Sie können eine offene Frage annehmen, sie aufschlüsseln und innerhalb kurzer Zeit mit etwas Konkretem zurückkommen
• ■ Zuverlässig, diskret und bequem mit den Vertraulichkeitsstandards einer Privatbank
• Ein flexibler Teamplayer, komfortabel in einer Umgebung, in der sich Prioritäten schnell entwickeln

Désignation des marchandises
 Union Bancaire Privée (UBP) est l'une des principales banques privées suisses, au service de clients privés et institutionnels de Genève, Zurich et d'un réseau de bureaux internationaux. Au sein de la banque, l'équipe Projets et outils de conformité est responsable des applications, des flux de données et des méthodes de travail qui permettent à la fonction Conformité de surveiller l'activité de la banque et de respecter ses obligations réglementaires.
 En tant qu'analyste de données et de processus, vous rejoindrez cette équipe pour des missions concrètes et pratiques. Votre travail consistera à comprendre comment fonctionne aujourd'hui un processus de conformité, à localiser et à analyser les données qui l'entourent, et à proposer une façon plus claire, mieux documentée et plus automatisée de le faire fonctionner. Vous passerez entre les questions d'affaires, les ensembles de données bancaires et les outils qui les consomment.
 Parallèlement au travail d'analyse, vous participerez à la réalisation de projets de conformité : collecte d'exigences auprès de l'entreprise, rédaction de spécifications, préparation et exécution de tests, et documentation de la manière dont un nouvel outil est conçu pour se comporter. Ce faisant, vous verrez en peu de temps comment un processus réglementé est conçu, défié et industrialisé.
 L'intelligence artificielle fait partie de la boîte à outils. La banque met à la disposition de son personnel des assistants professionnels en sécurité, et la conformité examine activement comment bien les utiliser : résumer et comparer les documents réglementaires, extraire des informations structurées du texte libre, rédiger et réviser les procédures et répondre plus rapidement aux questions récurrentes.
 Mission
 Aider l'équipe Projets et outils de conformité à analyser, documenter et améliorer les processus de conformité et les données qui les alimentent, et à fournir les outils qui soutiennent la fonction.
Le rôle se situe à l'intersection de l'analyse des données, de la conception des processus et de l'exécution des projets : poser une question ouverte, la décomposer, la tester par rapport à des données réelles et revenir avec une recommandation claire et fondée sur des données probantes – en utilisant pleinement et judicieusement les outils d'analyse et d'intelligence artificielle mis à disposition par la banque.
• Vous serez encadré par une équipe de responsables du changement dans les projets et outils de conformité, basée dans notre bureau de Genève, et travaillera en étroite collaboration avec les agents de conformité et les équipes informatiques.
 • Principales responsabilités
 • ■ cartographier et documenter les processus de conformité, les contrôles et les flux de données, et identifier les possibilités de simplification ou d'automatisation
• ■ Extraire, nettoyer et structurer les données de plusieurs systèmes bancaires internes afin de répondre à des questions précises de conformité
• ■ Construisez de petits scripts et prototypes, principalement en Python et SQL, pour automatiser les tâches/rapports manuels récurrents et réduire l'effort opérationnel
• ■ Contribuer à la fin des projets de conformité: exigences, spécifications, cas d'essai et essais d'acceptation par les utilisateurs
• ■ transformer les résultats analytiques en documents clairs et concis sur lesquels les acteurs non techniques et la direction peuvent agir

Éducation

■ Actuellement inscrit à l'EPFL (ou à une université suisse équivalente) en dernière année de licence ou en maîtrise en informatique, informatique, informatique, mathématiques, génie ou autre discipline quantitative
■ Une base solide en matière de statistiques et de traitement des données; les projets académiques ou personnels impliquant l'IA sont un plus

Expérience

• ■ une connaissance pratique du Python et une réelle volonté de le développer davantage dans un environnement professionnel; la connaissance du SQL est un avantage
• ■ Travail confortable avec des ensembles de données volumineux ou imparfaits: nettoyage, assemblage, rapprochement et validation des données avant de tirer des conclusions
• ■ Utilisation manuelle d'assistants générateurs d'IA, avec un sens réaliste de ce qu'ils font bien, où ils échouent, et comment vérifier ce qu'ils produisent
• ■ Bonne maîtrise d'Excel et capacité à produire une documentation écrite claire et bien structurée
• ■ Intérêts bancaires, financiers ou réglementaires; expérience antérieure dans le secteur financier est un plus, mais n'est pas nécessaire
• ■ Aucune connaissance préalable de la conformité n'est attendue: le contexte réglementaire sera enseigné au travail
 • Langue
 • ■ Français: fluide
• ■ Anglais: fluide
 • Compétences personnelles
 • ■ Curieux et inventif: vous voulez comprendre comment un processus fonctionne réellement avant de proposer une solution, et vous aimez construire des choses plutôt que de les décrire seulement
• ■ Structure, rigueur et qualité, avec un regard critique sur vos propres résultats
• ■ Jugement sain sur la sortie générée par l'IA: vous la vérifiez par rapport à la source avant de vous y fier, et vous le dites quand elle ne tient pas
• ■ Capacité d'expliquer le travail technique en termes simples, par écrit et verbalement, aux acteurs non techniques
• ■ Autonome et pragmatique: vous pouvez répondre à une question ouverte, la décomposer et revenir avec quelque chose de concret dans un court délai
• ■ Fiabilité, discrétion et facilité avec les normes de confidentialité d'une banque privée
• ■ Une équipe flexible, confortable dans un environnement où les priorités évoluent rapidement

jobs.title: SECURITIES TRANSFERS OFFICER
jobs.description:
• SECURITIES TRANSFERS OFFICER - 4 MONTHS MISSION

• Mission:

• Ensure the clients' assets delivery/receipt for all the activities associated with the transfer of securities to a different financial establishment or within the Bank.

• This includes all type of assets with expertise primarily required in alternative assets such as mutual funds, Private Equities and Hedge Funds

• Effective date : ASAP.

• Main responsibilities:

• Crossed analysis of the received information: custodian’s swifts, agent prospectus, contract notes and financial providers such as: Bloomberg, Telekurs.

• Perform control of reconciliation of holdings, entitlements determination, pending positions management.

• Be able to manage and control securities transfer instructions received from Wealth Management and external parties (transfer IN/OUT/Internal and funds registration process).

• Control transmission of the deposits to our correspondents/Transfer Agents/Administrators and control of their safe delivery and acceptance.

• Follow-up of the topics and issues over the lifecycle of the securities transfer activities.

• Good understanding of the risks inherent in the Corporate Actions environment related to ongoing securities transfers and demonstrate good discipline around control and escalation.

• Ensure daily follow up in respect of pending issues and take appropriate measures for resolution.

• Your Profile:

• Education : Master Degree

• Languages : french and english

• Others
• Swiss Residence

Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives
